title: Lead Product Designer
original_description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them.   • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

Description Join Our Team as a Remote Experienced and Licensed Customer Service Representative! Within our Customer Response Center, the Remote Customer Service Representative provides timely, accurate and responsive information and service to policyholders and agents for a division of Personal Lines products, plans and programs. Independently solve problems relating to policies within scope and escalate others as appropriate. Identifies, analyzes, and owns customer policy needs to ensure high customer satisfaction, growth and retention of business. Training: Paid training is Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:30pm EST (full time). Training is a critical component to your success, and that success starts with reliable attendance. Attendance and active engagement during training is mandatory for success in this role. Shift: After onboarding and training is complete, go-forward shifts will have a start time between Shift hours 8:30 am -10:30 am EST with a weekend rotation. One weekend day (Saturday or Sunday) will be required with an alternate day off mid-week when working the weekend. Work Location: All equipment is provided. However, to work from home you must have dependable, wired internet connectivity with an upload speed of at least 5Mbps and a download speed of at least 25Mbps along with a quiet, secure, distraction free place to work. License: Active P&C Producers insurance license REQUIRED. We are currently not hiring in NY, CA, AK, HI, NM or IL. Qualifications Associates degree or 1+ year Insurance experience preferred. 2 years'+ related Customer Service experience is required. Ability to review, record and organize written data from a variety of sources with no prescribed format is essential. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are required. P&C Producers insurance license required. About Us Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. title: Surveyor I
original_description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
original_description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

We are one of the leading tech-driven media and entertainment companies, producing uplifting content in 17 languages for audiences of all ages. Known for the award-winning digital publisher boredpanda.com and the Crafty Panda DIY channel, we fight the worldâs boredom at scale - reaching 160 million site views per month and 62 billion video views per year. Our team consists of around 350 creative professionals from 36 countries, with 2 offices in Vilnius, Lithuania.

Spike, the global animated series, is searching for talented voice actors to bring its characters to life! Our YouTube channel has reached over 1 billion views, entertaining children worldwide with universal, character-driven stories. We're casting our two lead roles: Spike, an imaginative, curious, and fearless 7-year-old whose creativity turns everyday moments into adventures; and Sparkle, his confident, attention-loving 5Â½-year-old sister with unmistakable main-character energy. Additionally, we are seeking versatile utility players who can perform multiple recurring characters - from the know-it-all giraffe girl, Poem, and the scared but loyal elephant boy, Muddles, to the bully rhino twins, Storm and Thunder, and the local mad scientist lion, Professor Roar, to name a few.   • Bring recurring characters to life with expressive performances that match the show's playful and energetic tone;
  • Help shape memorable voices and personalities for the faces of a global IP;
  • Deliver engaging voice performances that support clear storytelling in fast-paced 3â5 minute episodes;
  • Perform dialogue that enhances visual comedy and elevates emotional moments;
  • Maintain consistent character voices and performances across multiple episodes;

  • Record clean, broadcast-quality audio from a professional home studio;

  • Spike is worldwide, so an understanding of globally accessible performances that communicate character and emotion across cultures;

title: Regional Sales Manager
original_description:
Company Information

CSWâs Engineered Building Solutions segment manufactures custom architectural building components and innovative firestopping and smoke-rated products that help protect people. Safety and code compliance are top of mind for architects, engineers and contractors. Our purposeful brands combine functionality with aesthetically pleasing designs for the construction, refurbishment, and modernization of buildings.â¯Our brands include Balco, Greco Architectural Metal Products, and Smoke Guard.

Position Summary

Balco is seeking a dynamic, motivated, and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead and grow sales of our architectural product lines across the Western Half of the United States. This is a high-impact leadership role for a sales professional who thrives in the architectural building products space and is energized by building teams, driving growth, and influencing complex construction projects from design through installation.

The RSM will lead a network of direct sales professionals and independent manufacturer representatives while serving as a key market ambassador for Balcoâs portfolio of architectural engineered products for the construction industry. Categories include expansion joint systems, stair nosings, entrance mats & grids, photoluminescent egress systems, etc. The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership with technical acumen to guide product selection based on project-specific conditions, ensuring Balco solutions are specified and installed successfully in competitive bid environments. This role combines strategic leadership, hands-on selling and technical support, and rigorous performance management to deliver profitable growth and exceptional customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Drive year-over-year revenue growth to meet or exceed sales budgets across assigned territories and product lines.
  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing sales organization consisting of direct sales employees and independent manufacturer representatives, setting clear goals and driving accountability across both groups.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to sales team members and customers, including analyzing project conditions, recommending appropriate Balco products (e.g., expansion joint systems, stair nosings, photoluminescent egress markings), and assisting with submittals and specifications.
  • Develop and implement competitive strategies to increase Balco specification rates and market share, including targeted initiatives with architects, contractors, and distributors.

title: Growth Strategist
original_description:
About the Company

Why We Built Lyric: Supply chains are more critical and complex than ever. Every day, large enterprises navigate trillions of possible decisions that could impact the bottom line. Powerful algorithms and AI can address these problems, yet most organizations struggle to leverage supply chain AI at scale. The current SCM technologies are either rigid, limited-scope point solutions or custom solutions built in-house, which demand immense expertise and investment.

That isâ¦until now.

Enter Lyric: Lyric is an enterprise AI platform built specifically for supply chains, offering the best of both worlds:

  • Out-of-the-box AI solutions for optimizing networks, allocating inventory, scheduling routes, planning fulfillment capacity, promising orders, propagating demand, building predictions, analyzing scenarios, and more, plus

  • A platform-first approach that empowers both business and technical users with end-to-end product composability, leveraging no-code tools, their own code, or even forking our code to build and refine supply chain decision intelligence

With Lyric, enterprises no longer have to choose between flexibility and speed, they get both.

The Mission: Weâre building a new era in supply chain with the team best equipped to lead it. With over 20 years at the intersection of supply chain and algorithms, we developed a deep conviction that global supply chains needed something like Lyric. Since our inception in December 2021, that conviction has been validated time and time again.

Today, a growing number of Fortune 500 companies, including Smurfit WestRock, EstÃ©e Lauder, Coca-Cola, and more, are innovating on their own terms with Lyric. We canât wait to see what our customers, both current and future, are empowered to build with us next. Come build with us!

About the Role

Weâre hiring Growth Strategists: high-agency, client-facing professionals who will be the tip of the spear for Lyricâs go-to-market approach. This is not a traditional business development role. Youâll be embedded with senior sales leaders and cross-functional teams, opening new accounts while building real expertise in the enterprise GTM motion.

This role is designed for driven early-career professionals or post-MBA candidates looking to break into a high-growth startup. You donât need enterprise AI or supply chain experience, just the curiosity and work ethic to learn it fast.

Â 

What Youâll Do

  • Identify, research, and develop new account opportunities across target verticals

  • Conduct outbound prospecting through multi-channel campaigns (email, phone, LinkedIn, events)

  • Shadow senior AEs and GTM leaders on client meetings and demos to build domain fluency and selling skills

  • Help prepare demo environments, RFP responses, and opportunity materials for active deals

  • Join opportunity teams to support key pursuit strategy and client engagement

  • Contribute to broader GTM activities: market research, competitive intelligence, event support, and content collaboration

  • Develop a point of view on target accounts and industries that sharpens the teamâs overall strategy

Who You Are

  • Early career (2+ years of professional experience) or post-MBA candidate looking to pivot into enterprise AI technology

  • Exceptional communicator; polished, articulate, and comfortable in client-facing settings

  • High agency: you take ownership, follow through, and donât wait to be told what to do

  • Intellectually curious with a hunger to learn about supply chain, technology, and enterprise sales

  • Strong researcher; you can quickly synthesize complex information and present it clearly

  • Resourceful with tools and technology. You're the kind of person who finds the right shortcut or AI-powered workflow to 10x your output before anyone asks you to

  • Collaborative and team-oriented; comfortable in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

    Â 

Why This Role

  • Career path into AE, pre-sales, solution design, revenue operations, or other GTM roles

  • Direct mentorship from experienced Revenue leadership, VPs of Sales, and AEs. Youâll learn by doing alongside the best

  • You'll be helping define a new category, enterprise AI for supply chain, at a company where the playbook is still being written but the customer base already includes some of the largest, most complex enterprises in the world.

  • Join at a pivotal stage where your contributions are visible, and your growth trajectory is steep

Â 

Even if you donât meet 100% of the qualifications, we recommend applying to the role!

Â 

Location: Remote - Spain, Italy, Portugal. Some travel required.

Â 

Compensation: We provide a competitive mix of salary, commissions, local benefits, and equity, designed to reward both your impact and growth.

title: Regional General Manager Airports
original_description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.
  • Ability to manage multiple leaders and locations simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PC based applications, Microsoft Project, Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to travel & spend time away for significant periods of time.
  • Project management skills considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of International regulations and guidelines (for example - TSA/Civil Aviation, UK High Commission etc.) an asset.
  • Proven track record of effectively influencing leadership teams via handling partners and developing strong direct leadership teams.
  • IATA SGHA experience would be beneficial.

The Benefits Of Being a WestJetter

WestJet provides all WestJetters with a competitive total rewards package. On top of that, we offer:

  • A fun and friendly culture with colleagues who work together to win
  • Travel privileges for you and your family, effective from your start date
  • Savings and Benefit programs that are flexible to meet your specific needs

Think weâre a great fit? Apply now!

About WestJet Group Of Companies

WestJet took to the skies in 1996 with just over 200 employees and three aircraft operating service to five destinations. Since then, WestJet has pioneered low-cost travel in Canada, cutting airfares in half, and increasing the flying population in Canada by more than 50 per cent. Since the Sunwing Airlines integration in 2025, more than 15,000 WestJetters support nearly 200 aircraft and connect guests to our global network of more than 100 destinations across North America, Central America, the Caribbean, Europe and Asia. The WestJet Group is a major Canadian employer and includes WestJet Airlines, WestJet Encore and Sunwing Vacations Group. Weâre Canadaâs leading value airline and largest vacation provider, with a united purpose of providing affordable and accessible air and vacation travel to Canadians.

Our safety promise

At WestJet, the safety and security of our people and our guests is a core value and at the heart of what we do. Safety and security are shared responsibilities all team members are expected to use safe work practices to ensure their well-being and the safety of others. WestJet recognizes that the use of Alcohol and Drugs can adversely impact a safe work environment and the well-being of others including guests, suppliers and the public, as well as place WestJet's operations at risk. All roles that are identified as Safey-Sensitive are required to pass a Pre-Employment Alcohol and Drug Test as per WestJet'sâ¯Alcohol and Drug Policy.â¯

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion

We embrace what makes each of us unique, and what makes us uniquely WestJet. We welcome diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds so if you're passionate about this role, we encourage you to apply â even if you don't meet every qualification listed. WestJet is committed to inclusiveness, equity and accessibility throughout the selection process. If you require accommodation at any stage, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at talent@westjet.com.

We value the time and effort you put into your application. Our recruitment process is highly competitive and while every applicant will receive communication regarding their application status, only those selected to move forward will be contacted with next steps. If this role isnât the right fit, we encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.

About

For more information about everything WestJet, please visit westjet.com/aboutus.

If you wish to withdraw your application or request that your personal information be deleted, please contact us at talent@westjet.com.

title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure)
original_description:
About the role:

The cybersecurity team at FYUL is deliberately small and execution-focused. Its engineering branch runs the company's security operations backbone: a large-scale telemetry and detection platform covering endpoints, network traffic, cloud workloads, and SaaS — a modern SIEM at its core, extended with substantial custom machine learning and AI agents that this team designs and builds itself. This senior engineer role, reporting directly to the Information Security Engineering Manager, owns significant parts of that platform: detection engineering, vulnerability discovery, cloud and endpoint security, data loss prevention, and the automation of security operations.

This is an individual-contributor position where professional growth comes from depth of expertise and ownership of outcomes. The security program is mature, with governance and compliance handled by a dedicated GRC function — so this role is about building and running security engineering, full-time.

Your daily tasks will include:

  • Detection engineering. Design, implement, and tune detections across our security telemetry — SIEM rules as well as custom ML models for anomaly and risk detection. Triage alerts, investigate real incidents, and drive them to closure — including technical incident response and post-incident improvement.

  • Cloud and platform security. Harden and monitor our AWS and Kubernetes (EKS) environments: workload security, IAM, container runtime defense, and configuration standards. Collaborate with engineering teams so security lands as enablement, not friction.

  • Endpoint security. Own the health and hardening of the endpoint agent fleet across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

  • Data loss prevention. Operate and extend DLP coverage across removable media, email, and SaaS channels: telemetry-driven detection of data exfiltration, tuned to keep false positives low.

  • Security automation. Automate recurring operations and detection-to-response workflows — including AI-based agents and pipelines, which are already a working part of this program. Prefer integrating established tooling over bespoke development where it delivers the same outcome.

  • Vulnerability discovery and management. Find infrastructure vulnerabilities yourself — through scanning, configuration review, and targeted penetration testing of our environments — then prioritize and drive remediation to closure. This is not an application security role: a dedicated sub-team covers appsec.

Your qualifications:

  • 5+ years in security engineering or SecOps roles with hands-on responsibility for detections and incidents in production — not solely policy or advisory work.

  • Real detection engineering experience on a modern SIEM/security platform (Elastic Security preferred; Splunk, Sentinel, or comparable count), and the appetite to go beyond built-in rules into custom ML-based detection.

  • Deep, hands-on mastery of Linux, macOS, and Windows: internals, hardening, and investigation on all three. You have personally hunted or hardened systems on each of them, not just one favorite.

  • Strong networking expertise: TCP/IP, routing, VPNs, firewalls, and packet-level analysis — you can reconstruct what happened from a packet capture and reason about how traffic actually flows through our environments.

  • Strong cloud security foundation in AWS, including Kubernetes; you have personally secured and monitored production cloud workloads.

  • Hands-on LLM experience. You have built or operated LLM-powered tooling — agents, pipelines, or detection/automation workflows — not merely used a chat assistant. Our security program already runs AI agents in production; you will extend that work.

  • A certification in practical infrastructure hacking or hardening — e.g., OSCP, OSEP, or a comparable hands-on offensive credential. This matters more to us than knowledge-exam certifications.

  • Demonstrated automation capability: scripts, integrations, pipelines, or AI-assisted workflows you can show. Software engineering background is not required; a track record of building practical automation is.

  • Self-directed working style with strong ownership: the ability to take ambiguous problems through to completed outcomes with minimal supervision.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Further certifications (e.g., CISSP, GIAC/GCFA/GCIH, AWS Security) are an advantage, but the hands-on hacking/hardening credential above is the one we screen for. Hands-on experience always outweighs certification.


Our tech stack:

  • Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis

  • Engineering Tools:Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus.

  • Remote work Tools:Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack.

  • Development Practices:Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment.

What we offer:

  • Monthly salary EUR €4,000 - €6,000/monthgross, depending on work experience, education, and skills

  • A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done

  • An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga

  • Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM)

  • Private health insurance

  • 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being

  • 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice

  • Internal and external learning opportunities

  • Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online

  • Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office

  • Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount

  • Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget!


FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale.

Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products.

From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach.

We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people.

We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience.

If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job.

Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team!

title: Solutions Architect
original_description:
Metal Toad is an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner that empowers organizations to innovate through artificial intelligence, cloud migration, cost optimization, and application modernization. We help our customers with their cloud adoption by providing architecture, migration, optimization, machine learning, and even 24/7 support. We are a professional services firm providing services in software engineering and the cloud. We do Technical consulting, Programming & Quality Assurance, DevOps, Applications, UX, Product management, and Project management.

Metal Toad is a fully remote company, offering all team members the ability to work from home.

Although Metal Toad is a remote company, we are currently seeking contractors residing in Brazil for this position. Compensation will be made in Brazilian Reais (R$), following the local currency of the country where the position is located. Due to legal limitations, we are unable to sponsor any type of visa.

To apply for this position, please submit your resume in English as a PDF.

Job Description

The mission for this role is to design solutions for sales and help engineering teams construct technical solutions.

OUTCOMES

  • Design Efficient solutions: All client solutions should be designed to meet the clients needs within their budget and without over engineering.
  • Ensure designs are cost optimized: Designs are the right mix of build, buy, open source, modules, etc that maximizes the clients’ ROI.
  • Aligns stakeholders: Produce deck slides, given presentations, and other activities to ensure stakeholders from the C-Suite to team developers are inspired and aligned on vision.

Activities

  • Estimation & Allocation: Create accurate estimates for every ticket to enable proper resource allocation.
  • Guide engineers: Ensure engineering efforts focus on the right-size/right-cost solution to prevent over-engineering and developer spiraling.
  • Project contribution: Participate in all phases of the SDLC including, sales, estimating, coding, program management, and other activities as needed.
  • Thought Leadership: Guide Metal Toad engineers and the community by publishing 8+ times per year. This can include blogs, articles, or hosting lunch and learns.
  • Accurate estimates: Create project plans and tickets with accurate timelines and budgets.

QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED

  • Agree with our Corporate Values Statement.
  • Believes in the company's mission: to help people.
  • Believes in the principles of open source.
  • 8+ years of experience programming.
  • Familiar with event-oriented architecture of applications.
  • AWS Certified or able to achieve an AWS certification within 90 days.
  • Familiar with ETL Processes and tools.
  • Experience with various kinds of software documents including data flow diagrams, data dictionaries, network diagrams, and UML diagrams.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with both backend and frontend programming languages.
  • 2+ years as an architect designing solutions on AWS.
  • An AWS professional or Specialty certification.

Please note that Metal Toad will never ask for payment or financial information during the hiring process. If you are asked for such information, it is a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Manual QA Engineer
original_description:
We are FundCount, an international fintech company with a 20-year track record of delivering innovative solutions. Our unified software platform powers investment, general, and partnership accounting, providing operational efficiency and insights to family offices,
fund administrators, and alternative fund managers worldwide. We’re looking for a Manual QA Engineer to join our growing Quality Assurance team.

As part of our team, you’ll play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our product. You'll engage in manual testing to uncover bugs and work closely with our development team to ensure flawless releases. We are a fully remote company, and you can work from anywhere except Russia and Belarus.

About the Product & Team:

Our technology stack includes:

  • Java (Hibernate, Spring, Swing, JUnit4, Mockito)
  • Gradle
  • PostgreSQL, MySQL
  • Git

We follow a one-month release cycle, freezing code two weeks before each release. We document our processes in Confluence and manage our tasks in Jira (in English). The development team primarily communicates in Russian via Slack. Our QA team consists of 8 engineers.

What you will do:

  • Perform thorough manual testing of desktop and web applications.
  • Write detailed bug reports in Jira.
  • Create and maintain test cases in TestRail.
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams throughout the development lifecycle.

What we expect from you:

  • 2+ years of experience in manual testing.
  • Solid understanding of Agile methodologies, SDLC, and CI/CD practices.
  • Intermediate or higher English proficiency (written).
  • Ability to independently research and gather information from documentation and public sources.
  • Adaptability to work with different technologies and tools, with a focus-solving rather than specific experience.

Technical Skills:

  • Experience testing both desktop and web (frontend and backend) applications.
  • Proficient in SQL and the ability to write DML queries.
  • Confident in working with Windows/Linux terminals.Experience with version control systems (Git).
  • Ability to read and interpret application logs and troubleshoot stack traces.
  • Familiarity with scripting languages like PowerShell, Bash, or cmd/bat.

Would be nice if:

  • Basic programming knowledge in any language.
  • Experience or interest in accounting, finance, or investment (e.g., personal involvement in stock markets).

We will be glad to offer you:

  • Fully remote work with a flexible schedule.
  • Corporate benefits.
  • Transparent processes with minimal bureaucracy.

If you’re ready to contribute to a fast-growing fintech company and work with a talented team, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today!

title: Cloud Network Engineer
original_description:
Headquarters: Remote United States

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

The Cloud Network Engineer extends BeyondTrust's on-premises networking fundamentals into AWS cloud networking, with a primary focus on architecting and operating FedRAMP-aligned environments. The successful candidate demonstrates strong technical judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to apply practical solutions to complex hybrid network engineering challenges, while serving as the primary liaison between the Network and Cloud Ops teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Operate and maintain BeyondTrust's on-premises and cloud network infrastructure, including routing/switching changes, datacenter resource changes, and routine firewall/security group changes end-to-end across on-prem and cloud environments; escalate complex or security-sensitive changes to the Sr. Engineer/SecOps.
  • Design and implement AWS network architectures, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, and network security controls, aligned with FedRAMP, ISO 27001, and SOX requirements.
  • Lead the CIDR range overlap remediation project by auditing existing on-prem and AWS CIDR allocations, designing a conflict-free addressing plan, and executing remediation/re-IP work with minimal disruption to production traffic.
  • Serve as the primary day-to-day liaison between the Network team and Cloud Ops on network design, shared infrastructure changes, and incident coordination.
  • Mentor Network Administrators and Engineers on cloud networking fundamentals and hybrid connectivity best practices, extending networking expertise into AWS environments.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using Terraform, Ansible, Python, contributing reusable modules to the team's shared automation library.
  • Participate in the shared 24x7 on-call rotation, independently resolving Tier-1 and Tier-2 escalations, including cloud connectivity issues.
  • Maintain network diagrams, CIDR/IPAM records, architecture documentation, and SOPs, and provide regular progress updates.
  • Manage vendor relationships for cloud connectivity services, circuit vendors, and network infrastructure procurement and renewals.
  • Work a hybrid or remote schedule depending on geographic proximity to a BeyondTrust office; travel to offices or datacenters as needed (5–10%).

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of total network administration/engineering experience, including 2+ years hands-on AWS cloud networking work with VPC design, Transit Gateway, VPN/Direct Connect, Route 53, network security controls across hybrid environments.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Administrator/Engineer-level on-premises networking fundamentals.
  • 3-5 hands-on experience with Cisco NX-OS/IOS/IOS-XE, Dell, and Palo Alto equipment.
  • CCNA certification or equivalent hands-on experience
  • Experience implementing and maintaining security controls aligned with industry frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC2, and FedRAMP.
  • Strong documentation and organizational skills — demonstrated ability to produce clear network diagrams, IPAM records, and runbooks that hold up under audit.
  • Strong analytical and cross-team communication skills; comfortable operating as a liaison between technical teams with different priorities.

Nice To Have

  • CCNP in progress, or equivalent Network Engineer-level experience.
  • Experience with IPAM tooling such asNetBox, phpIPAM, Infoblox, BlueCat.
  • Experience with Azure networking services and hybrid connectivity.
  • Direct experience supporting a FedRAMP ATO or continuous monitoring (ConMon) process.
  • Formal project management or technical project leadership experience.
  • Proficiency in dynamic routing protocols (EIGRP, BGP) and in identity and access management services including RADIUS, TACACS+, Duo, Okta, and Cisco ISE.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com. 

#LI-BS1

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/beyondtrust-cloud-network-engineer

title: Senior Full Stack
original_description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia
URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually.

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.

 

The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery

  • Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

  • Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

  • Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack

  • Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

  • Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

  • Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

  • Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design

  • Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

  • Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

  • Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar

  • Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

  • Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

  • Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage

  • Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

 

About You

You will thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

  • Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

  • Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

  • Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast.

  • Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

  • Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

  • Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

  • Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

  • Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

  • Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

  • Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

  • Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

  • Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

    • Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

    • Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT

  • A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

  • A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

  • A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

  • A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
    team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
    tests, or own your performance regressions.

  • A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

  • A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

 

The Team

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

 

Benefits

  • Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

  • 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

  • Unlimited sick leave

  • In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

  • 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

  • Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

  • €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

  • €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

  • €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

  • €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

  • Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack
