title: Senior Product Designer - ShareGate
original_description:
Company Description

Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them. We have two product lines: Workleap Agent, our newest solution built to make every manager more effective, and ShareGate, the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us. If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

Your role

Almost every company now runs on Microsoft 365, and almost nobody has it fully under control. Work has to be moved into it and around it, through mergers, acquisitions and reorganizations that touch millions of files and can't afford to lose a single one. And once it's there it sprawls faster than anyone can track, with people sharing things they shouldn't and no clear view of what's actually going on. ShareGate is what IT professionals use to do both jobs. Taking something this complex and this consequential and making it feel simple and trustworthy is what we're here to do.

Your impact:

  • Own a whole product area end-to-end, from framing the problem with your team to shipping the solution customers actually use, and monitoring for learnings after.
  • Design AI-first flows where the product does the real work for customers while they stay fully in control.
  • Turn genuinely complicated situations into something a busy person can understand at a glance and feel confident acting on.
  • Put bold bets in front of real customers early, measure what happens, and let the result change the plan, including when it proves you wrong.
  • Bring AI into your own way of working so you can go from a question to something real and testable in days, and put it in front of customers while it's still rough.
  • Raise the bar for everyone around you through critique, through the standards you hold, and by making your thinking clear enough that the team can carry a decision without you in the room.

Your team

You'll join our design team at ShareGate and partner with a product lead and an engineering lead on every project you own, from first idea to launch. We're hiring across two sides of the product right now: one focused on moving companies into and around Microsoft 365, one focused on keeping it secure and organized once they're there. Both are big, high-stakes problems, and we'll work out together which one fits you best.

We're builders. We care a lot about craft and taste, we expect people to own their work rather than wait to be handed it, and we'd rather take a big swing on what's genuinely best for customers than ship the safe version. AI is part of how we work every day; it helps us move faster and try more ideas, not think less. Work gets shared early and often, feedback is direct, and decisions get made quickly and revisited just as quickly when we learn something new.

The people we design for run IT at their companies. They're experts who get the call when something breaks. Our job is to earn their trust and make complex, high-stakes workflows feel simple.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years designing complex software for businesses, with shipped work you owned from the first question to the last detail;
  • A systems mind: you design the whole journey and think about what happens next, not one screen at a time;
  • The judgment to make design decisions that are hard to take back: what people see first, what they confirm, what they can reverse;
  • A weekly habit of talking to real customers, and the discipline to let what they actually do change your direction;
  • Design rationale you can defend out loud to designers, engineers, and executives alike: the problem, the options you turned down, the trade-off you made;
  • Real fluency using AI in your own workflow, with the judgment to know where it helps and where it gets in the way;
  • The drive to take your work the last mile yourself: refining and polishing in the real product and pushing those changes straight to production;
  • Comfort working without a clear brief: you name the assumption, pick a direction, and learn in the open;
  • Bonus: experience designing for IT, security, data or any audience where the user is an expert and a wrong move is expensive.

Most of this sounds like you? Apply.

What the job comes with

  • Base salary: $125 000 - $160 000. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
  • Annual bonus program.
  • LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
  • RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
  • Flexible vacation policy.
  • Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
  • In-person gatherings twice a year.
  • Claude access, for everyone.

What drives us

At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.

We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.

If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.

How we hire

Transparency is how we hire — for you as much as for us.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call.

We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human.

We can't wait to meet you.

By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy.

Here's how it works: a first call with a recruiter, then a virtual interview with the hiring manager. You'll then complete a take-home case study, followed by a meet with future colleagues to discuss it together. Depending on the role, the process may vary slightly — your recruiter will walk you through it on your first call. We use AI to support certain steps of the process, but every hiring decision remains human. We can't wait to meet you. By applying, you confirm that you have read and agree to our privacy policy . #LI-Remote

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About The Opportunity

OKX is looking for a Senior AI Creative Innovator(Paid Ads) to develop AIGC video and AI-animated assets for paid ads to drive OKX’s global market growth and product launches.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Concept and execute high-impact creatives for ads growth and marketing, from initial brief through final asset delivery

  • Use AI to accelerate every phase of the design process: ideation, moodboarding, asset variation, copy iteration, and production polish.

  • Sort out AIGC prompts and internal visual resource library to improve design efficiency.

title: Senior Product Designer
original_description:
Kinsta is one of the top providers of managed hosting for WordPress, with a growing club of 120,000+ businesses including startups, universities, and Fortune 500 firms. We're motivated by excellent quality and proud to have received a 97% satisfaction rating from our customers.

That's because, to us, each day is a chance to grow. As a team, we continuously inspire each other to learn new and better ways to make an impact. We own our jobs proudly - our leaders don't hold our hands, but they're in our corner whenever we ask for help - and our environment is flexible and remote-first.

As our new Senior Product Designer, you'll lead and execute product initiatives from concept to UI, bringing a user-focused mentality to everything you ship. You'll join a small, close-knit Product Design team, report to the Head of Product, partner day to day with Research, Product Management, and Development, and work with other teams as collaborators and stakeholders. It's a hands-on senior design role with the opportunity to grow into leading the PD team as it scales, while staying close to the design work

Your primary canvas is MyKinsta, the dashboard where our customers manage their sites, but your scope also extends to the service layer to cover the full user experience of Kinsta. This means a design output can include internal workflows, customer communication, or additional tooling.

You'll work with a high level of autonomy while you design features, manage stakeholders, provide UX guidance, and occasionally step in to own a project through delivery. The ideal Kinsta Senior Product Designer is a strong craftsperson, a confident decision-maker, curious, collaborative, and self-motivated.

What You'll Do:

  • Own design projects end to end (concept, scoping, user flows, UI, release, and follow-up), at any scale, from small improvements to strategic new capabilities.

  • Drive discovery: define what to build to address real problems and user needs, and study competitors and best practices.

  • Work closely with Research, Product Management, and Development: request and apply insights, align on business requirements, and validate technical feasibility.

  • Write clear specifications so design intent is unambiguous, and run design QA against both the intent and the Kinsta Design System.

  • Give clear rationale for your decisions, resolve design and product deadlocks, escalate when you need feedback or mediation, and communicate trade-offs when priorities compete.

  • Serve as Project Owner on occasion. We don't have full-time delivery managers, so one team member leads each project as its Owner during delivery, communicating progress and coordinating releases.

  • Be a product expert: know how our product works, the personas and use cases we support, and how that translates into UI-level design solutions.

  • Represent the craft: uphold professional standards in design thinking, problem solving, usability, UX, and UI; give and receive design critique; and help maintain and evolve the Kinsta Design System.

What You Bring To The Role:

  • A minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience as a Product or UX Designer.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping products and features from zero to production, with the ability to carry a project fully autonomously.

  • Experience working in a SaaS environment, on a highly technical product, in cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on experience across the full design workflow: research, problem definition, ideation and facilitation, creating UI, and partnering in delivery.

  • Expert-level proficiency with Figma.

  • Experience working with and maintaining a design system.

  • A portfolio with at least one case study taking a project from a problem statement to a delivered solution. We want to see your process and how you arrived at decisions, not only screens and a general workflow description.

  • A good understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, JS). You don't need to write production code, but you should have a working sense of feasibility and be comfortable poking at things in an Inspector.

  • Proactivity: you take the initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Professional-level English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience working on a hosting or web infrastructure product.

  • Experience with technical products where the audience is developers or technology-oriented users.

  • Experience with the WordPress ecosystem.

  • Experience mentoring or leading other designers.

Benefits:

  • Annual remote expense budget.

  • Flexible PTO.

  • Paid parental leave.

  • Annual professional development budget: available after one year with Kinsta.

  • Sabbatical: available after three years with Kinsta (and every three years thereafter).

  • Location-specific healthcare benefits (includes vision and dental) for employees hired in the USA, UK, Canada, and Hungary.

  • Pension plan for employees hired in the UK, and 401k contributions for employees hired in the USA.

Compensation

Additional Information

Kinsta is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate and we will take actions to ensure against discrimination in employment, recruitment, advertisements for employment, compensation, termination, promotions, and other conditions of employment against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, religion, creed, disability, marital status, veteran’s status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

By applying to one of our positions, you agree to the processing of the submitted personal data in accordance with Kinsta's Privacy Policy, including the transfer of your data to the United States.

#LI-Remote, #IHSRemote

title: Staff Product Designer (Contract)
original_description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Staff Product Designer to serve as Flex's highest-caliber individual design contributor. In this role, you will set the bar for craft and quality across our entire product portfolio - not by managing designers, but by doing the work at a level others aspire to. You will drive design vision and strategy for the most complex, highest-impact initiatives at Flex, shaping how we build for our users and how the design function operates.

Vision and Strategy

  • Define and articulate design vision for Flex's most critical and complex product initiatives, ensuring work aligns with business goals and resonates deeply with our users
  • Establish a north star for the consumer experience and drive cross-functional alignment around it
  • Influence product strategy and roadmap directly through the quality and clarity of your design work and perspective
  • Stay close to how the design industry and UX trends are evolving and bring those insights into Flex

Quality and Craft

  • Own the design process end-to-end on flagship initiatives, from research and ideation through refinement, prototyping, and final execution
  • Hold a high bar for craft across everything you touch, from individual interaction patterns to our design system
  • Build detailed prototypes that illuminate the future of the product and help teams make better decisions
  • Use AI across the design lifecycle for, rapid exploration, prototyping, and front-end workflows, and model how the team can do the same

Influence and Collaboration

  • Partner with design leadership, product, and engineering to shape the direction of complex, cross-cutting product areas
  • Collaborate with other designers to ensure alignment and consistency across the consumer experience
  • Advocate for design thinking and user-centered principles across the company at every level, up to and including executive leadership

Standards and Mentorship

  • Establish and evolve design standards, processes, and patterns that raise the quality floor for the entire organization
  • Provide mentorship and craft feedback to designers across the team
  • Contribute foundational elements and set the standard for how the design system should evolve

Key Qualifications

  • Experience: A demonstrated track record as a senior IC contributor on complex consumer products
  • Design Mastery: Deep expertise in UX/UI design with strong experience showcasing shipped work at significant scope and quality
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability and demonstrated experience to operate at the product strategy level, shaping direction through design
  • Craft: Exceptional execution skills with high attention to detail in interaction design, visual design, and prototyping
  • Collaboration: Excellent communication skills; able to work fluidly with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, marketing, and executive leadership
  • Tools and Tech: Proficiency in modern design tooling; and fluency with front-end development
  • AI Fluency: Comfort using AI tools across the design process for research, exploration, prototyping, and workflow improvement
  • Passion: Genuine interest in financial products and improving people's financial lives

Compensation

This is a contract position with an hourly rate of $125–$200 per hour, commensurate with experience and our internal leveling guidelines. Flex takes a market-based approach to pay and utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index; if you are located outside of our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) markets, your rate will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. There is potential for this engagement to convert to a full-time role, in which case compensation would be aligned to the full-time salary range and benefits for the level.

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

For full-time U.S. employees we offer:

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision
  • Company equity
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Unlimited paid time off + 13 company paid holidays
  • Parental leave
  • Free Flex subscription

For full-time non-U.S. employees, we offer:

  • Competitive compensation + company equity
  • Unlimited PTO

title: Video Editor
original_description:
Kalshi is defining a new category

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history. Kalshi is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.
  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Building a new category is hard… like really hard. But it’s beautiful and deeply fulfilling. Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

We are looking for a Video Editor who is passionate about creating viral social media content, including TikTok and other user-generated content. We have a massive nationwide campaign coming up that will involve hundreds of videos being created. This role will be crucial to the success of the campaign.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Edit and produce high-quality, engaging social media videos, including UGC TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Collaborate with our creative and social teams to ideate, plan, and execute video content that will go viral.
  • Transform raw footage into polished, short-form video content that’s optimized for social media.
  • Stay up-to-date with social media video trends, techniques, and best practices to ensure content resonates with our audience.
  • Ability to film or capture content is a plus—helping guide shoots or even capturing footage on occasion.

Who You Are:

You love making super high quality engaging videos and have made many viral videos yourself. You thrive in fast-paced environments and are obsessed with crafting content that engages and excites audiences.

Some basic requirements:

  • Experience making videos that have gone viral.
  • 2+ years of experience in video editing, specifically for social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
  • Proven ability to create highly engaging and viral content.
  • A creative mindset with a keen understanding of storytelling, pacing, and the latest video trends.
  • Experience in editing short-form, fast-paced videos for social media audiences.
  • Experience with sound editing, color correction, and motion graphics is a plus.
  • Bonus: Experience in filming content or directing video shoots.

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $70,000 to $150,000 annually plus equity and benefits.

This salary range is based on the current available market data and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but a broad range of experience is represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to discuss further.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer (Web)
original_description:
We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talented team.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Web team, dedicated to crafting exceptional digital experiences for a global audience. In this role, you’ll take ownership of Capital.com’s web presence — from marketing pages and landing experiences to product-facing web interfaces — working closely with brand, engineering, and product teams to bring compelling designs to life.

Responsibilities:

  • Create visually compelling, high-quality web experiences that reflect our brand and engage our global audience.
  • Own the design of marketing pages, landing pages, and web product interfaces end-to-end.
  • Be the voice of the user, embedding their needs into every design decision with insights and research.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, and brand stakeholders to transform ideas into reality.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to test and illustrate design concepts.
  • Define and maintain design guidelines, bringing consistency across all web touchpoints.
  • Lead design initiatives with balance and clarity, adapting to timelines while juggling multiple priorities.
  • Design user journeys that turn complex tasks into simple, delightful experiences.
  • Improve web performance post-launch, focusing on continuous, user-centered enhancements.
  • Collaborate with the Design System team to ensure consistency across all web surfaces.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience designing web products and digital experiences.
  • A portfolio showcasing strong web design work — marketing pages, landing experiences, or product web interfaces.
  • Proficiency in Figma and strong knowledge of components and design systems.
  • Experience with modern web design tools such as Framer or Webflow is a plus.
  • Strong visual design sense with an eye for typography, layout, and motion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Skilled at understanding the technical impact of design choices for web.
  • Self-directed, with the ability to take ownership of the design process.
  • Strong UX focus and a deep understanding of human behavior.
  • A continuous learner, eager to grow both personally and with the team.
  • Proactive, confident, and effective communicator — able to present work and articulate design decisions clearly to a range of stakeholders.

What you will get in return:

  • Competitive Salary: We believe great work deserves great pay! Your skills and talents will be rewarded with a salary that makes you feel valued and motivated.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Join a company that genuinely cares about you—because your life outside of work matters just as much as your time on the clock. #LI-Hybrid
  • Annual Performance Bonus: Your hard work doesn’t go unnoticed! Celebrate your achievements with a well-deserved annual bonus tied to your performance.
  • Generous Time Off: Need a breather? Our annual leave policy lets you recharge and enjoy life outside of work without a worry.
  • Employee Referral Program: Love working here? Share the love! Bring your talented friends on board and get rewarded for growing our awesome team.
  • Comprehensive Health & Pension Benefits: From medical insurance to pension plans, we’ve got your back. Plus, location-specific benefits and perks!
  • Workation Wonderland: Live your digital nomad dreams with 30 extra days to work remotely from anywhere in the world (some restrictions apply). Adventure awaits!
  • Volunteer Days: Make a difference! Take two additional paid days each year to support causes you care about and give back to the community.

Compensation

Additional Information

Be a key player at the forefront of the digital assets movement, propelling your career to new heights! Join a dynamic and rapidly expanding company that values and rewards talent, initiative, and creativity. Work alongside one of the most brilliant teams in the industry.

title: UI Artist
original_description:
Moon Active is one of the world's fastest-growing mobile game companies, providing entertainment to millions of active users across the universe.

We're looking for a UI Artist star for its top-notch, industry-leading product.

As a Monetization Artist, you will be responsible for user experience, visual design concepts and game user interface across digital products and platforms. As part of our dream team, you will receive everything you can think of from super friendly and creative co-workers and a strong focus on your development.

Required time zone CET +/- 3 hour.

Requirements

  • Create a playful, intuitive cohesive look & feel, and overall mobile game user experience.

  • Conceptualize, present and execute your ideas from A to Z.

  • Work collaboratively with other designers and cross-functionally with UX, engineering, and product management on the design and implementation of new game features.

  • Create and own the implementation of fun, engaging in-game events and other game content.

  • Design and deliver UI for in-game offers, promotional screens, and purchase flows (offer popups, sale banners, seasonal promotions).

  • Own the visual pipeline from brief to implementation, including asset handoff.

  • Maintain and evolve the UI component library and style guides to ensure consistency across features.

  • Rapidly iterate on A/B test variants - create multiple visual treatments and adapt based on performance data.

  • Collaborate closely with the monetization team on conversion-driven design decisions.

  • Participate in design reviews and contribute constructive feedback to peers.

Responsibilities

  • At least 3 years of experience in game UI and understanding of game UI principles.

  • Hands-on experience designing monetization UI (offer screens, shop flows, promotional screens) - a strong advantage.

  • Familiarity with mobile game design patterns (LiveOps events, popups, progression screens).

  • Ability to work in a dynamic environment with quick decision-making within tight schedules.

  • Proficiency in Photoshop, Figma, AI creative tools.

  • Strong design, drawing, color, composition, and conceptual ideation abilities.

  • Comfort with data-informed iteration - ability to create variants and adjust based on A/B results.

  • Understanding of asset production constraints (texture atlases, file sizes, animation-ready layers).

  • Fluent English.

#LI-Remote

title: Sr. Motion Designer
original_description:
AI at Zapier

At Zapier, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: October 2026

Location: EMEA

We're looking for a Motion Designer to join Brand Studio, the creative team behind how Zapier shows up in the world. Brand Studio is a small, high-ownership team embedded in Marketing, working at the intersection of brand, product, and enterprise positioning. We care deeply about craft, think strategically about systems, and move fast when the moment calls for it.

In this role you'll work closely with a team of brand designers and design ops, collaborate cross-functionally with PMM, Product Design, Web, and Social, and partner with external agencies on bigger productions. You'll help define how Zapier moves across every surface, and build the systems and tooling that let the whole org ship motion work independently without Brand Studio in the room every time.If you want to advance your career at a fast-growing, profitable, impact-driven company, read on…

  • Our Commitment to Applicants

  • Culture and Values at Zapier

  • Zapier Guide to Remote Work

  • Zapier Code of Conduct

  • Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier

About You

  • You can take a UI frame or a brand brief and turn it into a story that lands. You ask the right questions, understand the product well enough to know what the animation needs to communicate, and don't wait for a fully baked storyboard to get started

  • You think in systems. You build mogrts files, component libraries, and motion guidelines that other people can use independently, and every project is an opportunity to make the next one ship faster

  • You understand brand as well as UI: timing, easing, personality, the emotional register that makes motion feel ownable rather than generic

  • You have a strong sense of sound and rhythm. You know how motion and sound work together, and you shape that relationship intentionally rather than as an afterthought

  • You understand narrative. You think about motion the way a director thinks about a scene: setup, tension, resolution. You know when to breathe and when to accelerate, and you can articulate that thinking to stakeholders

  • You manage up with creative insight, bringing your expertise into conversations proactively so stakeholders understand the why behind every creative choice

  • You use AI as a genuine part of your practice, experimenting with video tools and sharing what you figure out so the whole team benefits

  • You're energized by ambiguity, move fast, and don't wait for perfect conditions

Things You’ll Do:

  • Design and produce motion across product explainers, website animations, paid social video snippets, keynote and event motion, and campaign assets

  • Draft simple storyboards yourself for straightforward projects so we can move fast without a separate brief-to-board cycle

  • Work directly from UI frames provided by the product team to build polished product demo animations and feature explainers

  • Build Zapier's motion design language: ownable branded motion patterns that establish how Zapier feels in motion across every surface

  • Create motion guidelines, component libraries, and mogrts files that give partners and social teams repeatable building blocks to work from independently

  • Explore tools like Jitter and Figma Motion to enable partners to generate on-brand animated assets without Brand Studio involvement every time

  • Produce short video snippets for paid social testing across multiple angles and formats

  • Support the recurring product video format and turn it into a scalable template for future launches

How to Apply

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

Application Deadline:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Product Design Manager
original_description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Design leadership to match.

Our users are maintenance technicians, reliability engineers, and operations managers working on factory floors, in processing plants, and across distributed facilities. We're looking for a Product Design Manager to lead a team of product designers who make these complex, high-stakes workflows simple, intuitive, and increasingly AI-powered. You'll set creative direction across your team's product areas, grow designers at different stages of their careers, and partner deeply with Product and Engineering to ensure design is shaping outcomes, not just shipping screens. In this role, you'll be close to the work, close to the people, and accountable for both.

What You'll Do

  • Own design quality across your team's product areas for web and mobile. Guide designers through ambiguity, review work with a sharp eye, and ensure what ships is grounded in real user needs and built to a high standard.

  • Lead and grow a team of 4-6 product designers. Run 1:1s, drive career growth, deliver clear feedback, and build a team culture where people do their best work. You'll be responsible for hiring, performance, and developing the next generation of design talent at MaintainX.

  • Translate product strategy into focused design execution. Help your team understand not just what they're building, but why it matters. Set a clear, directional vision for your team's focus, rooted in customer understanding and business context.

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and Engineering leads. Align on priorities, unblock delivery, and advocate for design quality and user needs in every conversation.

  • Raise the craft bar. Contribute to design critiques, invest in our design system, and ensure consistency and coherence across the experiences your team touches.

  • Lead your team in adopting AI tools and practices to accelerate design work and push the quality and speed of your team's output.

About You

  • 6+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms. You've shipped complex, multi-surface work and you know what good looks like because you've done it yourself.

  • 1–3 years of experience managing product designers. Running 1:1s, giving feedback that changes the work, navigating performance conversations, and helping people grow. You chose management because you're energized by making others better.

  • Strong product thinking and craft judgment. You understand customer problems, business tradeoffs, and how to connect design work to strategy. You don't simplify by removing; you simplify by clarifying.

  • You build trust through how you show up. Consistent, direct, and accountable. You create clarity for your team, resolve friction with partners early, and lead with enough confidence to make decisions and enough humility to change your mind.

  • You care about AI-powered product experiences, both in how your team designs for AI-first workflows and in how they use AI tools to push the quality and speed of their own work.

  • An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to lead platform engineering managers across multiple teams, present technical priorities to executive stakeholders, and align with engineering leaders outside Québec on a daily basis.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontline, mobile-first, or offline-capable product design

  • Background in industrial, operations, or maintenance-adjacent domains

  • Experience contributing to or scaling a design system

  • Familiarity with designing for AI-powered workflows and data-rich interfaces

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Digital Designer
original_description:
Digital Designer

PH location / Remote first

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business We make eco-friendly products and donate 50% of our profits to provide clean water and help build toilets for the billions of people who lack proper access. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role We are looking for a creative and collaborative Digital Designer to join our Digital Product team! In this role, your goal is simple: help us design the digital experiences that turn curious consumers into loyal subscribers.

Working closely with our eCommerce Specialist, Growth Marketing, and Creative partners, you will take our brand campaigns and translate them into engaging on-site experiences. You’ll work closely with our Product Designer on the storefront, with a focus on visual craft, brand expression, and keeping the storefront looking fresh and commercially effective.

We are also excited for this person to embrace AI. You'll use AI tools to speed up your day-to-day workflow—handling routine formatting and generating assets so you have more time to spend on the actual creative craft that AI can't replicate.

If you worked here this past month, here are some things you might have been involved in:

  • Helping design a site takeover for a new product launch (like adding a cameo from “Clammy” as a temporary avatar during our Splash Limited Edition).
  • Using AI tools to generate draft assets and format standard banners, saving yourself hours of manual resizing.
  • Collaborating with Growth Marketing to iterate on landing pages, making sure the design connects the ad content smoothly to the shop experience.
  • Partnering with the Product Designer to ensure your campaign placements fit nicely within the everyday storefront.
  • Updating standard campaign placements (banners, hero treatments, product callouts) to keep the site looking unmistakably Who Gives A Crap.
  • Sprinkling digital easter eggs across the site that reward curiosity (like hiding toilets across the site for a "Where's the Loo" Limited Edition campaign).

Let’s talk about you
You are a solid visual designer who understands that great digital design isn't just about looking good—it's about helping the customer find what they need. You have a great eye for typography and composition, and you're eager to learn how your designs impact metrics like conversion.

Here’s what we're hoping you'll bring to the table:

  • Visual Craft: You have a strong portfolio of digital work. You know how to take a campaign brief and apply it to digital surfaces while keeping the brand feeling consistent and high-quality.
  • Curiosity around AI: You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools to speed up your production work, but you know that the final brand finish and quality control always stay with you.
  • Commercial Interest: You want to know why a design works. You're curious about how campaigns perform on site and are open to using customer insights to tweak your designs.
  • A Collaborative Mindset: You are a great team player. You listen well, adapt your communication style depending on who you are working with (marketing, engineering, etc.), and take constructive feedback in stride.
  • Time Management: You know how to juggle multiple tasks. Campaign work moves fast, so you are good at prioritizing your time, keeping the team updated on your progress, and flagging when you need help.

You give a crap
Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?
First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the highest standards of social and environmental impact. With our most recent score of 125.5 we’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world. We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right). Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (95%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?
If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

title: Analyst II, Full Stack (Revenue Analytics)
original_description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Analyst at Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement.
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

What you'll do

  • Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts

  • Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting

  • Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions

  • Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products

  • Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows)

  • Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue.

What we look for

  • 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role

  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake)

  • Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality

  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business

  • Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products

  • Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution

  • Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Compensation and Benefits

Base Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 3

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this role, but do require that someone is based in Spain for the role.

ESP base pay range per year: 63,000 - 99,000 EUR

Additional benefits include:

  • Type of employment: Contract of Employment
  • Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
  • Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Parental benefits
  • Employee Resource & Community Groups

This role is eligible for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law and company policy

Location - Remote Spain

The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Spain.

**This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.**

#LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Senior Product Designer, AI
original_description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

We're growing fast and hiring the Design talent to match.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who combines exceptional craft with deep product thinking to shape MaintainX’s AI-first product experience. You’ll lead end-to-end design across web and mobile, partnering with Product Managers, Engineers, and designers to turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive tools for frontline workers.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end design for AI-powered product surfaces across web and mobile — from problem framing through high-fidelity delivery.

  • Design AI-powered experiences for frontline users like maintenance technicians and facility managers, making workflows simpler and smarter without adding complexity.

  • Translate ambiguous, fast-moving AI problem spaces into clear, testable design solutions in close partnership with product and engineering.

  • Think in systems: spot patterns, build for reuse, and contribute to our design system with a focus on consistency, scalability, and high craft.

  • Present design work with clear rationale, integrate feedback from stakeholders, and champion high quality across the product lifecycle.

  • Use AI tools in your own design process to accelerate your work and push the quality ceiling of your output.

    About You

  • 6+ years of product design experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise platforms.

  • Hands-on experience designing AI-powered features such as natural language interfaces, agents, and predictive insights for real users solving real problems.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills with a sharp eye for typography, spacing, color, layout, and motion.

  • A systems thinker who naturally spots patterns, builds for reuse, and considers how design decisions scale across a product.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills to articulate design intent, navigate ambiguous product spaces, and influence cross-functional peers.

  • An expert level of English, both spoken and written, is required, as the individual will need to work across multiple teams and present work to executive stakeholders.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

title: Senior Product Designer
original_description:
We are a leading trading platform that is ambitiously expanding to the four corners of the globe. Our top-rated products have won prestigious industry awards for their cutting-edge technology and seamless client experience. We deliver only the best, so we are always in search of the best people to join our ever-growing talented team.

We’re seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our team, dedicated to building intuitive and impactful financial products for a global audience. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with a talented design team to address customer needs, elevate design standards, and ensure a seamless user experience. Using data-driven insights alongside your skills in design, research, and prototyping, you’ll develop user-friendly solutions for complex challenges. If you’re eager to bring compelling designs to life and create exceptional digital experiences, we’d love to meet you.

Responsibilities:

  • Create intuitive, visually appealing interfaces that enhance user engagement.
  • Be the voice of the user, embedding their needs into every design decision with insights and research.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product, engineering, and stakeholders to transform ideas into reality.
  • Collaborate with researchers to uncover actionable feedback, guiding meaningful usability improvements.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to test and illustrate design concepts.
  • Define and maintain design guidelines, bringing consistency across all products.
  • Lead design initiatives with balance and clarity, adapting to timelines while juggling multiple priorities.
  • Design user journeys that turn complex tasks into simple, delightful journeys.
  • Improve product performance post-launch, focusing on continuous, user-centered enhancements.
  • Help maintain, evolve and improve the design system, as well as using it as a toolkit to ensure consistency.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience designing complex commercial apps;
  • A portfolio showcasing strong design work;
  • Experience in SaaS products;

title: Digital Experience Specialist - Canada
original_description:
Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

This is a remote, full-time position, and is open to candidates across Canada.

We’re seeking a detail-oriented, strategic, and creative Digital Experience Specialist to join our UX & Brand Experience team. This is a keystone role focused on helping clients create goal-driven, user-centric websites that align with brand identity and drive measurable results.

You’ll be instrumental in guiding website redesign projects—from research and analysis through to content structuring, page building, and testing. You’ll also contribute to broader UX, market research, and brand consultancy initiatives, playing a key role in delivering polished, high-impact client work.

Key Responsibilities - Website Redesign & Optimization:

  • Analyze website performance metrics to inform strategic recommendations
  • Lead content audits and create Keep-Update-Delete reports
  • Develop intuitive navigation structures and information architecture
  • Design and build website content using platforms such as WordPress (Elementor), HubSpot, Webflow, and others.
  • Provide UX and CRO-focused feedback on wireframes and visual designs
  • Ensure alignment with client brand messaging and visual identity
  • Co-lead the project delivery process alongside a Project Manager
  • Contribute to user journey mapping and documentation
  • Conduct quality assurance (QA) reviews of built pages to ensure content accuracy, design consistency, and functional integrity across devices and browsers
  • Propose and implement A/B and multivariate tests to support continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities - Brand and UX Consultancy:

  • Conduct qualitative research, including stakeholder interviews and persona development
  • Conduct information architecture (IA) and UX audits, including heuristic evaluations and gap analysis
  • Support brand messaging strategy and product positioning
  • Collaborate on naming, copy tone, and style guidance deliverables
  • Analyze digital properties such as YouTube channels for branding, UX, and conversion opportunities

Essential Functions & Success Factors:

  • Deliver high-quality, on-spec work within established deadlines
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with internal teams and client stakeholders
  • Collaborate across departments including design, development, content, and SEO
  • Track project progress in internal project management tools
  • Review and edit deliverables from colleagues as part of peer-review workflows
  • Maintain alignment with client goals and internal quality standards
  • Assist with formatting, information synthesis, and reporting as needed

Additionally, this role may work toward:

  • Exploring and developing new service offerings, with the support of managers and senior colleagues.
  • Working to understand and gain insights into industry trends and standards around data analysis and reporting, lead generation, design best practice and content marketing in general.
  • Collaborating with senior members of staff to develop strong in-house knowledge stores, policies and processes.
  • Working closely with Brafton's development team, CMS, production teams and other departments, as is helpful, toward the timely and successful completion of these tasks.

Growth & Development Opportunities:

  • Contribute to the evolution of service offerings and internal processes
  • Stay current with industry trends in UX, data analysis, and content strategy
  • Help build knowledge libraries, templates, and best practice documentation

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in UX, web design, digital strategy, or content marketing
  • Excellent communication skills—written, verbal, and visual
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets (e.g., Google Sheets, Excel)
  • Working knowledge of UX, CRO, and content best practices
  • Comfortable with CMS platforms like WordPress, Webflow, and HubSpot
  • Experience with visual page builders (e.g., Elementor, Webflow) is a strong plus
  • Fluency in CSS is highly desirable
  • Understanding of the modern digital marketing landscape

Time Allocation:

  • 70% Independent Contributor Work
  • 20% Internal or Client Communications
  • 10% Miscellaneous Tasks

Additional Requirements:

  • Access to reliable, professional-grade hardware and a stable internet connection
  • Comfort working in a fully remote, deadline-driven environment
  • Willingness to collaborate across time zones when needed

Compensation

Additional Information

Ready to help shape the digital experiences of tomorrow? Apply now and join a team where strategy meets storytelling.

Benefits Include: Commission on top of salary, Health Savings Account, pension, paid vacation, flexible remote schedule, and more!

title: Chief Technology Officer
original_description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering

  • Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.
  • Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.
  • Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.
  • Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability

  • Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.
  • Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.
  • Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution

  • Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.
  • Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.
  • Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.
  • Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.
  • Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.
  • Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.
  • Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.
  • Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.
  • Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.
  • Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.
  • Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.
  • You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.
  • Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.
  • Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.
  • Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.
  • Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Content Designer | LATAM
original_description:
Location: Remote – Central or South America (Open to applicants anywhere in Central or South America)

Fueled is a leading digital strategy, design, and engineering agency. We are a 300+ person team that has designed and built hundreds of digital products and experiences for brands like Google, Apple, The New York Times, ESPN, Victoria’s Secret, MGM Resorts, Albertsons, and CLEAR.

As a Senior Content Designer at Fueled, you’ll bring clarity to complex product experiences through thoughtful, strategic content design. You’ll partner closely with design, product, and engineering teams to shape content systems that scale by moving beyond copy to define structure, meaning, and user understanding across digital products.

Intentionally remote, our team thrives in a culture that values flexibility, creativity, and cutting-edge technology. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital experiences.

What you will do:

  • Lead content design across client engagements, shaping clear, user-centered experiences through content strategy, UX writing, and information architecture.
  • Translate ambiguous product and business goals into structured content models, messaging frameworks, and scalable content systems.
  • Write and adapt content to meet client needs, balancing brand voice, user experience, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with product designers, engineers, and stakeholders to integrate content seamlessly into the product development process.
