title: Senior Brand Designer, Experiential
original_description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Senior Brand Designer, Experiential

You’ll shape how Synthesia shows up in experiential moments around the world — from global events and physical environments to the digital experiences that surround them.

Located EMEA Remote/London: Ideally London. Otherwise Europe (hub-based preferred).

Reporting to @Antonia Delnevo , Head of Brand Design

Working in the Brand Design team (team of seven incredible brand and motion designers) in strong collaboration with @Adela Posse

✈️ Travel: Required across Europe + US, potential APAC in future.

Design at Synthesia

Design at Synthesia exists to clarify, build trust, and make the work memorable. We care about fundamentals (typography, layout, systems thinking) and default to simple, clear communication.

We run with low process and high ownership. Designers are trusted to lead end-to-end, collaborate closely with partners, and ship work that holds up outside of Figma.

For Experiential, that means strong concepts and production discipline: systems, specs, file hygiene, and a high bar for what shows up on-site.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate and expand Synthesia’s brand into physical and experiential environments globally

  • Evolve the visual design of our event presence — across trade shows, conferences, and owned customer events

  • Design booths, spatial environments, signage systems, print assets, and merchandise from design to production

  • Develop cohesive event identities across physical and digital touchpoints (presentations, environments, social media posts, events web)

  • Design for digital experiential moments (webinars, virtual events, launches)

  • Storyboard and design motion and screen-based content for events and keynotes

  • Partner closely with Field Marketing and cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life and raise the bar on how we show up

  • Provide art direction and guidance to external vendors, agencies, and fabricators

  • Own production quality: manage print setup, supplier-ready files, and on-site execution standards

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in brand design, visual design, or experiential design, with strong hands-on events experience

  • Multidisciplinary designer with a wide skill set and comfortable working across different mediums and crafts; excited about experimenting with new technologies

  • Proven experience designing physical environments and real-world brand experiences

    Strong visual craft across typography, layout, and physical-to-digital brand translation

  • Deep knowledge of print production and large-format design (this is a must)

  • Fluent in Figma, with the ability to translate work into production-ready files in Adobe Illustrator

  • Experience working across multiple mediums: physical, digital, and motion

  • A strong sense of ownership — comfortable leading projects end-to-end in a low-process environment

  • A proactive, organised, and ownership-driven mindset — you’re comfortable working autonomously in a small senior team

  • A producer mindset: able to balance creative ambition with feasibility, timelines, and budgets

  • Comfortable collaborating with and directing external partners, vendors, and agencies

  • Strong communication skills and confidence presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders

  • Systems thinker, able to create scalable approaches for global execution

  • Comfortable working across different types of projects while keeping experiential as a core focus

  • Experience in B2B or tech environments

Nice to Have

  • Experience incorporating AI tools into your workflow to accelerate ideation, iteration, or content creation

  • Experience in building websites in no-code tools such us Framer/Splash

  • Basic 3D modular design

  • Industrial design knowledge

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
original_description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:

  • Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
  • Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
  • Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
  • Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will leverage our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.

Learn more in our press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

What You'll Do

Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:

Vocal Synthesis — Research in vocal and speech synthesis, along with related areas such as ML-based audio processing and signal processing.

Post-Training — Research in post-training techniques for music generation, including preference alignment methods (such as DPO, RLHF, or KTO), reward model design and training, and reinforcement learning to improve output quality, controllability, and human preference adherence.

Editing — Research in iterative music generation and audio editing, including capabilities such as stem replacement, instrumentation change, mood changes (while preserving content), tempo changes, and structure changes.

You will also:

  • Run large-scale experiments with access to Spotify's extensive infrastructure and an audience of more than 700 million monthly active users.
  • Create practical applications that harness generative technologies and push the boundaries of what's possible in listening experiences.
  • Collaborate as part of a cross-functional team—working closely with scientists, engineers, product managers, designers, user researchers, and analysts—to craft innovative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Have a direct impact on Spotify's products, tools, and services, working on projects that influence the entire organization.
  • Engage with the broader research community by publishing your findings, delivering talks, and attending top conferences.

Who You Are

  • You have a Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field. Previous industry experience is helpful.
  • You have experience in one or more of the following fields: generative modeling, machine learning, music information retrieval, speech processing, audio processing, signal processing, probabilistic modeling, computer vision, or related areas.
  • You have deep expertise in at least one of the focus areas above—whether that's vocal/speech synthesis, post-training alignment techniques (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DPO), or audio-to-audio generation and text-guided music editing.
  • You have publications at leading conferences such as ICASSP, ISMIR, INTERSPEECH, ICLR, AAAI, IJCAI, NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ICCV, or related venues.
  • You have strong coding skills in Python, PyTorch, and NumPy.
  • You are a creative problem solver who is passionate about building outstanding products that add real value to millions of people.
  • You are enthusiastic about turning research ideas into products operating at scale.
  • You can explain complex topics in simple terms, and you enjoy building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Where You'll Be

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location
  • This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zone for collaboration.
  • Core working hours are CET 3pm-6pm / EST 9am-12pm.

Compensation

Additional Information

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

title: Marketing Designer
original_description:
About the Role

Playson is a leading online gaming supplier with worldwide recognition which was founded in 2012. We offer complete gaming solutions based on the latest technologies and detailed market analysis for the leading iGaming operators.

We’re looking for a Marketing Graphic Designer to help shape the way we promote our games and present our brand to partners. This role sits within the Marketing Squad and has direct impact on how Playson is seen across channels.

To further strengthen our creative function, we are looking for a Senior Marketing Designer - a mature and structured professional who will drive the development of our marketing visuals and support the growth of the Graphic Artist stream.

Key Responsibilities

  • Creating sets of promo materials for partners when launching new iGaming products and/or Network Promotions (game icons packs, resizes, promo banners, etc.)

  • Developing custom promo materials for key partners

  • Creating key visuals for communication campaigns, as well as artwork for various communication channels (web, social media, print ads, email campaigns, etc.)

  • Creating designs for branded merchandise

  • Creating designs for point of sale materials

  • Creating mockups and designs for exhibitions and company’s own events (branded decor, photo zones, etc.)

  • Designing landing pages for brand’s promo activities

  • Creating sales decks for company products

  • Producing small video clips or animated graphics for social media, as well as standard motion elements for video contractors

  • Further development of company brand book

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Marketing, UI/UX Designer

  • Experience working with brand identity (logos, branding, templates), banner ads, animated banners, landing pages, and storyboards for video production

  • Knowledge and understanding of design trends, meaningful and smart design concepts, critical thinking ("why am I doing this?"), research skills, as well as expertise in composition, grids, typography, color theory, and their impact on design, including working with AI

  • Excellent proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, After Effects, Blender, XD

  • Knowledge of usability principles and techniques

  • Experience working with contractors and production companies in BTL by delivering design materials for print & production

  • Understanding of principles of brand display and consistency in BTL design.

  • Experience working with AI tools for creating marketing materials (videos, animations, image generation, landing page generation).

  • Experience working with WebFlow to develop landing pages and other web-oriented content

Nice to have

  • Experience in the gaming industry, though we are also open to professionals from other fields who can bring a fresh perspective to our industry

  • Experience working with AI tools for prototyping and modelling

  • Motion design experience

What we Offer

  • Benefit from a transparent and systematic quarterly bonus system.

  • We offer a flexible work schedule to accommodate your needs.

  • Choose to work remotely, providing greater flexibility and comfort.

  • Enjoy unlimited paid vacation leave, including bank holidays.

  • Take unlimited paid sick leave whenever necessary.

  • Get reimbursement for professional development courses and training. We provide access to the latest tools and training for continuous growth.

Recruitment Process

  • Portfolio review. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered for further steps.

  • HR Interview

  • Take home task

  • Technical interview

  • Final interview

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

title: Director of Product Management and IT Operations
original_description:
About Self Bill Pro:

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities.

About the Role: Compensation - $130,000 - 160,000
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Product Management and IT Operations to lead the strategic direction and operational execution of our proprietary software platform. This is a critical leadership role that requires a unique blend of product management expertise, technical acumen, and operational leadership. You will be responsible for defining and driving the product roadmap while also ensuring the stability and security of our IT infrastructure and systems.

Reports to: Chief Operating Officer

Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Leadership: Partner with our global product manager to define, prioritize, and manage the product roadmap, ensuring it aligns with overall business objectives and our long-term technology vision.

  • Product Development: Lead the product development lifecycle from ideation to launch, including gathering and analyzing user feedback, writing detailed user stories and specifications, and collaborating with our offshore software development team.

  • Technical Oversight: Provide technical oversight and guidance to the development team on product features, enhancements, and operational issues.

  • Compliance & Security: Ensure compliance with security standards (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA) and best practices, working to protect the organizationâs data and systems.

  • Stakeholder Management: Effectively communicate with and manage relationships with various stakeholders, including customers, investors, and internal teams to gather requirements, test ideas, and communicate product progress.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with the stateside operational team to field feedback and translate business needs into technical requirements.

  • IT Operations & Helpdesk: Oversee day-to-day IT operations, including helpdesk support and quick resolution of operational issues and hotfixes as new employees are onboarded.



  • Extensive experience in a product management role, with a strong background in software development and project management.

  • Direct experience in the employee benefits or benefits administration technology space is a must.

  • Proven ability to think creatively about building software solutions and features that solve complex, real-world problems.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience managing and collaborating with a global or offshore development team.

  • Practical knowledge of IT operations, helpdesk support, and cybersecurity principles.

  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance requirements is highly desirable.

  • A natural leader with the ability to inspire and motivate a team, foster a positive work environment, and manage a high-volume workload in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us? At Self Bill Pro, youâll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. As a key leader in a rapidly growing organization, you will have a direct impact on our product, our clients, and our future. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology, data, and making a tangible difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply!

Equal Opportunity Self Bill Pro is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected status.

title: Director US Tax & Accounting #35344
original_description:
Company Profile:

Our client was founded to provide high quality professional & personalized tax preparation, accounting and bookkeeping services for individuals, businesses, and non-profits at reasonable rates. The company is a very fast-growing medium-sized accounting firm, allowing them to better serve individual business needs while helping clients save time and money. They serve clients throughout the United States, where demand for highly skilled Philippines-based accounting professionals continues to grow rapidly.

The company has maintained a Philippines accounting team for approximately 5 years and has consistently expanded its PH headcount year after year. The current Philippines team is nearing 30 professionals, and as the business continues to grow, they anticipate further long-term investment and expansion of their Philippines team into the future.

Our clientâs core values are centered around family, long-term career positioning, and professional development. As they continue expanding their PH accounting team, employees will have opportunities to take on increasing levels of responsibility, and participate in comprehensive training initiatives

They are reliable and responsive to clientsâ U.S. tax and accounting needs as businesses and organizations evolve through various operational and financial changes. Their customized service approach allows clients to better control costs while receiving the appropriate level of professional engagement and support needed to preserve and strengthen the value of their businesses.

The company has a growing client base of over 1,500+ U.S. business clients and 2,000+ individual tax clients. With decades of experience, the companyâs dedication to hard work has earned the respect of the business, individual, and financial community. They believe this reputation is a direct reflection of the quality, responsiveness, and professionalism of their team.

Finally, the company takes its responsibility to clients very seriously. Their commitment to every client includes delivering work accurately, professionally, and with the utmost integrity.

This is a great opportunity to join a family-oriented company that treats employees equally and invests meaningfully in their professional growth. Significant support and development will be provided across all areas of U.S. taxation and accounting, with clear opportunities to progress into more senior and rewarding responsibilities over time. As the PH accounting team continues to expand, you will also have the unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future direction of the team.

Overall purpose and responsibilities of the role:

The Director, US Tax & Accounting (title subject to discussion during calibration) will be responsible for preparing and reviewing standard US tax returns, including individual (1040), partnership (1065), S-Corporation (1120-S), and C-Corporation (1120) returns. The role also involves managing client relationships, providing tax compliance support, using QuickBooks for accounting-related tasks, and training junior staff. Experience with estate tax (1041), nonprofit tax (990), and employee benefit plan returns (5500) is an advantage but not required, and candidates may use any established tax software. The ideal candidate is a developing US tax professional with a solid technical foundation who is ready to take on greater responsibility and grow into a leadership role. This is a development hire, with opportunities to take on broader strategic and firm leadership responsibilities over time rather than requiring director- or partner-level experience from day one.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Tax Services

  • Provides review, management and thorough final detail review of tax returns in consideration of tax needs and compliance requirements for individuals, partnerships, and corporations, including general advisory services (e.g., Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S).
  • Provides, when not reviewing or managing returns, full-service preparation of tax returns (e.g., Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S).
  • Provides tax projections, planning, and tax notices, etc.
  • Estate tax returns (1041), nonprofit tax returns (990), and employee benefit plan returns (5500) are nice-to-haves and can be learned on the job.
  • Prepares and/or reviews US tax returns for small business clients, with a primary focus on compliance-driven work.
  • Provides tax planning support, which represents a smaller portion of the role (approximately 10â15% of the time), particularly toward year-end.

Tax Supplemental Services, Accounting & Bookkeeping Services

  • Manages professional accounting and bookkeeping services for business owners.
  • Manages financial records, transactions, entries, payments and reporting primarily using QuickBooks.
  • Provides light oversight of bookkeeping and QuickBooks-related activities, with the primary focus on tax services rather than day-to-day bookkeeping.

Firm Support

  • Serves as a firm Tax Partner and serves as primary point of contact.
  • Manages client relationships and support staff.
  • Acts as a trusted year-round advisor to clients, providing tax compliance guidance and advisory support beyond the annual tax season.
  • Helps streamline operations plus helps train and educate staff.
  • Mentors and upskills junior team members, setting an example of high-quality technical work and client service for a relatively junior, growing team.
  • Provides leadership responsibilities to firm, with broader strategic and leadership responsibilities developing over time.
  • Ability to have a significant voice in shaping the firm's future as the role grows.
  • Advises business owners on tax compliance, financial records and other matters as needed.
  • Independently tracks deliverables and identifies additional advisory opportunities with existing clients.
  • Supports the development of overseas-based, client-facing leadership as the firm grows, helping demonstrate that senior client-facing leadership can be based in the Philippines.

Critical Skills & Experience

  • Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or an advanced degree is strongly preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years of US tax experience.
  • Hands-on experience preparing and reviewing all required US tax return types, including Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120S. Experience across all four return types is essential.
  • Must be willing and able to prepare tax returns personally, not solely review or delegate deliverables.
  • Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Desktop.
  • Must be comfortable serving as the primary client point of contact, managing client relationships, negotiating fees, resolving service issues, and providing tax and business advisory guidance beyond tax preparation.
  • Ability to advise clients on matters such as LLC versus partnership structuring and entity location decisions.
  • Must be able to work US Eastern-aligned hours to support client and team collaboration.
  • Technology-savvy, with proficiency in Microsoft Office tools.
  • Familiarity with UltraTax and Onvio is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • A mid- to senior-level US tax professional, with preference for candidates who have significantly more than five years of experience, including those with 15â20+ years of experience.
  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and growth-oriented, with a desire to help shape and build the organization.
  • Interested in a long-term commitment to the firm and growing into broader leadership responsibilities.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in fund accounting, private equity, or hedge fund taxation, particularly candidates from firms specializing in these areas.
  • Big Four or large accounting firm background.
  • Experience managing client relationships while mentoring and overseeing internal team members.
  • CPA designation is strongly preferred.

Job type:Â Permanent

Emp type:Â Full-time

Schedule:Â Monday to Friday, with flexible start times. The preferred schedule is 8:00 AMâ4:00 PM EST, but earlier starts, as early as 4:00 AM EST, are also permitted.Â 

Location:Â Work From Home

Industry:Â Accounting/Financial

title: Head of Technology
original_description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
original_description:
Location: 100% remote (Ohio residency required)

Classification: Full-time, exempt
Reports to: School Leader

Pay Range: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

  • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

  • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

  • Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

  • Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

  • Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

  • Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.



Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred

  • Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements

  • At least 3 years of teaching experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal

  • Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online

  • Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews

  • Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems

The Ideal Candidate Brings:

  • Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data

  • Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school

Compensation & Benefits

  • The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.

  • Miaplazaâs compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.

  • Compensation is evaluated twice per year, based on performance.

  • Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.

  • All employees are eligible for a retirement plan with employer match.

  • PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 200hours per year or 25 eight-hour days on average.

  • Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

  • We invite your family and friends to join our journey! All employees receive free site memberships and discounted MOHS tuition for the children in their household, plus two additional memberships for other children in their lives.

â¡ï¸ Learn more by visiting our careers page!

Ready to apply?

Join our team at Miaplaza! Start by submitting your application and resume. Our hiring process involves an assessment, followed by two or more interviews and a role-specific assignment.

We're building an inclusive workplace where everyone belongs. As an equal-opportunity employer and E-Verify participant, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, or arrest/conviction records in accordance with applicable laws.

Need accommodations during the application process? Simply let us know before your assessment. We'll work with you to provide any necessary adjustments, including alternate versions of the assessment or assignment based on your needs.

original_description:
About Us:

Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. Weâre building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI (Remote - USA / Canada)

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer II, Applied AI to join our Agentic Systems team, where you'll build AI agents that automate workflows for teams across Wrapbook. You'll partner directly with internal teams like Marketing, Sales, Support, Operations and Finance to find high-leverage processes, then design, ship and iterate on agents that take real work off their plates. This is a chance to define how a 400+ person company runs on AI. You'll see the impact of your work every day, while shaping the patterns, tools and standards for how we build agents at Wrapbook.

What Youâll Do:

  • Design and build production-grade AI agents with LangGraph that automate multi-step workflows for internal teams across Wrapbook

  • Deploy, run and scale agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, using its runtime, memory, identity and gateway capabilities to make them secure and reliable, while tracking what they cost to run and keeping it efficient as usage grows

  • Partner with internal teams to find high-impact workflows, draw out requirements from people who can't hand you a spec, and turn them into agent-driven solutions, explaining clearly what each agent can and can't reliably do

  • Integrate agents with Wrapbook's internal systems, APIs and third-party tools so they can take real actions, not just answer questions

  • Build evaluation, observability and guardrail frameworks to measure agent quality, catch failures and keep humans in the loop where it matters

  • Establish reusable patterns, shared tools and best practices that let the Agentic Systems team ship new agents quickly and consistently

  • Own agents end to end, from prototype to production, measuring their impact on the teams they serve and iterating based on usage data and feedback

  • Drive adoption through clear documentation, training and enablement, so teams understand what each agent does, trust it and know how to get the most from it

What Youâll Have:

  • 6+ years of back-end development experience with Python, TypeScript/Node.js or Java, with a track record of delivering systems built for security, scalability, availability and performance

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered agents or workflows (with models such as Claude, GPT, Llama or Mistral), including prompting, tool use and structured outputs. You can walk us through one you built: how it was designed, what broke and how you fixed it

  • Production experience with at least one agent or LLM framework, such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex or AutoGen, and a solid understanding of AI architectures like RAG, reranking and multi-agent orchestration. Experience with LangGraph specifically is a plus

  • A security-first mindset: you think about data access, permissions and failure modes in everything you build, especially when agents can take real actions

  • Strong product sense and communication skills, with the ability to work directly with non-technical teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable automation

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an ownership mentality: you can take a loosely defined problem from idea to production on your own

  • Nice to have: experience running AWS workloads in production and knowing how to design for, deploy on and get the most out of Amazon's services, ideally including Amazon Bedrock AgentCore

Why Join Us:

At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology â and not just in the product.

In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, youâll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts Benefits include:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off

  • Work from anywhere in Canada and USA

  • Health and Dental benefits

  • Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home

  • Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K

  • Learning and Development opportunities

  • Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service

Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace:

Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation.

title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
original_description:
Description

BlueTuskr is a full-service e-commerce growth agency built exclusively for e-commerce brands. We combine paid media, owned media, creative, and analytics to help our clients scale profitably. Our team is made up of specialists who are deeply invested in their craft â and in the success of the brands they serve.

This isn't a "jack of all trades" environment. We hire people who are exceptional at what they do, then give them the resources and autonomy to do it well.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Graphic Designer and Video Editor who creates with conversion in mind. You know that a beautiful email that doesn't get clicks isn't finished yet, and that a product page is a sales tool first. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent real time designing for e-commerce brands â emails, landing pages, website sections, and social/ad creative â and can explain exactly why each design choice was made.

You'll design across a portfolio of e-commerce clients, working closely with our email, CRO, Shopify development, and paid media teams. You'll also use Claude and other AI tools as a real part of your workflow â to move faster on ideation, variations, and production, without sacrificing quality or brand consistency.

This role starts part-time at 15 hours/week, with real room to grow as your client roster and responsibilities expand.

What You'll Own

Email & Retention Design

  • Design campaign and automated flow emails (newsletters, welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back, etc.) that are on-brand and built to drive clicks and revenue
  • Design mobile-first, with clear hierarchy, scannable layouts, and strong calls to action
  • Prepare email-ready files and specs (image slicing, live text vs. image text, alt text, dark mode considerations) for clean builds in Klaviyo and other email platforms

Web Creative & CRO Support

  • Design landing pages, homepage, and collection page sections, product page (PDP) modules, banners, and promotional assets for Shopify stores
  • Partner with the CRO team to design test variations based on data, heatmaps, and hypotheses â not just personal taste
  • Hand off dev-ready Figma files to our web developers, with desktop and mobile layouts, organized layers, and clear specs

Social & Ad Creative

  • Design static social and paid ad creative for Meta, TikTok, and other channels
  • Create ad variations and iterations to support creative testing
  • Video editing for social and ad use (resizing, trimming, captions, simple motion) where needed

Process & Quality

  • Follow each client's brand guidelines closely, and flag gaps or inconsistencies when guidelines are missing or unclear
  • Apply design and e-commerce best practices (accessibility, contrast, legibility, load-friendly assets, platform specs)
  • Present work with a clear rationale â why this layout, this hierarchy, this CTA â to internal teams and, when needed, clients
  • Take feedback well, turn revisions around quickly, and keep work moving across multiple accounts and deadlines
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to speed up concepting, copy-to-layout exploration, asset variations, and repetitive production tasks â while following client confidentiality and our AI use guidelines
Who You Are

Skills get you in the door. These are the qualities that make you right for this role:

  • An exceptional designer with a strong eye for layout, typography, and color â your portfolio speaks for itself
  • Conversion-minded â you think about what the customer needs to see, feel, and do next, not just what looks good
  • Detail-obsessed â you catch the misaligned element, the off-brand color, and the typo before anyone else does
  • A clear communicator who can explain the reasoning behind design choices and keeps the team updated without being chased
  • Excellent at managing your time â you can juggle multiple clients and deadlines in a remote, async environment without dropping the ball
  • AI-curious and AI-capable â you already use tools like Claude in your workflow and are excited to find new ways to work smarter
  • Adaptable â you can shift between very different brand styles and still make each one feel right.
What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days:

  • You've learned the brand guidelines and design systems for your assigned client accounts
  • You're consistently delivering email, web, and social designs on time with minimal revision rounds
  • You've handed off at least one web project or CRO test variation to our Shopify dev team with clean, dev-ready files
  • You've built AI into your workflow in a way that measurably speeds up production
  • Internal teams trust your work and your reasoning, and come to you with ideas, not just requests

Must-Have:

  • 2â4 years of e-commerce digital design experience (email, website, social, etc.)
  • A portfolio showing e-commerce work â ideally with context on goals and results
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Hands-on experience using Claude and/or other AI tools in a design workflow
  • Experience designing for the web and supporting website creative (landing pages, site sections, PDPs)
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused design and e-commerce best practices
  • Proven ability to follow and apply brand guidelines across multiple brands
  • Strong written and spoken English for async communication with a U.S.-based team

Strong Differentiators:

  • Video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar)
  • Experience designing for Klaviyo or other email platforms
  • Familiarity with Shopify themes and how designs get built
  • Experience designing A/B test variations or working with CRO data
  • Paid social ad creative experience (Meta, TikTok)
  • Agency background preferred

This role is fully remote.

Time Commitment and Availability

  • Hours: 15 hours/week to start, with the opportunity to scale up as the role and client roster grow
  • Availability: Between 9 a.m. and 6 p.m. EST

Compensation

$20â25 USD/hour, based on experience and portfolio. This is a part-time, remote contractor role starting at 15 hours/week. Video editing experience is a strong plus and is factored into the rate.

title: Principal Product Manager Strategic Initiatives
original_description:
OUR MISSION

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person's cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help our care team focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you're inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what's possible, we'd love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We're hiring a Principal Product Manager to set the product direction for new, zero-to-one initiatives focused on applying AI to make better care decisions in oncology â helping people receive the right, evidence-based treatment at the moment it matters. Working closely with senior clinical, operations, engineering, and business leaders, you will shape the strategy, identify the highest-value opportunities, and lead the most complex and consequential product work needed to build a solution with the potential to become a category-defining platform.

This is a hands-on, zero-to-one role for a product leader who can operate at both the strategic and implementation levels â moving fluidly between learning from users, defining product direction, partnering with engineering and other stakeholders to shape solutions , and driving execution to launch. You will establish the product foundation across workflow tooling, data integrations, and AI systems, while creating patterns that can scale across future products and initiatives. Much of this work sits at the intersection of applied AI, clinical guidelines, and operational workflows in a regulated setting where fidelity, auditability, and trust are non-negotiable. This is an individual contributor role today, with the opportunity to build and lead a product team over time as this business line grows.

Additionally, you will:

  • Drive the roadmap for a zero-to-one AI initiative to improve care decisions in oncology

  • Prototype, test, and ship AI powered products with engineering and other teams cross functionally

  • Build the workflow tooling and decision support surfaces clinicians and care teams need to act on AI recommendations

  • Own the evaluations, guardrails, and observability standards to ensure recommendations are accurate, safe, and trusted across, auditable, and defensible to clinical, provider, and health-plan stakeholders

  • Partner with engineering to shape the technical architecture around AI systems, data models, and integrations

  • Communicate tradeoffs and profess clearly to senior clinical, engineering, and business stakeholders

  • Leverage AI to accelerate your own work and help decide how the team uses AI tooling to move faster and prototype more efficiently

WHAT YOU'VE DONE

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including leading zero-to-one or early-stage initiatives when the problem, requirements, and path forward were not fully defined

  • You have healthcare experience, ideally building workflow, data, or integration products for enterprise contexts

  • Youâre comfortable with ambiguity and defining a path forward for yourself and others

  • You have hands-on experience building or shipping AI/LLM-powered products

  • You communicate clearly and build alignment across engineering, clinical, and business stakeholders

  • You like to operate close to the technical details, such as data models, edge cases, evaluations, and impacts of implementation

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in oncology, serious illness / palliative care, or chronic condition management

  • Hands-on experience shipping AI/LLM-powered product features, including safety guardrails, evaluation, and quality measurement

OUR VALUES

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we chooseâor donât choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $195,500-$230,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level. This position is also bonus-eligible.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. Weâre here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud, and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

title: Technical Customer Support
original_description:
QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢.

The Role

We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality.

You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to.

Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are.

The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking.

This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer.

We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it.

If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.

What Work Looks Like

You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable.

Every day

  • Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it.
  • Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution.
  • Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform.

Delighting customers

  • Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success.
  • Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked.
  • Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates.

Making support smarter with AI

  • Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do.
  • Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving.

Keeping the product solid

  • Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected.
  • Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors.
  • Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice.

Running the week

  • Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated.
  • Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps.

Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude.

Who You Are

  • You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls.
  • You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things.
  • You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding.
  • You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom.
  • Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said.
  • You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity.
  • You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results.
  • You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack.
  • Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive.
  • Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are.

A Plus If You Have

  • Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role.
  • Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps.
  • Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client.
  • Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report.
  • An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment.

How We Work Together

You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer.

Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice:

  • Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask.
  • Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt.
  • Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked.
  • The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on.
  • The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you.

This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once.

Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too.

Benefits

  • Contract type: full-time or part-time
  • Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099).
  • Start date: negotiable
