title: Principal Software Engineer
original_description:
Your Opportunity

As a Principal Engineer, you will help design, build, and operate the clinical decision support and API-driven data delivery platform that enables Vytalize Health to embed timely, actionable clinical insights directly into provider workflows. Working cross-functionally with Data Engineering, Product, Clinical Operations, and EMR partners, your solutions will transform how clinicians access dataâmoving from external tools and workarounds to seamless, in-workflow decision support via CDS Hooks and real-time APIs.

You will own the technical foundation for Clinical Decision Support (CDS) Hooks, REST APIs, and the architectural patterns that ensure clinical data is accessible, trustworthy, and performant at the moment of care. This role sits at the intersection of healthcare interoperability standards, modern API design, and operational excellence. You will establish reliability metrics and SLAs that ensure CDS Hooks and APIs serve clinician workflows with consistent quality and performance. You will be part of a small, high-performing healthcare engineering team where engineers support each other's growth through mentorship and tight collaboration.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of the CDS Hooks platform, including card orchestration, hook context handling, EHR-side logic orchestration, and integration with downstream data services

  • Own CDS Hook API contracts and evolution, ensuring compliance with SMART CDS Hooks specification while adding performance, reliability, and healthcare-specific optimizations

  • Lead technical integration with EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) for CDS Hook discovery, execution, card rendering, and user action handling

  • Design, build, and maintain public-facing REST and event-driven APIs exposing clinical data, quality metrics, care gaps, attribution data, and decision support content to partners and provider-facing applications

  • Establish API contracts, versioning strategies, and deprecation policies that balance innovation with stability for external consumers

  • Implement and maintain API security patterns including OAuth 2.0, scope-based authorization, rate limiting, and audit logging for compliant clinical data access

  • Design and optimize real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding CDS Hooks and APIsâensuring low latency, high freshness, and graceful failure modes

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing and QA frameworks for CDS Hooks and APIs â including hook context validation, card rendering verification, and clinical workflow testing across EMR systems

  • Establish reliability metrics and SLAs (latency, availability, freshness) for CDS Hook delivery and API performance; measure and track against clinical requirements

  • Define and measure clinical impact metrics â adoption of CDS Hooks, clinician interaction rates, workflow integration success, and patient outcome influence

  • Exercise architectural judgment across tradeoffs in correctness, latency, scalability, maintainability, and operational risk in clinical data systems

  • Design and implement reliability patterns for CDS and API services including monitoring, alerting, failure detection, graceful degradation, and incident recovery

  • Partner with Data Reliability Engineer to define and operate SLAs for CDS Hook delivery, API response times, and data freshness aligned to clinical needs

  • Establish and uphold engineering standards for API design, data schemas, integration patterns, and interoperability; maintain high-quality technical documentation and OpenAPI specifications

  • Partner with Data Engineering to align upstream data models, gold-layer datasets, and platform capabilities with clinical decision support and API requirements

  • Serve as the technical authority on clinical interoperability standards (SMART CDS Hooks, FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, EHR integration patterns)

  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical Operations, and Business stakeholders to clarify requirements, translate clinical workflows into platform features, and shape product direction

  • Act as trusted technical advisor to EMR partners, healthcare systems, and external API consumers; ensure expectations and delivery are well-defined and predictable

  • Ensure all CDS and API services comply with healthcare security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, state regulations, payer mandates)

  • Partner with IT Security and Compliance teams to implement secure access controls, audit logging, encryption, and data protection measures across delivery mechanisms

  • Design and implement audit trails for all clinical data access; support compliance audits and regulatory reporting

  • Mentor team members through design reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance on clinical data integration and API design

  • Document new and existing systems, designs, processes, and procedures

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience designing, building, and operating API platforms, service-oriented systems, or backend infrastructure at scale

  • Demonstrated experience operating at a senior or staff-level individual contributor scope, owning complex systems end-to-end

  • 3+ years of direct experience with healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, clinical data exchange, or healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7, CDA, claims data)

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR, or similar clinical decision support APIs

  • Strong experience designing and operating REST APIs, including contract design, versioning, error handling, and authentication/authorization patterns

  • Deep understanding of healthcare data integrations, EMR workflows, and interoperability patterns (FHIR, HL7, CDS Hooks, SMART on FHIR)

  • Expertise in designing for reliability, SLAs, and operational metrics; ability to translate clinical requirements into technical SLOs

  • Experience defining and measuring API performance metrics (latency, availability, error rates); familiarity with SLA monitoring and enforcement

  • Strong systems thinking with ability to design for scale, reliability, maintainability, and resilience

  • Proficiency in modern backend languages (Python, Java, Go, or similar); comfort reading and reviewing code across languages

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Databricks, GCP) and containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes, or managed services)

  • Proven ability to partner effectively across engineering, product, analytics, clinical operations, and business teams

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly for explaining technical concepts and tradeoffs to clinicians and non-specialists

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with healthcare compliance and regulatory constraints

Strong Pluses

  • Hands-on experience with CDS Hooks specification and SMART on FHIR implementations in production healthcare environments

  • Experience implementing and testing CDS Hooks across multiple EMR systems (Epic, NextGen, Athena, ECW) including clinical workflow validation

  • Familiarity with healthcare data formats and standards: FHIR resources (Patient, Condition, Medication, etc.), CCD/C-CDA, claims data (837s, 835s), HL7 v2 or v3

  • Experience designing and operating real-time or near-real-time data pipelines feeding clinical applications and decision support systems

  • Knowledge of value-based care metrics, care gaps, quality measures (NQF, HEDIS), and HCC/RAF risk stratification

  • Experience with API management platforms, developer portals, or partner ecosystem / API monetization patterns

  • Familiarity with OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and federated identity patterns in healthcare systems

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and safe deployment practices

  • Background supporting provider-facing platforms or external clinical partners; deep understanding of provider workflows and constraints

  • Experience in a healthcare startup or high-growth healthcare technology environment

  • Familiarity with healthcare data governance, interoperability regulations (21st Century Cures, ONC rules), and clinical data quality frameworks

  • Experience with API testing frameworks and quality assurance for distributed systems

Perks/Benefits

  • Competitive base compensation

  • Annual bonus potential

  • Health benefits effective on start date

  • Health & Wellness Program; up to $300 per quarter for your overall well-being available on start date

  • 401K plan effective on the first of the month after your start date; 100% of up to 4% of your annual salary

  • Unlimited (or generous) paid "Vytal Time", and 5 paid sick days after your first 90 days

  • Company paid STD/LTD

  • Technology setup

  • Ability to help build a market leader in value-based healthcare at a rapidly growing organization

Please note at no time during our screening, interview, or selection process do we ask for additional personal information (beyond your resume) or account/financial information. We will also never ask for you to purchase anything; nor will we ever interview you via text message. Any communication received from a Vytalize Health recruiter during your screening, interviewing, or selection process will come from an email ending in @vytalizehealth.com

title: Federal Business Development Director
original_description:
About Fortanix

In today's world, where data spreads across various clouds and devices, traditional security measures aren't enough. Businesses and Government need a dynamic approach to defend against constant cyber threats and ensure agile data security. Fortanix leads the way in data-centric cybersecurity for hybrid multicloud environments, using advanced cryptography, encryption, PQC and Confidential AI solutions.Â Â 

In an era where customers want solutions that allow their AI models to be close to the sensitive data they keep on premises, a unique solution is required.Â  Fortanix harnesses the power of memory-encryption based Confidential Computing to protect AI data, applications and proprietary models all the way through their lifecycle:Â  At-Rest, In-Motion and In-Use, ie at runtime.Â  Fortanix is the only company that can do this.Â  Our Confidential AI solution, developed in conjunction with NVIDIA allows enterprises, agencies and AI Factories to protect data, applications and models using secure multi-tenancy and data sovereignty capabilities.Â Â Â 

Our commitment to solving the worldâs toughest data security challenges has earned Fortanix multiple Cybersecurity Excellence and Innovation Awards, as well as recognition from industry giants such as NVIDIA, Dell, HPE, Intel, Supermicro, Crowdstrike, Redhat and VAST Data.Â Â Â 

Our team includes industry leaders and cryptography experts, creating a culture of trust, innovation and collaboration where every voice is valued. Recognized as a Great Place to Work, we're looking for passionate individuals to help us shape the future of data security and work towards a safer digital future.Â 


Job Description

Fortanix is in search of a Federal Business Development Director that is a proven sales leader to drive the expansion of our team and business across the Federal segments focused on national security. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, weâre looking for a unique individual that wants to be on the leading edge of security data and Generative AI models for these critical mission oriented groups.Â Â  demonstrated expertise at finding opportunities and driving revenue opportunities, as well as managing large agency accounts on both the civilian side and in the IC & adjacent DefenseÂ  segments.Â Â 

The ideal candidate will bring a track-record of consistent overachievement as an Federal seller, and experience leading a team that is skilled in selling into the civilian, IC and DOD segments. Weâre looking for a hands-on business leader who wants to be directly involved in key deals, in addition to coaching and team-building. As a member of Fortanixâs leadership, youâll serve as a strategic partner across the broader GTM organization, providing guidance on account strategy, deal prioritization, and value-selling best practices. Experience working in a tech startup environment is a strong preference.Â 

Â 

Role ResponsibilitiesÂ 

As a Federal Business Development Director reporting to the CRO, you will own, drive, & be rewarded for your business.Â 

You will:Â 

  • Develop and execute territory account plans to achieve quota responsibilities for your team and the region through direct selling and partners.Â 
  • Drive a best-in-class sales methodology framework which includes rigorous qualification and navigation of complex Federal deals.Â 
  • Manage effective working relationships with Strategic Alliances, Federal Resellers, FSIs, Sales Engineers, Consulting Professionals, Sales Development, Marketing & your own network to identify the best prospects, then develop & qualify the sales pipeline.Â 
  • Champion value and consensus selling across our GTM organization and enable AEs to create their own territory account strategyÂ Â 
  • Engage with other functions across the company, as well as Fortanixâs partner ecosystem, in support of sales pursuits and revenue growthÂ Â 
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of our core personas, competitors, product offering, and named accountÂ 
  • Most importantly:Â  You will identify and develop opportunities to bring Fortanixâs innovative Confidential AI solution to mission oriented agencies that have projects where their data, applications and models must be protected at all times.Â 

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of successful, growth-oriented sales experience in key security agencies and SIâs.Â  Leadership experience is a major plus.Â Â Â 
  • Location in the Washington DC area and an active security clearance are highly desired.Â 
  • Proven track record of selling complex solutions (ideally security platform solutions) to the federal government (ideally the DOD/IC) and increasing revenue through net-new customer acquisition, working with and through strategic partner channels (FSIs, Partners, Consultants etc).Â 
  • Demonstrated ability to sell to CXO, technical buyers, and Line of Business, successfully emphasizing business value versus productÂ Â 
  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and executive engagement skillsÂ Â 
  • Coaching direct and indirect team members on strategies to drive sales winsÂ Â 
  • Accurate reporting on sales activity and forecasting; consistent monitoring of the sales activity of the team, and tracking of resultsÂ Â 
  • Bachelor's degree; MBA preferred or relevant experienceÂ Â 

What we valueÂ 

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for successÂ 
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work.Â 
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Fortanix everything is a work in progress â we can do better at everything.Â Â 
  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.Â 

What we offer:

  • We offer a collaborative work environment, amazing equity, great benefits, competitive salary, and the opportunity to redefine cloud computing.Â Â 
  • 100% employer paid base plans for health, dental and vision
  • Short and Long Term Disability
  • Life Insurance
  • Unlimited PTO (itâs between you and your work!)
  • The week off between Christmas and New Year's Day
  • 40 hours of Volunteer Time Off/yearÂ 
  • Internet stipendÂ 
  • Friendly culture that brings the best out of everybodyÂ 
  • 401kÂ 

Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Holidays, and more. The compensation for this role is $275,000 - $350,000 / Year.Â 

Fortanix is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If youâre interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment â we encourage you to apply!

title: Director of IT and Workplace
original_description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

  • Partner with Security on incident response and vulnerability remediation, and with Legal on data handling, retention, and discovery requests.

  • Own business continuity and disaster recovery for corporate systems â write the plans, test them, and fix what the tests expose.

  • Treat protected health information and confidential data with the care our customers and their patients expect. This is non-negotiable in everything we do.

Workplace and facilities

  • Own day-to-day operations of the headquarters, and lead space planning and buildouts against a hiring plan that keeps moving.

  • Manage physical security â access control and badging, visitor management, cameras, and emergency preparedness â aligned with our compliance obligations.

  • Own conference room and event AV, including all-hands and customer visits, to a standard where the technology is never the story.

  • Support remote clinicians and staff with reliable equipment logistics, home office standards, and consistent service regardless of location.

  • Manage facilities, AV, security, and food vendors, plus landlord and lease matters, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

What You'll Bring

  • 8+ years in IT, spanning hands-on administration or engineering and progressively senior ownership. You've done the work you'll now be leading.

  • 3+ years managing IT or workplace teams, including hiring, performance management, and developing people into bigger roles.

  • Proven ownership of an IT function through rapid growth. You've scaled systems and process ahead of headcount, not behind it.

  • Deep technical expertise across identity (Okta or comparable), Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, MDM at fleet scale, and corporate networking.

  • Experience as a named control owner in a regulated environment â HIPAA, SOC 2, or HITRUST â including sitting across the table from auditors.

  • Budget ownership and vendor negotiation experience, with the financial fluency to frame a risk or a funding ask so a CFO can act on it.

  • Workplace or facilities exposure â buildouts, moves, physical security, or lease management â or a genuine appetite to own it and learn quickly.

  • Willingness to stay close to the work. This is a leadership role at a company where the director still unblocks a broken demo when it matters.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. We weigh demonstrated ability over credentials.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare, life sciences, or another environment handling sensitive personal data at scale.

  • IT integration of an acquisition, or standing up a function's first access governance or asset management program.

  • Automation depth (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and experience managing devices and infrastructure as code.

  • Certifications such as Okta Certified Administrator, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator, Jamf, CISM, CISSP, or ITIL.

Why Join Hippocratic AI

Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first. Weâre building the worldâs first healthcareâonly, safetyâfocused LLM â a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation.

Work with the people shaping the future. Hippocratic AI was coâfounded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA.

Backed by the worldâs leading healthcare and AI investors. We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Childrenâs, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others.

Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI. Join experts whoâve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building worldâchanging technologies â ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative.

Equal Opportunity

Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com.

Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @hippocraticai.com email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.

title: Project Manager
original_description:
The Project Manager is a client-facing role at the center of everything we do.

Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplinesâresearch, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.

Key Responsibilities

Youâll own three core responsibilities:

  1. Coordination. Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
  2. Strategy & Planning. Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.
  3. Energy (âVibesâ). Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

Skills, Knowledge and Traits

You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you:

  1. Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and donât stop until things are finished properly.
  2. Communication. You default to over-communication. You proactively reach out to clients and teammates, flag risks early, and ask for help when you need it.
  3. Smart and high agency. You learn quickly, enjoy technology and design, and want to understand why things work (or donât. Youâre the kind of person who notices patterns and asks good questions.

What Youâll Get

  • Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry-level roles.
  • Tech reimbursement. Need a better computer, monitor, or setup? Want training on Figma or GA4? Weâll help.
  • In-demand skills. Youâll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.
  • Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.

If youâre excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit-based environment, weâd love to hear from you.

Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Marketing and Sales Administrator

Compensation range: $1,500 AUD - $2,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, youâll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our company is a thriving real estate agency in Brisbaneâs south-west, with a principal who lists and sells at a strong pace, an in-house finance broker, and a loyal local client base built over many years. Appraisal requests are coming in fast, and the agency is ready to add a sharp, organised operator to keep every lead warm and every opportunity moving.

Role Overview: Youâll sit at the centre of the agencyâs growth engine. Youâll own a database of 30,000+ contacts, keep it clean and organised, and run a consistent nurture program so past clients, buyers and potential sellers hear from us at the right time. Youâll be on the phones connecting with homeowners, qualifying appraisal leads and booking them in for the principal. Youâll also support marketing and bring practical AI and automation skills that make every follow-up faster and more reliable.

Key Responsibilities:Â 

Database & CRM ownership

  • Clean, de-duplicate, update and segment approx. 25,000 existing contacts plus 5,000â10,000 newer buyer and seller contacts.
  • Run a structured 6â12 month nurture cadence so every contact receives timely, relevant touchpoints.
  • Log every call, email and outcome accurately so the CRM stays the single source of truth.

Phones & lead nurturing

  • Make value-led outbound calls: just listed, just sold, upcoming auctions in the street, and free market report offers.
  • Nurture appraisal leads, qualify their timing and motivation, and book appraisals directly into the principalâs calendar.
  • Hand over warm, ready-to-list clients with clear notes, and refer finance opportunities to the in-house broker.

Marketing support

  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns to targeted database segments.
  • Prepare market updates and suburb reports that give homeowners genuine value.
  • Support social media content and scheduling alongside the agencyâs existing marketing.

AI & automation

  • Set up automated follow-ups across SMS, email and CRM workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, or built-in CRM automation.
  • Monitor automations for accuracy and tone, and refine them to lift response and booking rates.

Additional sales administration

  • Prepare sale contracts using approved templates and instructions; enter details, coordinate signing and distribute completed copies to relevant parties.Â 
  • Prepare and process Form 6 appointment documents; check details and signatures, follow up outstanding items and file completed records, subject to principal review.

Reception and general administration coverÂ 

  • When the receptionist is away, answer and direct calls, respond to general enquiries, record messages, manage appointments and assist with routine administrative tasks.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 2-3+ years in a sales admin, marketing admin or client-facing role, ideally within Australian real estate.
  • Excellent spoken and written English with a warm, confident phone manner that Australian homeowners respond to.
  • Hands-on CRM experience and a genuine love of clean, well-organised data.
  • Comfortable making outbound calls daily and energised by booking results.
  • Confident using AI tools and automation platforms to work smarter.
  • Self-directed and output-focused: you plan your day, deliver consistently and report progress proactively.

Bonus Skills:

  • Australian real estate CRMs such as Rex, VaultRE, AgentBox or Box+Dice.
  • Email marketing platforms, Canva, and social scheduling tools.
  • Familiarity with Australian property terms: appraisals, auctions, listings, settlements.


Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as âIndependent Contractorâ)

title: Technical Account Manager
original_description:
About DEUNA ð§¡

 

DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution.

 

With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation.

We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð

 

Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us!


About the Role

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live.

You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions.

For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform.

Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA.

 

 

Responsibilities

Proactively monitor merchant technical health

  • Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies.

  • Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues.

  • Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected.

  • Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants.

Be the main technical contact after go-live

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live.

  • Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior.

  • Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support.

Support technical incident management

  • Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues.

  • Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams.

  • Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up.

  • Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely.

  • Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required.

Drive merchant technical improvements

  • Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost.

  • Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth.

  • Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch.

Build merchant health visibility

  • Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants.

  • Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks.

  • Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally.

 

 

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles.

  • Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS.

  • Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support.

  • Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline.

  • Fluent in Spanish and English.

  • Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must.

  • Startup environment experience is a plus.

 

 

What Success Looks Like

A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks.

The TAM should help ensure that:

  • Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly.

  • Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership.

  • Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication.

  • Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts.

  • Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA.

\n


\n

title: Product Design Lead
original_description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do:
  • Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
  • Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
  • Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
  • A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
  • We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process:

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

title: Product Engineering Lead
original_description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businessesâfrom exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMsâto seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels.Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiterâs identity.Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods.Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses.Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @tether.to orÂ @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details.Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Senior Director of Sales - Global MTO & PSP Markets (Crypto/Fintech/Payments)
original_description:
Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Their operation is fully legal and compliant, with licenses in multiple countries and jurisdictions globally. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.

﻿

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Director of Sales to lead our client’s global sales strategy within the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors. This critical leadership role will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth, managing their global sales team, and expanding their footprint into key international markets. title: Application Security Architect
original_description:
About the Role

The Application Security Architect role is pivotal to the NinjaOne team, with company-wide visibility spanning individual developers through executive leadership. As part of NinjaOne's core Information Security organization, you will directly contribute to the security, privacy, reliability, and user experience of more than 6,000 customers across MSP and enterprise IT environments.

This is a highly technical, architecture-focused role blending hands-on software security and secure design principles. Ideally, you have a solid background in both software engineering and security. You will work across application, cloud, infrastructure, and identity layers to embed security into NinjaOne's software and systems from design through deployment.

Working closely with engineering, platform, and product teams, you will lead code reviews, secure design and architecture reviews, anticipate emerging threats, and help drive scalable, resilient, and compliant security solutions. You will also serve as a security mentor to engineering teams, helping raise overall security maturity across the organization.

English Resume Required.

Location: We are flexible on remote working from home, but you must be located inBrazil, Colombia,Ecuador, or Mexico.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with engineering teams to review system designs and source code for security and architectural risks
  • Lead threat modeling, secure design reviews, and architecture review sessions with engineering teams
  • Execute and help improve our AI-assisted workflows for product security
  • Define and guide security initiatives from proof-of-concept through operational maturity
  • Develop clear reports and presentations for technical and executive audiences
  • Document security architectures, policies, and best practices
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to other security team members
  • Promote a culture of security awareness across the organization, driving and evolving the Security Champions program to foster shared ownership of secure design practices

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in software security, including 2+ years in security architecture or offensive security roles
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages: Java, Kotlin, C++
  • Strong understanding of application security fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, cryptography, and secure communications
  • Experience with security frameworks and methodologies such as OWASP, NIST, BSIMM, STRIDE, and DREAD
  • Hands-on experience with identity and access management technologies (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC)
  • Knowledge of cloud security in AWS environments
  • Experience with modern delivery technologies, including IaC and CI/CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Linux and Windows security in enterprise environments
  • Experience with security testing and common security tooling
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, or SecurityX are preferred but not required

About Us

NinjaOne automates the hardest parts of IT to deliver visibility, security, and control over all endpoints for more than 40,000 customers. The NinjaOne automated endpoint management platform is proven to increase productivity, reduce security risk, and lower costs for IT teams and managed service providers. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and provides free and unlimited onboarding, training, and support. NinjaOne is #1 on G2 in endpoint management, patch management, remote monitoring and management, and mobile device management.

What You'll Love

  • Flexible working hours with home office options that help you balance your personal life and your job
  • Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
  • Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
  • Receive competitive compensation
  • Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

title: RP26 Roster - Partnership Management Consultant
original_description:
CIMMYT is a cutting edge, non-profit, international organization dedicated to solving tomorrow's problems today. It is entrusted with fostering improved quantity, quality, and dependability of production systems and basic cereals such as maize, wheat, triticale, sorghum, millets, and associated crops through applied agricultural science, particularly in the Global South, through building strong partnerships. This combination enhances the livelihood trajectories and resilience of millions of resource-poor farmers, while working towards a more productive, inclusive, and resilient agrifood system within planetary boundaries.

About this Roster Position

This vacancy is intended to identify and assess qualified internal and external candidates for CIMMYT’s Talent Roster. Successful candidates may be considered for future opportunities matching their experience, job family, level and location.

Inclusion in the roster does not constitute an offer or guarantee of employment. Opportunities arise according to project requirements, organizational priorities and the availability of donor funding. When a suitable position becomes available, CIMMYT will reconfirm the candidate’s interest and availability and may conduct a brief role-fit assessment before appointment.

Consultancies in this roster are based within CIMMYT’s Office of the Chief Transformation Officer and support the design and strengthening of institutional partnership management across CIMMYT’s research programs and Chapters. The focus is on how CIMMYT selects, contracts, monitors and manages its implementing partners and collaborators throughout the partnership lifecycle. This roster does not cover donor relations or resource mobilization.

Engagements are typically home-based and part-time (approximately half-time), with short missions to CIMMYT headquarters in Texcoco, Mexico. Consultants work with a high degree of independence, producing institutional-quality frameworks, procedures and tools that are handed over to CIMMYT staff for implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct diagnostics of existing partnership management systems, processes and practices across programs, including stakeholder interviews, process mapping and systems landscape reviews.
  • Translate diagnostic findings and risk assessments into prioritized design requirements and recommendations.
  • Develop institutional partnership management frameworks covering value proposition, strategic priorities, partner segmentation, governance, decision rights, and roles and responsibilities.
  • Draft operational procedures across the partnership lifecycle: partner selection, risk-based due diligence, contract management, financial and performance monitoring, technical quality assurance, relationship management and close-out.
  • Design practical tools for staff, such as financial monitoring templates, due diligence risk-tiering and organizational capacity assessment tools, partner risk registers, tracking tools and close-out checklists.
  • Define functional and data requirements for embedding procedures into ERP and contract management systems, and for portfolio-level oversight dashboards.
  • Prepare implementation and change management roadmaps, including phased rollout, piloting, training needs and interim workarounds.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Grants, Legal, Donor Relations, program leadership and IT/ERP teams, and provide regular written progress updates to senior management.
  • Prepare handover packages and support knowledge transfer to the CIMMYT staff responsible for implementation.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in partnership, grants or program management within international organizations, research institutions or NGOs, including donor-funded, multi-program environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or strengthening financial controls, due diligence frameworks, or partnership/grant management systems, including in response to audit findings or risk assessments.
  • Proven track record of independently producing institutional-quality policies, frameworks and procedures under tight timelines.
  • Strong financial acumen: ability to interpret partner budgets, financial reports and funding structures and translate them into practical controls and monitoring tools.
  • Working knowledge of grant and contract management systems (e.g., ERP platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, contract management platforms such as Icertis) and of dashboard tools for portfolio oversight.
  • Experience conducting organizational diagnostics, including stakeholder interviews and process mapping across dispersed, multi-country teams.
  • Excellent written English and document design skills, with the ability to produce board- and donor-ready material.
  • Experience with CGIAR, agricultural research or Global South–focused development organizations is an advantage.

Benefits

This is an individual consultancy. CIMMYT offers a competitive fee commensurate with experience and the scope of each assignment, and covers travel costs for missions to headquarters in accordance with CIMMYT policy. As a consultancy, this engagement does not include staff benefits. title: Site Reliability Engineer
original_description:
Who are Tyk, and what do we do?

The Tyk API Management platform is helping to drive the connected world and power new products and services. We’re changing the way that organisations connect any number of their systems and services.Whether internal, external, public or highly encrypted systems, Tyk helps businesses drive value across the retail, finance, telecoms, healthcare, or media industries (to name just a few!)

If you’ve banked online, used an app to check the news, or perhaps even driven a connected car, API’s, and by extension, Tyk, make that possible. Founded in 2015 with offices in London – UK, London – Ontario, Atlanta and Singapore, we have many thousands of users of our B2B platform across the globe. Brands using Tyk range from Lotte, Bell, T Mobile, to RBS, Capital One and Vinci. We have a varied user base hailing from every continent – even Antarctica.

Our Mission

Tyk is on a mission to connect every system in the world. We’ve started by building an API Management platform.

Total flexibility, default remote, radical responsibility

We offer unlimited paid holidays and remote working from anywhere in the world, for everyone, Why? Tyk was founded on the principle of offering flexibility and autonomy to our employees, we believe this allows our employees to achieve their best results. It also means we can build the best possible team, location and working hours are no barrier.

If this sounds like an environment that you believe could work for you then read on to find out more.

The role:

Tyk Cloud is our managed API management platform, running on multi-region Kubernetes at scale for customers around the world.

We're looking for an SRE who's as comfortable in the code as in the infrastructure. You'll spend most of your time improving and automating the platform, and when you're on call, you'll handle incidents independently. You'll join a small, centralised SRE team that works closely with our product teams.

You don't need to have done everything below. We care most about how you reason through problems and how quickly you learn. You'll have three to four months to get up to speed, shadowing first, before you go on call.

What you'll do:

Most of your time

  • Deliver the team's planned work each quarter, such as optimising the platform, building self-serve tooling for other teams, and rearchitecting parts of the platform as it grows.
  • Help expand Tyk Cloud across regions and clouds, and bring down what it costs to run.
  • Automate operations in Go, including building and maintaining our custom Kubernetes operators.
  • Run the platform's services and databases, including MongoDB and Redis.
  • Improve our observability: find the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and alerts to act on them.
  • Keep runbooks and documentation current, and support security work such as SOC 2 audits.

When you're on call

You'll be doing one week in three initially (one in four as we grow), Monday-Friday, on a 12-hour shift with secondary backup support. Rotas: 12 PM–12 AM UTC

  • Be first line for platform alerts and incidents: restore service, escalate or help fix product bugs, and lead post-incident reviews.
  • Act as second line for our Customer Success team, on requests that come directly from customers.
  • Handle ad hoc requests from other teams across the organisation regarding Tyk Cloud.

Requirements

What you'll need:

  • 3+ years in SRE, platform or infrastructure roles, across more than one company or production platform.
  • Experience owning on-call and leading incidents yourself.
  • Hands-on experience running production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS: operating, upgrading and debugging large, multi-tenant clusters.
  • Experience designing and operating infrastructure on AWS, with Terraform or similar.
  • The ability to write, test and ship Go tooling or services.
  • Experience with Prometheus and Grafana, and with logging systems.
  • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, load balancing).
  • Clear communication across time zones and teams.

Our stack

EKS, Terraform/Terragrunt, Helm, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, MongoDB, Redis, Prometheus and Grafana.

Benefits

Here’s why you should join us:

  • Everyone has unlimited paid holiday.
  • We have total flexibility in hours, as we believe creativity flows better when our people are given freedom to decide when they are most productive. Everyone is unique after all.
  • Employee share scheme
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave
  • Company retreats

We all share the same vision – we value authenticity, respect, responsibility, independence, honesty, diversity and inclusion and most importantly treating others how you wish to be treated. We look for like-minded people who bring their personalities to work everyday, strive to achieve their personal goals and who are willing to challenge the way we do things, why? – to make what we do even better!

Our values tell the story of Tyk – here’s how:

  • It’s ok to screw up!

We’ve found that it’s often the ‘stupid’ or unexpected ideas that turn out to be the successful ones – so try it, at least we can say we have!

  • The only stupid idea, is the untested one!

It’s in our DNA – starting a business with founders 12 hours apart, giving our gateway away for free – sure, we did that, and we’d do it again!

  • Trust starts with you – make it count!

Trust is a two-way street – instill it from day one!

  • Assume best intent!

We have each other’s back – we’re all on the same team. Think before you speak or act.

  • Make things, better!

Always try to leave things better than when you found them – change is constant, inevitable and embraced! Be that change we want to see.

What’s it like to work here?! check it out:

Tyk is an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

You can see more about us here

title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Engineer - Silicon Enablement
cleaned_description: p Ubuntu Linux is already the most popular Linux distribution in the world, and its mission is to remain at the forefront of the global software ecosystem. This role sits at a critical junction in the software stack, ensuring that the underlying hardware is seamlessly integrated, optimized and prepared to meet the demands of modern computing. /p p While direct experience with the Linux kernel would be an advantage, it is not a hard requirement. Attackers not only break in - they log in. Identity is now a major target for attacks. These attacks can happen in on-premises setups, cloud environments, or with self-directed agents. Detecting and responding to identity-based attacks is essential for any modern Security Operations Center (SOC). /p p In this high-impact role, you will define how Elastic detects, investigates, and responds to identity-based threats, building on our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation to deliver a credible, differentiated ITDR function. You will also own the roadmap for securing non-human and AI agent identities within Elastic Security, one of the fastest-growing and least-governed attack surfaces in the enterprise. You will work at the intersection of identity, detection engineering, and AI, partnering with threat researchers, data scientists, and engineers, and evangelizing our approach to a global community of security practitioners. /p h3 strong What You Will Be Doing /strong /h3 ul li Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for a credible ITDR function within Elastic Security, evolving our Entity Analytics and Entity Store foundation from behavioral analytics into an identity-defense outcome. /li li Manage the plan for non-human and AI agent identities in Elastic Security. This involves modeling service accounts, workloads, secrets, and self-directed agents as important identities. Each identity will have its own behavior standards, ownership, and lifecycle. You will also establish how to detect identities that operate continuously and at machine scale. /li li Work with threat research and detection engineering. Focus on identity-specific threats. These threats include credential access, privilege escalation, and identity-based lateral movement. They also involve the abuse of identity providers and tokens. Ensure that these threats relate to real-world adversary tactics. /li li Drive the response and containment strategy. This is the R in ITDR. Turn detections into action. Use identity-system integrations and automated responses. Make sure there is human oversight for important action

Are you a fluent Czech speaker looking to build an international career while enjoying life in Greece? This is your opportunity to work remotely from anywhere in Greece and become part of a growing, multicultural customer support team.

Work where others vacation, and shape a lifestyle that truly inspires you.

Why Greece?
Greece offers an outstanding quality of life with sunshine, history, and natural beauty at every turn. Whether you prefer the dynamic city life of Athens or Thessaloniki, the island atmosphere of Crete, Rhodes, Corfu, or Santorini, or the relaxed elegance of Nafplio and Messinia, Greece gives you the freedom to choose how and where you live. As a Czech-Speaking Customer Support Specialist, you will be the main point of contact for customers, delivering professional, high-quality assistance and ensuring a smooth and positive customer experience across multiple channels.

  • Provide clear, friendly, and solution-oriented support
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through effective communication
  • Accurately document customer interactions and follow internal procedures
  • Collaborate with an international team to maintain service excellence

  • Native or fluent Czech speaker
  • Good level of English for internal communication
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Customer-focused mindset with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Previous customer support experience is an advantage, but not required

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Relocation package to support your move to Greece
  • Fully remote role within Greece
  • Full training and structured onboarding
  • Supportive, international working environment
  • Long-term career development and growth opportunities

If you're ready to grow your career while living in one of Europes most beautiful and inspiring countries, this opportunity is waiting for you.

Apply now and start your Greek journey.

title: Vulnerability Management Engineer
original_description:
About Backblaze

Backblaze is the object storage leader in the open cloud movement, fueling customer success with cloud storage built purposefully to unlock budgets, unburden administrators, and unleash innovators. Together with our partners, we’re helping customers break free from the restrictive, overpriced legacy solutions that hold them back, and blaze forward with the full power of the open cloud in their hands.

Founded in 2007, we scaled the business with less than $3 million in outside funding until 2021, when we did a traditional IPO on the Nasdaq stock exchange. Today, Backblaze generates over $136M ARR and is the leading specialized storage cloud, managing over three billion gigabytes of data storage for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

But while there is a lot to celebrate in our past, there is almost as much opportunity ahead of us. We’re seeking a Vulnerability Management Engineer to join our team!

About the Role

The Vulnerability Management Engineer drives risk-based vulnerability and exposure management across infrastructure, applications, cloud services, endpoints, and software dependencies. The role combines vulnerability data, asset and configuration intelligence, application-security testing, threat intelligence, and AI-assisted analysis to determine whether vulnerabilities are reachable, exploitable, and likely to represent an imminent organizational threat.

Key Responsibilities

  • Correlate threat intelligence and vulnerability findings with asset inventory, software configuration, system configuration, application testing, network exposure, ownership, and business criticality.
  • Assess exploitability and reachability rather than relying on vulnerability severity alone.
  • Incorporate exploit prediction, known exploitation, open-source threat intelligence, adversary activity, and environmental context into prioritization.
  • Determine whether exposure requires immediate incident response or remediation under established operational objectives.
  • Use AI-assisted workflows to ingest and correlate vulnerability intelligence against the organization's actual technology configuration while independently validating conclusions.
  • Partner with Red Team to validate practical exploitability of significant vulnerabilities.
  • Identify compensating controls such as configuration changes, access restrictions, segmentation, or filtering when immediate patching is impractical.
  • Automate vulnerability ingestion, analysis, prioritization, remediation tracking, mitigation, and verification where appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise vulnerability or exposure management.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure, applications, cloud, containers, networking, and software dependencies.
  • Experience interpreting vulnerability intelligence and assessing practical exploitability.
  • Knowledge of risk-based prioritization techniques including CVSS, exploit prediction, known-exploitation intelligence, and environmental context.
  • Experience correlating vulnerability, asset, configuration, SAST, DAST, SCA, endpoint, or related security data.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, or data analysis.
  • Familiarity with continuous exposure management, attack-path analysis, AI-assisted analysis, or automated mitigation is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE D3FEND, and STRIDE.
  • Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, MITRE ATLAS and MAESTRO.

At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you're reading. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Learning, developing, and growing are key parts of our culture. We're eager to meet people who believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in various ways. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Backblaze Employee Privacy Notice.
