title: Senior Product Designer (Full Remote - Italy)
original_description:
Our Vision & Products

EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Product Designer to join our growing design team and help shape the future of AI companionship.

You’ll work across multiple product surfaces, including conversational experiences, character creation, monetization flows, growth experiences, interactive features, and emerging product areas still being defined.

You’ll work closely with our Product Design Lead, Product Managers, and Engineers to solve complex product problems, explore new opportunities, and help define the next generation of consumer AI experiences.

We’re looking for someone with strong product judgment, technical fluency, excellent communication, and the ability to contribute original ideas that raise the bar.

Your Responsibilities

Product Design

  • Own end-to-end design across multiple product areas from concept through delivery

  • Translate complex product and technical challenges into intuitive, high-quality user experiences

  • Balance speed, experimentation, and craft across fast-moving initiatives

  • Design for engagement, retention, monetisation, and conversion at scale

  • Create and iterate on visual content (image + video) to support product exploration, in-product experiences, and marketing/growth surfaces

Product Thinking & Innovation

  • Contribute original product ideas and creative concepts

  • Identify opportunities beyond the immediate brief

  • Help shape new features and interaction patterns through proactive exploration

  • Push ideas further through experimentation and thoughtful challenge

We value designers who don’t just execute; we want people who actively contribute ideas that surprise, inspire, and unlock new opportunities.

Technical & Workflow Fluency

  • Work confidently across modern design, prototyping, and creative tooling

  • Experiment with new workflows that improve speed and output quality

  • Operate comfortably close to engineering constraints and implementation realities

  • Use emerging tools thoughtfully to accelerate exploration and execution

  • Use AI image/video generation tools as part of the design process

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Communicate design reasoning clearly and confidently

  • Defend ideas thoughtfully

  • Push back when needed

  • Collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Leadership

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Strong experience designing high-quality consumer digital products

  • Excellent product thinking and interaction design

  • Strong technical fluency and comfort working with AI tools

  • Strong prototyping skills — able to choose the right approach and fidelity (e.g., design tools vs. code-based prototypes) based on the question being tested

  • Exceptional communication and collaboration skills

  • High design taste and strong visual judgment

  • Confidence operating independently in ambiguous, fast-moving environments

  • High ownership and strong decision-making ability

Soft Skills

Succinct, high-trust communicator — communicates ideas and tradeoffs clearly, quickly, and openly; respects others’ time

⚡ Speed-first operator — keeps momentum high; removes blockers quickly

High-agency, product-minded — strong point of view, takes ownership, and drives decisions in ambiguity

Collaborative and direct — aligns cross-functionally, pushes back thoughtfully, and keeps teams unblocked

AI-obsessed & workflow-innovative — stays at the bleeding edge of AI in design; constantly improves tools, prompts, and processes to increase output quality and velocity

Impact-first prioritiser — ruthlessly prioritises high-leverage work and says no to low-impact distractions

Comfortable working with NSFW product experiences

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on AI-native, conversational, social, or highly interactive products

  • Experience across creative tooling, content workflows, or technical experimentation

  • Experience designing monetisation / subscription products

  • Experience designing for NSFW / adult user experiences

  • Motion, systems, or front-end-adjacent experience

We Love Portfolios That Show

  • Strong consumer product case studies

  • Clear evidence of product thinking

  • Technical depth and prototyping capability

  • Original thinking and experimentation

  • High visual craft

  • Real shipped work

  • Clear ownership and measurable impact

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Why EverAI?

Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍ Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Cursor, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

* Compensation: Our salary ranges are set based on role level, scope, location, and market data, and applied consistently regardless of candidate background or negotiation history. The final offer within the published range reflects assessed experience and scope.

Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

External Referral Program

Know someone who could be a great fit for this role? You can refer them through the EverAI External Referral Program and earn a bonus of up to 2,500 USD if they’re hired. Submit a referral here.

title: Full Stack Developer (Frontend-Focused) - Brazil
original_description:
Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed.

You'll work directly with our design and consulting teams to turn mockups into fast, accessible, well-crafted websites for clients across a range of industries.

What You'll Do

  • Build custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks (ACF or React-based), and plugins from provided designs

  • Translate mockups into responsive, accessible frontend code using HTML, CSS/SASS, and modern JavaScript

  • Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and fix frontend and backend issues across a variety of CMS platforms

  • Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations

  • Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals

  • 3+ years building and customizing WordPress sites, including Gutenberg block development (ACF or React-based blocks)

  • Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently

  • Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work

  • Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git)

  • Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment

  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React or Angular

  • Laravel or Symfony

  • Docker and Linux environment familiarity

  • AWS or other cloud platform exposure

Why Brafton

100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries.

Compensation

Plus commission

Additional Information

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
original_description:
Compensation: $1000 per task

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases,

Remote, Brazil, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +3 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

 

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager to own and elevate Yuno's technical customer relationships across Latin America. title: Key Account Manager Danish Market Native Speaker Copenhagen
original_description:
Packmatic is the leading digital platform for packaging procurement. We connect companies with a Europe-wide network of packaging suppliers â fast, transparent and data-driven.

With Packa, we have built a new all-in-one solution for intelligent packaging management: companies run their packaging 100% digitally, cut packaging costs and meet sustainability requirements such as PPWR or EUDR without the usual headache.

Together, we are changing how packaging is designed, sourced and managed â for more efficiency, more sustainability and more impact. Backed by strong investors and driven by an ambitious team, we are growing fast â and we are looking for people who want to shape that growth with us.

\n


What you can expect at Packmatic
  • Ownership. You run your market independently, backed by a highly motivated team that has your back â wherever you work from.
  • Impact. A role that visibly shapes Packmatic's international growth.
  • Creative freedom. You work directly with the founding team and have the freedom to build your own playbook from day one.
  • Flexibility. 100% remote, combined with customer visits across Denmark and the Nordics.
  • Leadership. An inspiring vision, experienced serial founders at the helm and leading investors behind us.
  • Recognition and commitment. We believe in fair pay, and you get a clear path to grow and develop with us.


Your tasks
  • You are our visionary. You build our business in Denmark â from first contact to signed contract. You work hand in hand with our SDRs, keep finding new ways to create pipeline and share what works with the team.
  • You are our hunter. You go after new customers proactively and consistently, and you present our platform to every stakeholder â from procurement and technology through to top management.
  • You are our networker. You steer complex buying processes and manage stakeholders across departments with a sure touch.
  • You are the driving force behind every deal. You work closely with the German team on demos, technical questions and proposals.
  • You are our ambassador. You are the face of Packmatic in the Danish market and hold your own with buyers and senior management alike.
  • You are our sales driver. You own an annual target of EUR 3â4 million in new packaging revenue. By growing your accounts strategically, you spot and convert up- and cross-selling potential â and make a visible contribution to our growth.


What you bring
  • You are a sales professional. You have at least 5 years of experience in technical B2B sales, ideally in SaaS or an industrial environment.
  • You are our market expert. You know the Danish market inside out, you are based in or around Copenhagen, and you build lasting customer relationships â culturally on point and close to your customers.
  • You are a doer. You work independently, take decisions and get things done without waiting to be asked.
  • You are a navigator. You think in a structured way, find your way through complex setups and move confidently across every decision-making level.
  • You are a communication specialist. You are a native Danish speaker and fluent in English.
  • You are a road warrior. You are flexible, happy to travel and work closely with our Berlin team (on site roughly every 8 weeks).


\n

title: Full-Time Registered Dietitian
original_description:
LifestyleRx is a precision lifestyle medical practice, combining medical expertise with a team-based approach including one-to-one and group medical visits, nutritional coaching, education, and digital tracking. We are currently looking for a Registered Dietitian to join our team.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Working collaboratively with a physician-led health team.

  • Completing Nutrition Assessments using the LifestyleRx tools and systems.

  • Meeting with individuals via telephone or video calls from home.

  • Creating nutrition goals with individuals and providing ongoing support and accountability in cooperation with a health-care team.

  • Scheduling nutrition and coaching sessions.

  • Documenting appointments in our electronic medical records system.

  • Monitoring digital tracking used with individual health programs.

title: Technology Sales Specialist - Japanese And Mandarin
original_description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In this role

You will manage a portfolio of technology support service contracts, driving renewals, identifying new business opportunities, and helping education and nonprofit customers maximize the value of their technology investments. This role requires an independent, results-driven sales professional who can manage a book of business, build customer relationships, negotiate contract terms, address objections, and drive deals to closure. You will partner with account managers, customer success professionals, and internal sales support teams to develop sales strategies, maintain accurate forecasts, and achieve renewal and revenue goals. The ideal candidate brings technology sales or account management experience and fluency in both Japanese and Mandarin.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, owning the end-to-end sales process for service renewals and new contract opportunities.

  • Drive on-time renewals, improve renewal rates, and recapture previously lost or at-risk business.

  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships and generate incremental revenue through technology support services.

  • Engage directly with customers to understand business needs, address objections, discuss contract structures, and negotiate commercial terms.

  • Partner with account managers, customer success professionals, and internal deal support teams to develop proposals, scope services, and advance opportunities.

  • Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, update forecast commentary, track deal progress, and communicate risks and opportunities to management.

  • Develop and execute account and portfolio strategies to prioritize high-potential opportunities and achieve sales targets.

  • Build relationships with customer stakeholders, including decision-makers and influencers, to understand business priorities and support purchasing decisions.

  • Communicate the business value of technology support services and align proposed solutions with customer objectives.

  • Develop and execute close plans, coordinate stakeholder engagement, and proactively resolve blockers to move deals toward completion.

  • Analyze account performance, customer feedback, and portfolio opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and sales outcomes.

  • Collaborate with sales, services, and marketing partners to identify customer needs, strengthen the sales pipeline, and support long-term account growth.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Marketing, or a related field.

  • At least 3 years of technology-related sales or account management experience.

  • At least 3 years of solution sales or consulting services sales experience.

  • Fluency in both Japanese and Mandarin, with strong written and verbal communication skills in a customer-facing environment.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage customer accounts independently and drive opportunities through the full sales cycle.

  • Experience handling customer objections, discussing commercial terms, and supporting contract negotiations.

  • Strong customer relationship management, communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple active opportunities, prioritize competing deadlines, and maintain accurate pipeline and sales forecasts.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify sales opportunities and recommend actions to overcome obstacles.

  • Ability to work remotely while collaborating effectively with account teams and internal stakeholders.

  • Must be located on the U.S. West Coast and able to work within established business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling technology support services, enterprise support agreements, or consulting services.

  • Experience managing contract renewals, renewal negotiations, and customer retention or recapture initiatives.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, enterprise software, and business technology solutions.

  • Experience supporting education, nonprofit, or other mission-driven organizations.

  • Experience managing a defined book of business and developing account or territory plans.

  • Demonstrated success meeting renewal, revenue, or customer retention targets, supported by measurable results.

  • Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity qualification.

  • Experience partnering with account executives, customer success teams, and deal desk or commercial operations teams.

  • Familiarity with structured enterprise sales methodologies and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Must be fluent in Japanese and Mandarin

Location: Remote(West Coast Hours)

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital or familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact .

title: Deployment Strategist  - Canada
original_description:
Why Ethicrithm?

Ethicrithm Inc. is a Palantir partner serving clients across North America. We specialize in integrating and structuring enterprise data, developing AI-driven solutions, and implementing intelligent operating systems with Palantir Foundry and AIP. We deliver secure, scalable, and impactful solutions that optimize business operations and drive measurable returns on investment, impact and results. We’re building a high-performance team of humble, helpful, and client-oriented teammates.

The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, you own the successful delivery and real-world impact of Palantir Foundry for our clients. Your role is to deeply understand clients’ most critical operational problems and translate those needs into workflows and capabilities that drive meaningful outcomes.

You work closely with client teams across the organization—from frontline operators to executive leaders—to understand how decisions are made, what the data reveals, and how Foundry can be applied to improve those decisions in practice. You guide deployments from early problem framing through execution, ensuring solutions are adopted, trusted, and impactful.

You excel in ambiguous, fastmoving environments, creating clarity by forming hypotheses, testing assumptions, and iterating quickly to move clients toward their highest value outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Scoping: Engage with stakeholders through workshops and interviews across the client’s business to deeply understand their business processes, friction points, strategic goals, and data landscape.
  • Solution Design: Develop capabilities that deliver impact in the client’s business by determining how Foundry can be implemented against business problems.
  • Deployment Governance: Oversee the governance framework for deployments, ensuring shared understanding of objectives, scope, timelines, and execution approach. Track progress, surface risks, and communicate value delivered throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Driving User Adoption: Drive user adoption through training, friction removal, and sustained partnership with end users.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build relationships with executives, operators, and technical leads; align teams on shared goals; and navigate competing priorities to keep delivery focused on outcomes.
  • Value Realization: Define and measure the impact of deployments and demonstrate the value delivered to clients.
  • Services Feedback: Surface insights from the field to provide tangible recommendations on Ethicrithm’s practices.
  • Field Engagement: Go onsite to meet with client operators, understand the critical questions they need to answer, and locate their highest-impact problems firsthand.
  • Data Identification: Identify the relevant datasets that matter most by deeply engaging with client workflows and understanding how data connects to the decisions clients are trying to improve.
  • Growth and Expansion: Scope out potential engagements in new industries and expanding geographies, helping to shape where Ethicrithm goes next.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Technical Aptitude: A strong understanding of software and data concepts. You can write code that works, architect solutions, and solve technical problems alongside Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs).
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically about client challenges and develop innovative solutions
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of business principles and the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Project Management: Proven project management skills, including experience developing and executing project plans
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to identify and address potential roadblocks
  • Client-Facing Skills: Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport with clients. Empathy and a desire to understand client needs
  • Ability to travel in Canada and the US (approx 5% travel) without the need for Visas or other documents requiring processing time

Preferred with flexibility for the exceptional candidates

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics or related field
  • Experience designing and delivering technical solutions
  • Deep experience working with data (analysis, modeling, data engineering)
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry / AIP
  • Experience with Python and/or TypeScript

Research shows candidates from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply unless they meet every listed criteria. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

Total Rewards

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and career growth. This includes a competitive salary, equity participation to share in our success, a retirement contribution program, and health benefits. Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with four weeks of vacation, five personal days, and the flexibility of working from home. We also provide ample opportunities for career advancement within our dynamic and growing organization.

Ethicrithm Inc. is committed to employment equity and building an inclusive workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals, including those from equity-deserving groups. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and applicable human rights legislation, accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process. Please contact us if you require accommodation at any stage.

Ethicrithm uses artificial intelligence to assist in analyzing applications as part of our recruitment process.

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Engineer (Brazil)
original_description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Intel team runs at the intersection of intelligence analysts, back-end systems, and AI. This role sits at that intersection. Its mandate is to make TRM's intelligence collection meaningfully better with AI. You'll work directly alongside our intel analysts to understand how they collect and act on intelligence, then build the AI-powered products, tooling, and infrastructure that let them do it faster and at greater scale.

We're looking for a senior engineer with genuine product sense, someone who can sit with a semi-technical analyst, see past the surface-level request, and identify the highest-impact, scalable thing to build. The failure mode we're explicitly hiring against is an engineer who rapidly ships a pile of narrow automations that pick at minor annoyances but don't move the needle. We want sticky, real products that advance the mission.

This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to stay deeply technical while also shaping what gets built, not just how.

The impact you’ll have here:

  • Embed directly with our intel analysts to deeply understand their goals, constraints, and workflows, then translate those into technical solutions with clear success criteria.

  • Identify the highest-leverage opportunities to improve intelligence collection — bringing a product lens to prioritization, not just an engineering one — and productize your work so it's adopted and durable.

  • Design, build, and own AI-powered internal applications end-to-end: back-end services, APIs, data storage, the back-end infrastructure they run on, and user-facing interfaces.

  • Develop custom agentic solutions leveraging state-of-the-art models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) to augment and scale intelligence workflows.

  • Own projects end-to-end — technical design, architecture, scoping, delivery, iteration, and ongoing support.

  • Build reliable, scalable systems on which analysts depend day to day.

  • Continuously evaluate impact and iterate based on real outcomes for the Intel team.

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years full-stack software engineering experience building scalable web applications, services, and APIs

  • Strong product sense — the ability to zoom out, spot the highest-impact and most scalable solution, and ship it as something people actually keep using. This is the bar-raising skill for this role.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript, with strong back-end and systems engineering skills.

  • Experience building backend systems, working with various datastores such as (Postgres/pgvector, Pinecone, Redis) and designing APIs.

  • Demonstrated curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools and applications - using modern AI models, agentic IDEs, or building AI-enabled workflows or prototypes.

  • A high degree of ownership and initiative, with the ability to operate independently in ambiguous problem spaces

  • Strong communication and the ability to build trust with semi-technical stakeholders (our analysts) and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

We're deliberately open on background: a strong back-end/systems engineer and a strong data/ML-leaning engineer can both thrive here. Seniority, sharpness, drive, and product sense matter more than a specific profile.

About the Team:

  • The team operates on a weekly sprint schedule. Individuals on the team are tasked to lead projects as technical anchors, and given a chance to grow and take ownership according to their level and goals. We work closely with our internal stakeholders to deliver impactful features to our internal customers and the company.

  • The team’s culture is built on psychological safety wherein team members build rapport and trust-based relationships with teammates, hold each other accountable and to a high bar, collaborate extensively, and have lots of fun along the way.

  • The team’s timezone is a mix of EST and PST with at least 6 hours of overlap with PST (8 am to 2 pm PST)

  • On-Call: We have an on-call rotation that is specific to internal tools. In this role, the internal tools engineer is responsible for triaging customer support requests from specific Slack channels pertaining to internal tools.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

title: Senior Accountant (Managed Accounts Receivable)
original_description:
Position Summary

Manage accounts receivable for managed hotel properties, including guest and direct-bill ledgers, aging and collections, travel-agent commission activity, payment discrepancies and reconciliation between property management and payment systems.

Job Details

  • Work Setup: Work from home
  • Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila Time)
  • Holidays: U.S. corporate holiday calendar

Responsibilities

  • Review hotel guest ledgers, accounts receivable ledgers and direct-bill balances to identify unresolved items and collection risks.
  • Monitor receivable aging, follow up on outstanding balances and resolve account allocation and payment discrepancies, as well as apply payments received in the PMS against the proper folios.
  • Review direct-billing requests, coordinate account setup and retain the appropriate approvals and documentation.
  • Support weekly travel agent commission processing through TACS and relevant travel-program administration, including file uploads and supporting records.
  • Reconcile property management system activity against the CorPay Extranet and research payment differences to resolution.
  • Process or support CLC billing, invoicing and payment application for assigned accounts.
  • Work closely with property sales, finance and operations teams on AR cleanup, payment disputes and account-level requests.
  • Oversee all cash and credit card reconciliation, write-off and balance sheet submissions for applicable revenue related accounts. Will also handle chargeback disputes.
  • Maintain reconciliations, audit trails and accurate updates for assigned AR portfolios.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in accounts receivable, collections, direct billing or account reconciliation supporting multiple business units.
  • Ability to investigate ledgers, payment applications and aging, explain discrepancies, and communicate with operating teams.
  • Solid Excel capability and experience with an ERP, AR or property accounting platform.
  • Strong organization, sound judgment and attention to confidential financial information.

Nice to Have

  • Hospitality or managed-property AR experience.
  • Experience with Opera PMS
  • Experience supporting direct billing approval workflows and travel-agent commissions.
  • Experience with Airline or Cruise line AR workflows

title: Desarrollador Full Stack Java / React - Remoto
original_description:
Este puesto son 2 vacantes que aseguran la calidad técnica en las aplicaciones de uno de nuestros clientes del sector financiero. Te sumarás a una misión crítica de modernización tecnológica y arquitectura. El proyecto central consiste en migrar sistemas legados desde .NET hacia Spring Boot y NestJS. Tu desafío principal será diseñar e implementar microservicios escalables usando arquitectura hexagonal sin afectar el negocio.

Key Responsibilities

Estrategia Técnica y Desarrollo
  • Diseñar arquitecturas backend robustas entregando microservicios y APIs REST escalables en Java y Node.js bajo el estándar hexagonal.
  • Implementar aplicaciones frontend de alto rendimiento construyendo interfaces responsivas y accesibles en React con TypeScript.
  • Optimizar el procesamiento de la información modelando e indexando estructuras de datos complejas en SQL Server y MongoDB.
Calidad y Gobernanza
  • Garantizar la estabilidad técnica del producto construyendo coberturas de pruebas unitarias exhaustivas para frontend y backend.
  • Acelerar los ciclos de desarrollo de software operando asistentes de inteligencia artificial bajo estrictos protocolos de revisión de código y seguridad.
Operaciones y Entrega Continuas
  • Asegurar la disponibilidad de las versiones en etapas tempranas ejecutando y resolviendo fallos en los pipelines de despliegue hacia los ambientes de desarrollo.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Imprescindibles
  • Dominar Java 17+ y Spring Boot para la creación de APIs REST y despliegues con arquitectura hexagonal en producción.
  • Implementar servicios backend utilizando Node.js, NestJS y TypeScript con inyección de dependencias.
  • Desarrollar interfaces de usuario con React y TypeScript, traduciendo prototipos de Figma a código responsive.
  • Modelar y consultar bases de datos en SQL Server, incluyendo procedimientos almacenados y optimización.
  • Utilizar asistentes de IA como Claude para el desarrollo, aportando contexto y revisando críticamente el código generado.
  • Escribir pruebas unitarias efectivas empleando JUnit y Mockito para el backend, y Jest o Vitest para el frontend.
  • Gestionar versiones de código con Git mediante pull requests pequeños y trazables en Jira.
  • Construir imágenes de contenedores con Docker a partir de plantillas para su ejecución local.
  • Proponer soluciones y refinar requerimientos técnicos conversando directamente con el Product Owner, Business Analyst y Tech Lead.
Deseables
  • Aportar experiencia previa en la industria financiera, específicamente en áreas de pagos, core bancario o cumplimiento.
  • Operar bases de datos documentales utilizando MongoDB en ambientes de producción.
  • Participar en migraciones de sistemas legados construidos en .NET hacia los nuevos estándares en Spring Boot o NestJS.
  • Mantener y realizar mejoras en proyectos legados existentes que estén desarrollados con Angular.
  • Diseñar servicios que requieran un rendimiento extremo empleando el lenguaje Go.
  • Entender a nivel conceptual plataformas de orquestación como Kubernetes (RKE, OpenShift) y mensajería con Kafka.
  • Integrar aplicaciones modernas con sistemas core bancarios operando bajo la plataforma IBM AS/400.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
original_description:
We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to be the founding member of Burq's Platform team — the function that owns our engineering foundations: infrastructure, security, CI/CD, and reliability.

Right now, our infrastructure runs on AWS with a combination of ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and Step Functions. We have a strong contractor advising us, but we need a full-time engineer who can own this domain, execute on a significant infrastructure roadmap, and make every product team faster as a result.

This is a high-leverage, high-ownership role. You will be designing and building the platform that Burq scales on for the next several years.

Infrastructure

  • Own and execute the AWS account split — separating production, staging, and development into clean isolated environments
  • Lead the Aurora DB production migration with support from our infrastructure advisor
  • Manage and evolve our ECS Fargate services, RDS clusters, ElastiCache, SQS queues, and ALB configuration
  • Own Terraform — infrastructure as code, not click-ops

Security & Access

  • Harden IAM — developer permission sets, production access controls, least-privilege enforcement
  • Audit and lock down public S3 buckets
  • Enable AWS Config and Security Hub across all accounts
  • Own SOC 2 Type 2 readiness maintenance in partnership with Sprinto
  • Coordinate external penetration test cadence

CI/CD & Developer Experience

  • Own and improve our GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines — build times, test reliability, deployment velocity
  • Build out PR stack environments so product teams can test independently
  • Drive the local development stack initiative — Docker Compose-based environments that replace shared preprod
  • Integrate AI-assisted testing into the CI pipeline

Observability & Reliability

  • Own CloudWatch dashboards spanning ALB, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and target group health
  • Lead post-incident reviews and ensure every incident produces a runbook entry
  • Partner with product teams to distribute platform work as a standing sprint allocation — not a separate queue

Requirements

  • 5+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years focused on infrastructure and platform engineering
  • Deep AWS expertise — ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, Lambda, account architecture
  • Terraform proficiency — you write infrastructure as code and know why it matters
  • Strong CI/CD background — GitHub Actions, deployment pipelines, environment management
  • Security-minded — you know how to harden systems without creating friction for product engineers
  • Experience with observability tooling — CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Investing in you 🙏

  • Competitive salary
  • Medical coverage
  • Access to educational resources and courses

title: FP&A Specialist
original_description:
Localpayment is a fintech company specializing in local and cross-border payment solutions for emerging markets. Our platform enables global companies to accept payments in local currencies through native methods in each country, facilitating their international expansion.

In 2024, Localpayment entered into a strategic partnership with Aleph Group, a global technology and digital media company. This collaboration enhances our capabilities and reach, combining robust payment infrastructure with a broader digital ecosystem.

We are looking for a Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A)to support financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis across the organization. This role will play a key part in providing data-driven insights, improving financial visibility, and supporting strategic decision-making in a fast-growing, multi-country fintech environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support the preparation of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-term financial plans.
  • Develop and maintain financial models to analyze business performance and support strategic initiatives.
  • Monitor financial performance, identifying variances between actuals and forecasts, and provide actionable insights.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Finance, Operations, Product, Sales) to understand key drivers and improve financial outcomes.
  • Prepare management reports and dashboards for senior leadership, including KPI tracking and performance metrics.
  • Analyze revenue, costs, margins, and unit economics in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
  • Support cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis in coordination with Treasury.

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in FP&A, Finance, Consulting, or related roles, with at least 1 year within the fintech environment.
  • Experience working with financial models, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.
  • Experience in high-volume, multi-currency environments is a strong plus.
  • Advanced Excel skills (mandatory) and experience with BI tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience working with ERP or financial planning tools.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements (P&L, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet).
  • Business-oriented mindset with strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English (written and spoken).

title: Enterprise Account Manager, SLED
original_description:
Headquarters: Remote Chicago, IL | Remote Detroit, MI | Remote Columbus, OH | Remote Indianapolis, IN

BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

Identify, generate, qualify, and close new business for customers and prospects in a defined territory.  Responsible for managing the full sales lifecycle, building the go-to-market plan (including direct and indirect business). 

LOCATION: This is a remote role but due to accounts/territory covered candidates need to reside in the Great Lakes region (IL, MI, OH, IN, WI) ideally near an airport for ease of travel. 

Customer Segment: Higher Education (Public Sector)

What You’ll Do

  • Develop new and existing accounts within defined territory. Prior SLED experience required. 
  • Establish and deliver a sales strategy which outlines a roadmap to quota attainment
  • Sales forecasting, lead generation, prospecting, and strategic relationship development
  • Upsell ‘New Product’ to existing customers.
  • Work with assigned Account Executive – Enterprise Assist’s to intelligently cover and proactively hunt for Add-on opportunity within territory.
  • Maintain whitespace for all focus customers.
  • Partner closely with Vice President, SE’s, PM’s and wider POD to deliver strategic goals
  • Algin with Channel team and Channel Partners to deliver value to our customers and BeyondTrust wherever possible
  • Align with SDR team to proactively cover your total addressable market (focus and non-focus territory accounts)
  • Attend corporate trade shows and events
  • Maintain sales pipeline activity in Salesforce
  • Schedule and conduct product demonstrations and detailed presentations to prospects, customers and partners
  • Lead RFP responses for your accounts

What You’ll Bring

  • Must be located in the territory covered
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 8+ years’ sales experience with a demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding annual quota
  • Experience with enterprise software, IT services, SaaS, IoT or related managed services sales to global organizations
  • Experience with Salesforce
  • Able to command sales message and sale
  • Experience leveraging the channel to drive business
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to travel within region

Nice To Have

  • Prior experience selling PAM software solutions
  • Completed 2 professional sales training courses (Sandler, SPIN, DISC, TAS, or Miller)
  • Strategic Account Management

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com. 

#LI-JC1

title: Director, Information Security
original_description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity 

Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world. You will set the security strategy, own both corporate security (GRC, incident response, security awareness, vendor risk) and product security (application, cloud and infrastructure security, secure development lifecycle), and serve as the trusted voice on Carrot's security posture with executives, auditors, and enterprise customers.

Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.

What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership
  • Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)
  • Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance
  • Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards
  • Own the compliance portfolio, including SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and HIPAA, and prepare Carrot for additional frameworks such as ISO 27001 as the business requires
  • Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning
  • Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations
  • Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data
  • Build, coach, and grow the security team, balancing hands-on execution with delegation as the team scales
  • Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress
  • Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule
  • A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program
  • A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering
  • A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions
  • A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made
  • Faster, more consistent security reviews for Sales and Customer Success, with fewer escalations from enterprise customers
  • A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional frameworks the business prioritizes, such as ISO 27001

About You

You likely have:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in technology, including 5+ years in information security and at least 3 years leading security teams
  • A security certification such as CISSP or CISM
  • Experience leading the security function at a late-stage startup, scale-up, or public company
  • Working depth in healthcare data protection and privacy frameworks, including HIPAA, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA
  • Experience overseeing enterprise frameworks and audits such as SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001
  • Strong knowledge of application, network, and cloud security (AWS and Azure) and frameworks such as NIST CSF and OWASP
  • Experience running core security programs, including incident response, risk management, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and security awareness
  • Executive-level communication skills and confidence engaging customers and sales teams on security requirements
  • Experience managing budget and allocating resources across people, tools, and vendors

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience leading security through a major company event such as an IPO, acquisition, or large-scale audit cycle
  • A background in healthcare, digital health, or another highly regulated, high-trust environment
  • Experience leading security in a remote-first, globally distributed company
  • Familiarity with compliance automation platforms such as Drata
  • Experience building a security engineering practice alongside platform and infrastructure teams

 

Why This Role Matters

Members trust Carrot with some of the most personal information a person can share, often during some of the most meaningful moments of their lives. Protecting that trust is not a back-office function. It is what allows employers, health plans, and health systems to bring Carrot to millions of people worldwide.

As Carrot grows, security leadership shapes how we build, how we sell, and how we show up for customers. In this role, you will make security a strength that members and customers can see and rely on, and build a team that keeps raising the bar as the business scales.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their lives inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $188,000.00 - $245,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

title: Channel Account Manager
original_description:
Headquarters: AUS-Remote

About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) at Ping Identity plays a vital role in supporting the growth and success of the company's channel and alliances GTM. This role involves collaborating with the Partner ecosystem to develop and manage partnerships, help drive joint business development initiatives, and ensure effective communication and coordination with our channel partners.

The CAM will contribute to the expansion of Ping Identity's market reach and the achievement of revenue goals.

  • Reporting into the VP of Partnerships APJ, you will manage and support target partners across all Partner tiers helping to manage our partners across Australia and New Zealand.
  • Work closely with the sales team across Australia and New Zealand to support their regional GTM requirements
    • Important - You will ensure the Ping sales team are able to focus on finding, qualifying and closing opportunities with our partners - you act as the conduit between our sales team and our partners
  • Support and drive the development of joint value propositions with our partners.
  • Collaborate with partners to execute partner agreements and ensure other agreements are in place as required.
  • Assist in driving partner enablement, including the development of sales practices and training programs.
  • Help partners with deal registrations, portal access, program benefits etc.
  • Contribute to tracking partner performance against agreed-upon metrics, such as revenue targets and pipeline development.
  • Foster collaborative relationships with partners through ongoing engagement, communication, and business reviews.
  • Support the execution of marketing and demand generation activities with partners to drive brand awareness and lead generation.
  • Support the promotion and engagement with the Ping Partner program and related tools and processes.
  • Assist in coordinating and participating in joint business planning activities with partners.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure effective communication and coordination with partners.
  • Assist in ensuring partner success by monitoring delivery quality, customer satisfaction, and support.
  • Contribute to joint pursuits with partners, identifying and developing sales opportunities and impacting existing opportunities to close with the influence of Partners.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify new business opportunities and challenges

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • This role is based in Sydney or Melbourne.
    • Important - This role requires regular collaboration with Ping colleagues and partners, typically including multiple in-person meetings each week.
    • Additional partner or customer meetings may be required as the business needs dictate.
  • You have 3+ year’s experience managing partners and exposure to GSI & Advisory Partners would be a bonus. Alternatively, you have excelled in a Partner BDR/SDR function and are looking to move up in your career.
  • You have a good understanding of the Australia and New Zealand market.
  • You are currently working in the SaaS industry, but working in Cyber Security and SaaSwill move you right to the top of the list.
  • Understanding of channel sales strategies and partner ecosystems.
  • Ability to drive mutual business outcomes for both Ping and our Partners - this includes regular cadence, partner QBRs etc.
  • Good CRM opportunity hygiene (Salesforce preferred).
  • Strong organisational and coordination skills and the ability to work cross functionally with presales, marketing, professional services, customer success etc.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to changing priorities and responsibilities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel domestically as required and 1-2 international trips per year (US).
  • …and have fun and enjoy the ride working in a very high growth dynamic environment for a great company headquartered in Denver Colorado

Other:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com or other CRM systems.
  • Previous experience or exposure to channel sales, alliances management, or partner enablement is a must.
  • Interest in the software industry and identity access management sector.
  • Knowledge of marketing and demand generation practices.
  • Understanding of partner training and sales enablement processes.
  • Ability to analyse data and generate insights to drive partner performance.
  • Proactive and positive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ping-identity-channel-account-manager-1
