title: Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %
original_description:
Im Auftrag unseres Kunden Concordia AG suchen wir einen Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %

Darum CONCORDIA

Als Expertin für Gesundheit setzt sich die CONCORDIA für ein Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich Mitarbeitende wohlfühlen und verwirklichen können. Es ist geprägt von abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben, vielseitigen Teams und einem familiären Umgang. Zudem motivieren wir unsere Mitarbeitenden, sich weiterzuentwickeln und voranzukommen. Menschen, die Spass an der Arbeit haben und beruflich vorwärtskommen wollen, finden bei uns, was sie suchen: Jobs, die zu 100 % gesund sind.

Deine Vorteile

Ausgezeichnet von den Mitarbeitenden

Bereits 2016 und 2018 brillierte die CONCORDIA beim Swiss Arbeitgeber Award mit hervorragenden Ergebnissen. Im Jahr 2020 holten wir uns dann sogar den ersten Platz in der Kategorie für grosse Unternehmen mit mehr als 1000 Mitarbeitenden und im Jahr 2022 wurden wir mit dem zweiten Platz ausgezeichnet. Auch im Jahr 2025 dürfen wir mit gutem Recht festhalten, dass wir zu den allerbesten Arbeitgeberinnen der Schweiz gehören.

Senior Database Engineer (Oracle/PostgreSQL), 80–100 %

Werde Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, das gemeinsam eine moderne, skalierbare Datenbank- und Infrastrukturplattform gestaltet und betreibt. Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, gestaltest Architektur‑Entscheide und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Das erwartet dich

  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit dem Team den stabilen Betrieb, das Engineering und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Oracle- und PostgreSQL-Datenbankplattform sowohl im Daily Business als auch in Projekten und Releases.
  • Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Datenbank- und Data-Warehouse-Plattformen, bei der Migration von Oracle nach PostgreSQL und beim Ausbau unserer Datenbankplattformen in der Azure Cloud.
  • Du unterstützt das Team bei der Automatisierung, Performance-Analyse, Scripting, Monitoring und Logging.
  • Infrastructure as Code ist fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise: Du entwickelst unsere Automatisierung und Infrastruktur-Standards aktiv weiter. Gemeinsam treiben wir Themen wie deklarative Infrastruktur, versionierte Changes und reproduzierbare Deployments voran – mit Tools wie Ansible, Terraform und CI/CD Pipelines.
  • Du unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung unseres Data Warehouse mit GoldenGate und DataHub und trägst dazu bei, manuelle Prozesse weiter zu automatisieren.
  • Austausch und Weiterentwicklung sind uns wichtig: Du hast regelmässig die Möglichkeit, User Groups und Hersteller-Events zu besuchen.
  • Dich erwartet ein starkes Team: 3 weitere DBAs und 8 Linux Engineers arbeiten mit engem technischem Austausch und kurzen Entscheidungswegen zusammen.
  • Wir sprechen CH-Mundart & Deutsch und sind mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche im Büro Luzern.
  • Du arbeitest in einem selbstorganisierten Umfeld mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, Flexibilität, Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb und Engineering von Oracle oder PostgreSQL Datenbanken.
  • Begeisterung für moderne Plattform- und Cloud-Technologien.
  • Erfahrung in der Automatisierung (z. B. Bash, Python, Ansible) und Freude daran, Dinge nachhaltig zu verbessern.
  • Eine strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und ein hoher Qualitätsanspruch.
  • Analytisches Denken, konzeptionelle Stärke und eine lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise.
  • Informatikausbildung oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Firmensprache) sowie die Fähigkeit, englische Dokumentationen sicher zu verstehen.

Nice to have / Dein Entwicklungspotenzial

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD und deklarativen Systemen.
  • Automatisierung mit Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Actions oder Chef.
  • Infrastruktur-Provisionierung mit Terraform (On-Prem & Azure).
  • Arbeitszeit: Du hast eine 41-Stunden-Woche und kannst Teilzeit oder flexibel arbeiten. Für ausgewählte Tätigkeiten kannst du regelmässig von zu Hause aus arbeiten.
  • Familienfreundlich: Voller Lohn während 14 Mutterschaftswochen. Zusatzbeiträge zu Kinder- und Ausbildungszulagen. Bis zu 90 % Kostenübernahme für die Fremdbetreuung deiner Kinder.
  • Aus- und Weiterbildung: Die CONCORDIA unterstützt interne und externe Weiterbildungen. Bei deiner Karriereplanung begleiten wir dich individuell.
  • Pensionskasse: Wir bieten dir eine äusserst attraktive, sichere Pensionskasse mit überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberbeiträgen und grosszügigen Leistungen.
  • Wertschätzung: In der CONCORDIA-Familie erlebst du Wertschätzung und Teamgeist.
  • Versicherungen: Die CONCORDIA übernimmt die Lohnabzüge für Lohnausfallversicherungen (Krankheit und Unfall) und versichert dich grosszügig.

Dein nächster Schritt

Hast du weitere Fragen zu dieser Stelle? Jan Madera, Teamleiter Systemengineering, Telefon +41 41 228 08 63, hilft dir gerne weiter. Christoph freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

HR-Berater

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
original_description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

title: Data Engineer
original_description:
Krijg jij energie van data die gewoon klopt, processen die soepel draaien en code die je zelf schrijft? Als Data Engineer zorg je dat de datastromen achter Prijsvrij Vakanties en D-reizen elke dag betrouwbaar hun werk doen. Je beheert en verbetert onze databases, pipelines en koppelingen, bouwt nieuwe oplossingen en werkt mee aan de doorontwikkeling van ons datalandschap, onder andere met Microsoft Fabric en AI. Zo help jij het hele bedrijf slimmere keuzes te maken, waar uiteindelijk elke klant van profiteert. ✈️

Wat ga je precies doen?

  • Je beheert en verbetert onze bestaande datastromen, stored procedures en jobs;

  • Je bouwt nieuwe pipelines van bron tot bestemming;

  • Je schrijft en optimaliseert complexe SQL-queries voor analyses, rapportages en databeheer;

  • Je waarborgt de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van data binnen onze systemen;

  • Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen in onze data- en BI-architectuur en werkwijze;

  • Je werkt samen met teamleden aan automatiseringen en andere technische en analytische projecten;

  • Je zet AI in waar het waarde toevoegt, bijvoorbeeld voor geautomatiseerde analyses en monitoring van onze processen;

  • Je ontwikkelt mee aan koppelingen en tools, ook in andere programmeertalen zoals Go.

Dit krijg jij:
De allerbeste deal! De reis van jouw leven met een positie in een informele organisatie, waar harde werkers het verschil maken voor onze klanten. De mogelijkheid om je intern te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij ontvangen je met open armen in een hecht en gezellig team, waar je samen met je collega’s bijdraagt aan onze missie: een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs!

 

  • Een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

  • 25 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime) en 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via Nationale Nederlanden;

  • Korting op je eigen vakanties én Friends & Family-korting om weg te geven;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer enkele reis;

  • Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden via My Academy;

  • Een moderne werkplek in het bruisende hart van 's-Hertogenbosch;

  • Office gym, een handig fietsplan en collectiviteitskorting bij CZ;

  • Gezelligheid gegarandeerd met onze vrijdagmiddagborrels, Bossche bollen als er iets te vieren is én maandelijks een padeltoernooi.


Jij (gaat op vakantie en) neemt mee:

  • Een afgeronde wo-opleiding in een technische of analytische richting;

  • 2 tot 5 jaar werkervaring als data engineer, bij voorkeur in een commerciële organisatie;

  • Sterke kennis van SQL en relationele databases;

  • Ervaring met het bouwen én beheren van stored procedures, jobs en datastromen;

  • Ervaring met een programmeertaal, en je vindt het leuk om nieuwe talen zoals Go te leren;

  • Ervaring met Git en versiebeheer;

  • Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd, en schakelt makkelijk bij ad-hoc vragen;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Je woont in de regio Den Bosch en haalt energie uit samenwerken met collega’s op kantoor.


Ready for take-off?

Klaar om samen met ons verder te bouwen aan een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs? We maken graag kennis met je! Nog vragen? We zijn maar één belletje of WhatsAppje van je verwijderd: 06 45 49 13 03.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
original_description:
WHO WE ARE

Adikteev is an AdTech company that helps mobile app publishers grow their revenue through targeted advertising. We deliver personalized ads that drive users to install an app or re-engage with one they've stopped using. 

Our clients are mostly mobile gaming leaders but also span e-commerce, on-demand services, and entertainment apps. Recognized for 10+ years as one of the top mobile retargeting platforms, Adikteev now operates globally from Paris, San Francisco, Barcelona and Seoul and has grown to over 120 employees.

Beyond the business, Adikteev is consistently recognized as a great place to work. With an 18-nationality team, a 4.5-day work week, and a strong focus on inclusion, Adikteev is a place where people genuinely stay.

WHAT TEAM YOU WILL BE PART OF

You will join the backbone of Adikteev's infrastructure. This team ensures that all our systems run reliably, securely and at scale. They own the infrastructure, manage deployments and make sure our platform stays up and performant, even at millions of requests per second.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define Adikteev’s reliability strategy and technical roadmap across our multi-region AWS platform.

  • Lead the architecture, scalability, security, observability, and cost efficiency of infrastructure handling over 4 million requests per second.

  • Own high-severity incident response and drive measurable improvements through postmortems and operational best practices.

  • Partner with engineering teams to improve system design, automation, CI/CD, developer experience, and operational autonomy.

  • Lead complex technical initiatives, set engineering standards, and mentor senior engineers.

  • Own reliability decisions and ensure the right trade-offs between performance, delivery speed, infrastructure cost, and business impact.

WHO YOU ARE

You could be a great addition to our Engineering team if you have:


  • Extensive experience designing and operating large-scale, multi-region AWS infrastructure.

  • Proven track record improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of distributed systems.

  • Expert knowledge of Terraform, Infrastructure-as-Code, observability, Linux, networking, and performance troubleshooting.

  • Strong coding skills in at least two languages, with a focus on automation and maintainable tooling.

  • Experience leading complex incidents and driving lasting operational improvements.

  • Ability to set technical direction, influence across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate clearly.

  • Comfortable making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations and balancing technical and business priorities.

  • Calm, collaborative, and committed to blameless operations.

  • Fluent in English.

Please note that, to comply with employment regulations, applicants are required to maintain residency and be legally authorized to work in France, Spain or the European Union in order to be considered for this position.

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive salary between 90,000€ and 130,000€ OTE

We are committed to transparent compensation practices. The salary range shown reflects total On-Target Earnings (OTE), including base salary and a performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs. Final compensation will be tailored to each candidate’s background, experience, skills, and overall fit for the role.

PERKS AND BENEFITS*

  • Competitive Salary ;

  • Performance-based Quarterly bonus with transparent KPIs;

  • Longevity bonus every 2 years ;

  • 4 1/2 days work week (Fridays afternoon off) ;

  • “RTT” ;

  • Mental Health support ;

  • Flexible remote working policy ;

  • Regular team-life event / activity ;

  • Inclusive parental leave Policy.

*Most benefits are available to all employees. For remote team members based outside of France, benefits will be aligned with local laws and practices in your country of residence, ensuring support that’s both relevant and compliant wherever you are. 


OUR PROCESS

What to expect as you move through our hiring process:

  • HR Call with Mélanie, Talent Acquisition Partner,

  • Technical interview with Seiji and Alexandre, Staff Engineers,

  • Team fit Interview with Aldenis, VP of Engineering and Daniel, Engineering Team lead,

  • Final interview with Cédric, CTO, and Loïc, CPO.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the application process, please let us know. It will be handled confidentially by our HR and recruitment team.

OUR COMMITMENT

We’re proud that our team already spans 22+ nationalities, diverse talent and unique backgrounds, and we want it to grow even more. If this role appeals to you, we welcome your application, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. Not everyone gets through our hiring process, but your skills might be a great fit for another opportunity; now or in the future.

Adikteev is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees, candidates, vendors and clients, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital status, or military status.

original_description:
Über OOOVATION

OOOVATION entwirft und fertigt maßgeschneiderte Medaillen und Trophäen für Sportveranstaltungen, Unternehmen und Organisationen. Mit einem Team von 11 bis 50 Mitarbeitern mit Sitz in Frankreich expandiert das Unternehmen europaweit mit dem klaren Ziel, bis 2030 europäischer Marktführer für individuelle Auszeichnungen zu werden.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie treiben die Expansion von OOOVATION auf dem österreichischen Markt voran und bauen Beziehungen zu Event-Organisatoren und Organisationen auf, um die Marke in der Region zu etablieren.

Das bringen Sie mit

Sie bringen Erfahrung im Vertrieb oder Business Development mit und beherrschen Deutsch fließend.

Ihr Start bei OOOVATION

In den ersten Monaten bauen Sie Ihren Kundenstamm auf dem österreichischen Markt auf und etablieren die Marke bei lokalen Veranstaltern.

Sprachkenntnisse

  • Deutsch: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse oder Deutsch als Muttersprache sind erforderlich, idealerweise mit guten Kenntnissen des österreichischen Marktes.

  • Englisch: Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich.

  • Französisch: Grundkenntnisse sind wichtig, um die Kommunikation während der einmonatigen Einarbeitung an unserem Hauptsitz in Yssingeaux, Frankreich, zu erleichtern.

Perfekte Französischkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Wir suchen jedoch eine Person, die einfache Gespräche verstehen und sich während der Einarbeitung mit unserem französischen Team verständigen kann.

Langfristig bietet diese Position auch die Möglichkeit, weitere deutschsprachige Märkte wie Deutschland und die Schweiz zu entwickeln.

Vergütung

Das Gehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 33,600–50,600 per year.

Vorteile

  • Nutzen Sie ein Firmenhandy.

  • Ein Firmenlaptop wird bereitgestellt.

  • Profitieren Sie von der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.

  • Arbeiten Sie flexibel im Homeoffice.

  • Eine private Krankenversicherung ist enthalten.

  • Nutzen Sie die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten.

title: Robotics Diagnostics Engineer
original_description:
We are looking for a robotics diagnostics engineer who enjoys getting to the bottom of complex system issues. You will investigate unexpected behaviour in our autonomous drone-in-a-box system, combining log and code analysis with hands-on experiments on engineering systems and bench setups. Bridging support and engineering, you will turn field reports into clear explanations, actionable fix recommendations and practical mitigations.

Responsibilities

  • Own investigations into system issues from new bug reports through to actionable findings, working with support to capture symptoms, operating conditions and relevant logs

  • Assess issue severity with engineering, considering safety impact, system availability, affected versions and conditions, and uncertainty; escalate critical findings promptly
  • Give engineering clear evidence, reproduction steps and recommendations for fixes, and help verify that proposed changes address the underlying issue
  • Recommend and validate workarounds and mitigations with engineering, and give support clear guidance on their use, limitations and operational implications

Qualifications

  • Experience investigating complex software failures using logs, source code and systematic root-cause analysis
  • A practical approach to reproducing intermittent issues and designing experiments on engineering systems, bench setups or simulators
  • Clear written and verbal communication: you can explain evidence, uncertainty, safety and availability impact, and recommended next steps to engineering and support
  • Curiosity, persistence and ownership when tackling unfamiliar problems
  • A degree in computer science, robotics or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Bonus Points

  • Experience with drones, robotics and embedded software is a plus

100% · On-site

This position is for an on-site employee for our Zurich office.

title: Manufacturing Engineer - Industrialization & Production
original_description:
Sunflower Labs is an internationally operating company providing a fully autonomous, AI-powered drone security system built to protect commercial, industrial, and residential properties. Security that flies ahead of every threat.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Manufacturing Engineer to join our Manufacturing team and act as the technical bridge between R&D and Production.

You will take ownership of released product data and turn it into stable, documented, and efficient production processes. This includes DFM/DFA review, production readiness, assembly instructions and SOPs, tooling and test-process support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

We are seeking you, a professional with a strong foundation in manufacturing electronic or electromechanical products, hands-on technical troubleshooting, and practical programming or scripting used in production or test environments. Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, or similarly complex hardware is a plus.

Your Responsibilities

R&D to Production / Industrialization :

  • Own the transfer of released products, revisions, BOMs, drawings, specifications, and technical data from R&D into production.

  • Perform DFM/DFA reviews and identify issues affecting manufacturability, assembly, testing, quality, cost, or cycle time.

  • Provide structured manufacturing feedback to mechanical and electrical teams.

  • Define production readiness and ensure engineering changes are correctly implemented on the production floor.

  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and transition prototypes into repeatable production.

Production Documentation & Daily Support :

  • Create, approve, and continuously maintain assembly instructions, SOPs, test instructions, inspection instructions, and rework procedures.

  • Ensure production documentation always matches the latest released product revision.

  • Provide day-to-day technical support to technicians and remove process or tooling-related production blockers.

  • Troubleshoot assembly, test, fixture, tooling, and configuration issues and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Work with R&D when production issues require design, software, test, or documentation changes.

Tooling, Lean & Continuous Improvement :

  • Develop, improve, and maintain production fixtures, jigs, test setups, tools, and supporting scripts.

  • Improve assembly sequence, workstation layout, standard work, material flow, and production methods.

  • Reduce rework, waiting time, manual workarounds, process variation, and cycle time.

  • Apply Lean Manufacturing principles such as 5S, standard work, visual management, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Several years of hands-on experience in manufacturing engineering, production engineering, industrialization, NPI, or a similar role.

  • Practical experience manufacturing and troubleshooting electronic or electromechanical products.

  • Strong understanding of assembly processes, production tooling, fixtures, testing, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Ability to independently review drawings, tolerances, BOMs, specifications, and released engineering data.

  • Practical knowledge of DFM/DFA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem solving.

  • Programming or scripting skills sufficient to understand, modify, and debug production or test tools; Python or similar is a strong fit.

  • Experience creating and maintaining assembly instructions, SOPs, and controlled production documentation.

  • Ability to work independently across R&D and Production and take ownership of manufacturing readiness.

  • Good spoken and written English.

  • EU/EFTA citizenship or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to have :

  • Experience with robotics, drones, aerospace, automotive, or other complex hardware products.

  • Experience with both mechanical and electrical assemblies and production test systems.

  • Experience designing production fixtures, jigs, or test equipment.

  • Experience with FMEA, 8D, 5 Why, Lean, 5S, or Kaizen.

  • Experience with ERP/MRP or PLM systems such as Odoo, Aligni, or similar tools.

  • Basic German.

Benefits

  • Flexibility to work from home when tasks allow, without fixed weekly work-from-home days.

  • Comprehensive training on products and production procedures.

  • Hands-on experience with advanced drone and robotics technology.

  • On-site parking, occasional team lunches, and team events.


We are looking forward to receiving your detailed CV together with cover letter and certificates.

title: Sales Representative & Business Developer – Dutch Market
original_description:
Over OOOVATION

OOOVATION is een in Frankrijk geboren onderneming gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen en vervaardigen van op maat gemaakte medailles en trofeeën voor sportevenementen, bedrijven en grote organisaties. Met een duidelijke missie om tegen 2030 de Europese marktleider in aangepaste prijzen te worden, breidt de organisatie snel uit naar internationale markten zoals Nederland.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Sales Representative voor de Nederlandse markt ben je verantwoordelijk voor de uitbreiding en het beheer van het klantenbestand in dit specifieke segment. Je onderhoudt contacten met organisatoren van sportevenementen en bedrijven, introduceert de op maat gemaakte trofeeën en medailles, en begeleidt het volledige verkoopproces van de eerste kennismaking tot de uiteindelijke levering.

Wat de rol vraagt

Je brengt commerciële ervaring mee in een buitendienstfunctie en bezit sterke communicatieve vaardigheden om duurzame klantrelaties op te bouwen. Een resultaatgerichte aanpak en doorzettingsvermogen zijn essentieel om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen en de groeidoelstellingen te behalen.

Voldoe je niet aan elk enkel punt, maar herken je jezelf wel in het grootste deel van de profielschets? Reageer dan alsnog.

Voor deze functie is een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands essentieel. Engels is eveneens belangrijk. Daarnaast is een basiskennis van het Frans een groot pluspunt, zodat we tijdens de opleidingsperiode gemakkelijk met elkaar kunnen communiceren.

De functie is niet noodzakelijk gevestigd in Yssingeaux, Frankrijk. Je start met een opleidingsperiode van één maand op ons hoofdkantoor in Frankrijk om onze producten, werkwijze en bedrijfscultuur te leren kennen. Na deze opleiding ga je rechtstreeks aan de slag op de Nederlandse markt.

We zoeken iemand met ambitie, ondernemerschap en leiderschapskwaliteiten. Ons doel is niet alleen om de Nederlandse markt verder te ontwikkelen, maar ook om daar op termijn een lokaal team op te bouwen.

We zoeken daarom een toekomstige leider die bereid is om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, een team aan te sturen en een sleutelrol te spelen in de internationale groei van OOOVATION.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden

Je ontvangt een bedrijfstelefoon en een laptop van de zaak voor de uitvoering van je werkzaamheden.

De pensioenregeling is geregeld via een bedrijfspensioenregeling.

De regeling omvat daarnaast particuliere ziektekostenverzekering, thuiswerken en opties voor remote werken.

Salaris

Het salaris bedraagt EUR 2,500–4,500 per maand.

Jouw eerste maanden bij OOOVATION

In de eerste maanden maak je je de productlijnen van op maat gemaakte awards eigen en leg je de eerste contacten binnen de Nederlandse markt. Je bouwt een pipeline op en start met het binnenhalen van nieuwe opdrachten voor sportevenementen en organisaties.

title: Engineering Manager - Hands-on (CDI)
original_description:
🏗️ À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. Aujourd’hui, plus de 670 000 membres utilisent notre plateforme.

Quelques jalons : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée avec 5 M€ collectés en 5 secondes, puis plus de 20 M€ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

En 2025, Bricks a collecté 176 M€, soit +90 % en un an, tout en atteignant la rentabilité.

Derrière cette croissance, il y a un produit B2C régulé, des flux financiers réels, des enjeux forts de sécurité, de fiabilité et de cohérence des données. Ce qui part en production peut être utilisé par des milliers d’investisseurs dans les heures qui suivent.

Côté Engineering, on fonctionne avec une équipe autonome, proche du produit et du business. On attend de chacun qu’il comprenne les problèmes en profondeur, prenne des décisions et contribue directement à la qualité de ce qu’on construit.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoindras une équipe Engineering de 10 ingénieurs, avec un CTO qui code au quotidien. Côté Produit : 2 Designers et 2 PM.

L’équipe grandit, les enjeux aussi. On cherche aujourd’hui un Engineering Manager qui travaillera étroitement avec le CTO, à la fois sur le management de l’équipe, son organisation et les sujets techniques structurants.

Tu participeras aux roadmaps Engineering, à la composition des squads, à la définition des objectifs et aux prochains recrutements, tout en restant proche du code et du produit.

Chez Bricks, devenir manager ne veut pas dire s’éloigner de la technique : tu dois pouvoir entrer dans une discussion d’architecture, challenger une décision, faire une code review utile ou débloquer un sujet complexe.

🧱 Ce que tu vas owner

👉 Construire l’organisation Engineering avec le CTO : faire évoluer la composition des équipes, les objectifs, les façons de travailler et participer activement aux recrutements.

👉 Manager et faire progresser les ingénieurs au quotidien : 1:1, feedback, accompagnement, progression, exigence technique. Comprendre ce qui bloque quelqu’un et l’aider à passer au palier suivant.

👉 Rester connecté au code et au produit. Tu ne coderas pas nécessairement toute la journée, mais tu dois pouvoir entrer dans la codebase, participer aux reviews et prendre part aux décisions d’architecture.

👉 Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe shippe vite et bien. Identifier les blocages, arbitrer, clarifier les responsabilités et faire évoluer le process uniquement lorsqu’il apporte de la valeur.

👉 Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence technique. Modélisation du domaine, architecture, qualité des données, sécurité, performance : tu aides l’équipe à prendre les bonnes décisions là où elles comptent vraiment.

🛠️ La stack

Tu dois être suffisamment proche de notre environnement technique pour pouvoir intervenir réellement dans les discussions et dans le code :

👉 TypeScript end-to-end. Les types sont de la documentation qui s’exécute.

👉 Node monolithe, Screaming Architecture.

👉 Postgres (NeonDB) avec Graphile pour les queues ACID. Redis pour ce qui doit être rapide.

👉 Zod, Kysely, ts-pattern - type-safety du front à la DB.

👉 Better Auth.

👉 Railway pour l’infra.

👉 Github CI, Datadog, K6.

👉 React Native + RN Web côté front : une seul codebase web + mobile.

Tu n’as pas besoin d’avoir utilisé exactement chacune de ces technos. En revanche, Node/TypeScript et une vraie profondeur backend sont importants : on cherche quelqu’un capable de challenger techniquement l’équipe, pas seulement de la manager.

🤖 IA-first mindset

L’IA est partout dans notre quotidien. 100**% des workflows passe par elle** : Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Cursor, Automations, etc.

Et pour un Engineering Manager, l’enjeu va plus loin que sa propre utilisation : tu dois comprendre comment l’IA transforme la façon de manager, coder, de reviewer, de tester, de recruter et de faire progresser une équipe Engineering.

Si tu vois encore l’IA comme secondaire, ce poste n’est pas pour toi.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si...

👉 Tu as d’abord été Senior Software Engineer et tu n’as pas quitté la technique en devenant manager. Tu aimes toujours le code, tu restes proche des sujets techniques et tu peux encore mettre les mains dedans quand c’est nécessaire.

👉 Tu sais construire et faire vivre une équipe Engineering. Recruter, intégrer, faire progresser, donner du feedback et faire évoluer les responsabilités font partie du rôle.

title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
original_description:
Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences.

Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing, cashless payment, CRM, staff solutions and access control. We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures.

We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery.

Vos missions

This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year.

Part one : deliver the program. A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule.

  • Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start
  • Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked
  • Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt
  • Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order
  • Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads
  • Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence

Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality.

  • Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen
  • Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout
  • Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences
  • Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team

Vos compétences

Must-haves

  • Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams
  • A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly
  • Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once
  • The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data
  • Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means
  • Fluent French and English

What makes you a strong long-term fit

  • Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company
  • A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations
  • Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports
  • Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information

Nice to have

  • A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint)
  • Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them

This is not

  • A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads
  • A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure
  • A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy

The recruitment process

  • HR interview - background and soft skills
  • Interview with CTO - technical discussion

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Why it's a good move

You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs.

title: Alternant Ingénieur IA - Computer Vision (H/F)
original_description:
À propos du poste

Rejoignez TimeLapse Go, une entreprise innovante qui révolutionne le suivi de chantier connecté grâce à l’IA et à l’Internet des objets (IoT).

Notre mission : transformer la gestion de chantier pour aider nos clients à gagner du temps, de l’argent et à améliorer la sécurité sur le terrain.

Votre rôle :

Au sein de notre pôle R&D, une équipe resserrée où chacun a un vrai rôle, vous participerez au développement de nos solutions d’IA : analyse d’images et de vidéos de chantier, détection d’événements, automatisation. Vous travaillerez en lien direct avec la direction, sur des cas d’usage réels et avec des données de terrain : vos contributions auront un impact concret et visible sur notre produit.

Nous valorisons l’audace, la communication et l’exécution rapide dans un environnement en forte croissance.

Vos missions

Vos principales missions :

  • Entraîner et mettre en place des modèles de vision.
  • Réentraîner et maintenir les modèles de détection déjà déployés.
  • Préparer et gérer les datasets : extraction de données, annotation, versioning.
  • Développer des services personnalisés pour des besoins clients et/ou des besoins internes à l’entreprise.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché :

Vous aimez avancer par vous-même, prendre des initiatives et trouver vos propres solutions ? Dans une très petite équipe, votre autonomie sera un vrai atout : vous organiserez votre travail et serez force de proposition.

Compétences

  • Bonne maîtrise de Python.
  • Expérience en Machine Learning à travers des projets académiques ou personnels (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
  • Git, Linux.
  • Traitement d’image / Computer Vision, idéalement à travers des projets académiques ou personnels (OpenCV, YOLO, scikit-image).
  • Expérience avec un service cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, Scaleway).
  • Visualisation de données.
  • Bon niveau d’anglais (B2 minimum), notamment technique.

Formation

  • Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur (niveau M2 / Bac+5), en informatique, data science, robotique ou mathématiques appliquées, avec un contenu orienté Computer Vision / analyse de données.

Avantages

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Alternance, basée à Boulogne-Billancourt.
  • Une grande autonomie et de vraies responsabilités dès les premières semaines.
  • Une très petite équipe, où chaque contribution compte, en lien direct avec la direction.
  • Un environnement stimulant, avec une forte liberté d’initiative et des projets à fort impact.

Pourquoi TimeLapse Go ?

  • Un secteur en pleine transformation, porté par la tech et l’IA.
  • Une entreprise en croissance rapide, à taille humaine.
  • Une culture d’innovation, de confiance et d’autonomie.

title: AI Engineer (m/w/d) 80-100%
original_description:
Jobbeschreibung

Mach mit uns Schweizer Kleinunternehmen noch erfolgreicher! Klingt nach einer grossen Vision? Genau das treibt uns jeden Tag an.

Wir bei bexio leben die Philosophie, dass erstklassige, effiziente und smarte Softwarelösungen für jedes KMU zugänglich und erschwinglich sein müssen. Mit dieser Mission sind wir heute die führende Anbieterin für webbasierte Business-Software in der Schweiz.

Unser Expansionskurs geht steil nach oben: Über 100'000 zufriedene Kunden, mehr als 7'000 Treuhand-Partner und ein starkes Team von über 150 motivierten Mitarbeitenden sprechen für sich. Um diese Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir tatkräftige Unterstützung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel!

Stellenanforderungen

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du arbeitest in unserem motivierten und lösungsorientierten AI Feature Team mit agentischen Entwicklungsmethoden und einem hohen Mass an Eigenverantwortung.
  • Du konzipierst, entwickelst und implementierst skalierbare KI-gestützte Funktionen in unseren Produkten, die von mehr als 100.000 Kunden genutzt werden.
  • Du arbeitest intensiv mit Large Language Models (LLMs), um Lösungen für NLP, Conversational AI und generative KI-Anwendungsfälle zu entwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um KI-gesteuerte Funktionen und Anwendungen zu entwerfen.
  • Du treibst Innovationen voran, indem du die neuesten KI-Technologien erforschst und neue Ansätze für unsere geschäftlichen Herausforderungen vorschlägst.
  • Hochschulabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich mit praktischer Erfahrung als AI Engineer, ML Engineer oder Fullstack Software Engineer bei der Entwicklung skalierbarer, sicherer KI-Features (bevorzugt im SaaS-Umfeld).

Dein Rucksack für diese Stelle

  • Hochschulabschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich mit praktischer Erfahrung als AI Engineer, ML Engineer oder Fullstack Software Engineer bei der Entwicklung skalierbarer, sicherer KI-Features (bevorzugt im SaaS-Umfeld).
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Cloud-Umgebungen (GCP), KI-Plattformen (Vertex AI) und modernen KI-Orchestrierungs-Frameworks (z. B. Google ADK, LangChain, LlamaIndex).
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung mit RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Prompt Engineering und der Bereitstellung von LLMs für reale Geschäftsanwendungen.
  • Fortgeschrittene Python-Programmierkenntnisse, Erfahrung mit KI/ML-Bibliotheken und -Frameworks, solides Backend-Wissen (async, REST, Testing, Security) sowie Erfahrung mit Datenbanken wie MongoDB oder Redis.

title: Application Engineer (m/w/d) - 100%
original_description:
For our client Eugen Seitz AG – seitzvalve, we are looking for an Application Engineer (m/w/d) – 100%

The World of Seitz

Welcome to the fascinating world of high-pressure solenoid valves at SeitzValve!

SeitzValve, a leader in the development and production of valve technology for gaseous media in the medium- and high-pressure ranges, opens the door to a fascinating world of innovative solutions. Our ambition to think bigger and more progressively drives us to make life better for the next generation. At SeitzValve, we rely on proactivity, a sense of responsibility, reliability, innovation, and enthusiasm to drive our work forward.

Tasks

Are you not only an engineer, but also a bridge between the customer and the development team?

Do you understand technical requirements—and turn them into innovative solutions?

Then you’ve come to the right place.

At Seitz, you’ll work alongside our customers to develop high-precision valve solutions for the PET industry—an environment where technology, speed, and precision are crucial.

As an Application Engineer, you serve as the central link between the customer, the development team, and the product.

You understand applications, identify opportunities, and actively drive new solutions forward.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Developing and helping to shape design concepts in close collaboration with customers
  • Responsibility for the technical specifications of valve solutions
  • Collaborating on complex development projects in an international environment
  • Primary point of contact for technical customer inquiries and new applications
  • Initiating and driving new product developments in the PET sector
  • Building and deepening expertise in blow molding and valve technology
  • Close collaboration with internal teams and external partners

Requirements

  • Degree in mechanical engineering or systems engineering
  • Several years of experience in product development (ideally >5 years)
  • Experience with technically challenging products in an industrial setting
  • Understanding of customer requirements and their translation into technical solutions
  • Enjoyment of direct customer contact and international collaboration
  • Very good German and English language skills

A plus:

  • Experience in the field of PET / blow molding
  • Knowledge of valve or fluid technology

What Sets You Apart

  • You take the initiative to drive projects forward and take responsibility
  • You think analytically, creatively, and with an entrepreneurial mindset
  • You are open and approachable and enjoy working as part of a team
  • You have the courage to propose and implement new ideas
  • You think outside the box and continue to refine solutions

Benefits

  • Exciting technologies in the field of PET and industrial applications
  • Direct collaboration with international customers
  • Ample creative freedom and autonomy
  • Flat decision-making structures in a close-knit small-to-medium-sized enterprise
  • A motivated team with a high level of technical expertise

Please send us your certificates and diplomas along with your CV. Many thanks in advance!

title: Security Operations Engineer DevSecOps (a) 80 - 100%
original_description:
KNOW YOUR TALENTS.

Dein künftiger Arbeitgeber ist ein etablierter Schweizer Softwarehersteller. Seine Leitsysteme sorgen im Hintergrund dafür, dass kritische Infrastruktur rund um die Uhr zuverlässig funktioniert. Fallen diese Systeme aus, merken es viele Menschen sofort. Entwickelt wird in der Schweiz, in einem eingespielten Team mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung. Die Produkte werden über viele Jahre gepflegt und weiterentwickelt, Zuverlässigkeit zählt hier mehr als der schnelle Release. Mit NIS2 und dem Cyber Resilience Act rückt die Sicherheit der eigenen Software ins Zentrum, und Du gestaltest diesen Bereich von Anfang an mit.

Möchtest Du als

Security Operations Engineer DevSecOps (a) 80 - 100%

nicht nur Teil des Ganzen sein, sondern aktiv Einfluss nehmen und mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Aufgaben

  • Sicherheitsarchitektur der eigenen Softwareprodukte gestalten, analysieren und konsequent nach dem Prinzip Security-by-Design weiterentwickeln
  • Security automatisiert in CI/CD-Pipelines integrieren: SAST, DAST, Dependency- und Container-Scanning sowie verbindliche Secure-Coding-Guidelines
  • Schwachstellenmanagement sowie Incident Detection und Response verantworten und die Security-Toolchain gezielt ausbauen
  • Security Assessments, Architektur-Risikoanalysen und Audits planen und durchführen, mit Blick auf ISO/IEC 27001, NIS2 und den Cyber Resilience Act
  • Entwicklung und Fachbereiche beraten, Richtlinien und Standards erarbeiten sowie Schulungen und Awareness-Massnahmen durchführen

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium (FH/HF), idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Software Engineering oder Cyber Security, oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit klarer Weiterentwicklung Richtung Security Architecture und Secure Software Development
  • Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Architekturprinzipien, Secure-Coding-Praktiken und Threat-Modeling-Methoden wie STRIDE
  • Praxiserfahrung mit DevSecOps-Werkzeugen und deren Integration in CI/CD-Pipelines
  • Kenntnisse von NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, BSI-Standards und IT-Grundschutz
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
  • Von Vorteil: Know-how in OT- und IoT-Security sowie Erfahrung mit SOC-Konzepten

Benefits

  • Arbeit mit spürbarer Wirkung: Schutz von Systemen, auf die sich im Alltag viele Menschen verlassen
  • Grosser Gestaltungsspielraum: Security wird hier aufgebaut, nicht nur verwaltet, eigene Ideen fliessen direkt in die Produkte ein
  • Flexibles Pensum in Voll- oder Teilzeit, Arbeitsort Aargau
  • Gezielte Förderung der fachlichen Weiterbildung
  • Offene, kollegiale Kultur mit internationalen Kontakten und gemeinsamen Teamanlässen

title: Edge & Machine Integration Engineer (PLC to Cloud), Freelance, m/f/d
original_description:
FALU AG in Rüti (ZH) builds and sells swab production machines that run in plants around the world. With FALU PMAS, our cloud based production monitoring and assistance system, every machine reports its state every five seconds. Customers get live dashboards, shift KPIs, downtime analytics and automatic alerts in the browser. The first customer went live in September 2026 with eight machines, and more plants are lined up.

The cloud side of PMAS is built and running in production: broker, ingestion service, databases, web app. The path from the PLC inside the machine to the MQTT broker is covered by one engineer who designed and built it. With more machines and more plants coming, that one person is no longer enough. We are looking for a freelancer who adds capacity on exactly this path: PLC software, Raspberry Pi edge devices, site gateway, broker connection.

This is a permanent role that we staff on a freelance basis: no project end date, a long term engagement with about 1 week of work per month, with more when a rollout is on. You will work directly with our existing integration engineer, our inhouse engineering team and the CEO.

Tasks

You work on everything between the machine PLC and the MQTT broker, alongside the engineer who built the current setup. Which parts you take over completely and which you share depends on your strengths. Concretely:

PLC and machine side

  • Bring the PMAS message format into the CB1 machine software (Siemens S7, TIA Portal V18 with HMI) and keep it in sync with the payload contract: cumulative counters, machine status, error codes, timestamps from the PLC clock.
  • Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.
  • Manage PLC software versions across the fleet, including safe update and rollback procedures for machines already running at customers.
  • Ensure clock discipline on the PLCs (NTP, local time zone per plant), since every duration KPI is computed from PLC timestamps.

Edge devices and site gateway

  • Develop and maintain the software on the Raspberry Pi based edge devices next to each machine: MQTT client, buffering and store and forward during uplink outages, unique client IDs, credential handling, health reporting.
  • Develop and maintain the site gateway: isolated machine network, routing and firewall, outbound only TLS and NTP, remote maintenance access, watchdogs, recovery from a spare device.
  • Help turn the current setup into a provisioning process: golden image, per machine configuration, fleet wide updates without a site visit. A new machine goes from unboxing to "visible in the dashboard" in under an hour.
  • Monitor the edge layer so that we know about a degraded device before the customer does.

Broker and data contract

  • Administer the HiveMQ Cloud clusters per customer: credentials, topic ACLs, client ID scheme, certificates.
  • Maintain the payload contract together with the existing integration engineer. Changes are versioned and documented.

Commissioning and support

  • Onboard new customers and new machines end to end, remotely where possible and on site where needed (primarily Europe and the United States).
  • Act as second line when "the dashboard shows nothing" or "the numbers look wrong" and the cause sits between PLC and broker.
  • Write the documentation you would have wanted on day one: onboarding sheets, runbooks, wiring notes.

Requirements

Must have

  • Siemens PLC programming in TIA Portal (SCL and LAD, S7-1200/1500 family). You can open an existing machine project, understand it and change it without breaking the machine.
  • Industrial networking: PROFINET, VLANs, static and DHCP setups, firewalls, TLS basics. You have connected a machine to a network that was not built for it.
  • Linux on Raspberry Pi or comparable single board computers: systemd, networking, images, headless operation, remote administration.
  • Solid programming skills in Python or Node.js for edge software, and Git as a daily tool.
  • MQTT in depth: versions 3.1.1 and 5.0, QoS levels, retained messages, last will, TLS, broker ACLs.
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools is a hard requirement. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or comparable tools every day, you write and maintain project instructions for them, you review their output critically, and you are measurably faster with them than without. Our code and documentation are written with and for these tools. If you see AI tools as optional, this role is not for you.
  • Working proficiency in English (all code, commits and documentation are in English). German is a plus for the machine side.
  • Willingness to travel to customer plants, typically a few days per quarter.
  • Availability of at least two days per week on a permanent basis, with the option to scale up during rollouts.
  • You work as a freelancer (own company or registered self employed) and can invoice FALU AG.

Nice to have

  • OPC UA, Snap7 or the Siemens open communication libraries.
  • Node-RED, Docker on ARM, Ansible or similar fleet tooling.
  • Machine building or commissioning experience: reading electrical schematics, 24 V control cabinet basics, HMI (WinCC).
  • Administration of HiveMQ, Mosquitto or EMQX.
  • A basic understanding of what happens after the broker (Node.js services, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse), so that you can talk to the cloud side at eye level.

Benefits

  • A clearly bounded, business critical scope with a colleague who knows the system and hands over properly. No cold start.
  • A running production system with a real customer, not a greenfield slide deck.
  • AI assisted development is how we work, not an experiment. You get the tools and the budget for them.
  • Machines you can touch: a test bench at FALU in Rüti with real PLCs and edge hardware.
  • Remote by default, on site in Rüti when hardware is involved. Travel to customer plants is paid on top of the rate.
  • A permanent role, not a project with an end date: growing volume as more plants go live, on a freelance basis for as long as it works for both sides.
  • Fast, uncomplicated invoicing and decisions from a small team.

If you have ever made a stubborn PLC talk to the cloud and have capacity to do it again with us, we would like to hear from you.

Please send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, your daily rate and availability, one paragraph about a PLC to cloud integration you built or fixed and what went wrong on the way, and one concrete example of how you use AI tools in your daily engineering work.

What to expect: a short call with Marc Wyss (CEO) within a week of your application, then a small practical task with a simulated PLC data source, a Raspberry Pi image and a broker endpoint. We look at how you work, not just at the result. After that, one conversation with our integration engineer and the team, then a decision and a contract.

title: Backend Software Engineer (Core AI)
original_description:
At Goodweek, we're building a next-generation AI tool designed to revolutionize business productivity. We are focusing on delivering a secure, scalable, and reliable system that supports real business use cases across different departments. The goal is to make AI practical, controlled, and truly embedded in how modern organizations operate.

Our team spans across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by 6 international investment funds.

To accelerate our growth, we're looking for a talented Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and help us build an innovative product that will make a real impact on how thousands of users work every day.

Tasks

About the role

As a Backend Engineer, you'll work on the core infrastructure that makes our AI platform fast, reliable, and scalable.

You'll be joining the Core AI team, responsible for the foundational layer of our AI product, covering orchestration, memory, low-level security, and system harness.

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, thinking about latency, reliability, and model behavior all at once.

What you'll do

You'll be tackling challenges across:

  • AI orchestration: owning the core layer that coordinates AI workflows, model calls, multi-step reasoning, and multi-agent delegation, including RAG pipelines and knowledge bases
  • LLM integration: integrating and tuning new LLMs into a production-grade backend, with a focus on security, guardrails, and evaluation (latency, response quality)
  • Data ingestion & export: building robust pipelines and services to handle a variety of file formats reliably and at scale
  • Context & token optimization: designing strategies to maximize LLM efficiency, manage context windows, and keep costs in check
  • Infrastructure & observability: designing scalable APIs, automating deployment pipelines, monitoring, and testing to keep the platform reliable and performant
  • Architecture & engineering culture: participating in tech stack decisions, documenting technical knowledge, and continuously driving innovation across the AI platform

Requirements

Technical background

  • 5+ years of experience with Node.js + TypeScript stack
  • NestJS/React and PostgreSQL are a plus
  • Hands-on experience (or strong familiarity) with AI/ML integration (LLMs, RAG, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of backend architecture, scalability, and security best practices
  • Experience with databases, authentication, and cloud platforms (AWS)
  • Familiar with CI/CD, Git workflows, and agile methodologies
  • Bonus: familiarity with other backend programming languages applied to AI (Python, Go...)

Soft skills

  • Strong technical communication
  • Agile mindset focused on product and business value
  • Ability to document and defend architectural decisions
  • Balance between code quality and delivery speed
  • Technical English required

Benefits

  • Health insurance provided by the employer
  • Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Hybrid remote work
  • Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain

title: Software Delivery Manager 80-100%
original_description:
Für unseren Kunden santéservices ag suchen wir einen Software Delivery Manager 80-100%

santéservices ag ist eine moderne Dienstleistungsorganisation im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen. Mit fundiertem Fachwissen, langjähriger Erfahrung und einem breiten Angebot schaffen wir Mehrwert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und leisten einen wichtigen Beitrag zu einem funktionierenden Gesundheitswesen.

Als junge Organisation mit starken Wurzeln entwickeln wir uns laufend weiter. Wir vereinfachen Strukturen und Prozesse, nutzen die Chancen der Digitalisierung und richten unsere Leistungen konsequent an den Bedürfnissen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden aus. Dabei setzen wir auf Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, ihr Wissen einbringen und Veränderungen aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Für den Bereich Digitalisierung & Informatik suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine wirkungsvolle Persönlichkeit.

Aufgaben

Deine Mission | Du…

... begleitest die Fachbereiche bei der Anforderungserhebung (in Workshops, Interviews und Prozessanalysen) und spezifizierst die Anforderungen, z. B. als User Stories, Use Cases oder Prozessmodelle.

... steuerst das Demand Management, bewertest und priorisierst Anforderungen und sorgst für eine saubere Übergabe an die Umsetzung.

... verantwortest das Projekt- & Lieferantenmanagement – von der Beauftragung und Steuerung der Projekte bis zum Budget-, Governance- und Vertragscontrolling.

... vertrittst die fachlichen Interessen gegenüber Lieferanten und wirkst bei der Internalisierung externer Entwicklungsleistungen mit.

... koordinierst Tests und Abnahmen und begleitest die Qualitätssicherung entlang des gesamten Delivery-Prozesses.

... managst interne Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit dem Release Management zusammen – für zuverlässige Ergebnisse und erfolgreiche Releases.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil | Du…

... hast ein Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung abgeschlossen.

... bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Anforderungserhebung und Spezifikation mit (z. B. als Product Owner, Business Analyst oder Requirements Engineer).

... verfügst über solide Projektmanagement-Skills und bist vertraut mit der Steuerung externer IT-Dienstleister.

... hast Erfahrung in Testing und Abnahmen von Individualsoftware sowie idealerweise im Release Management.

... kennst das Krankenversicherungswesen oder hast Freude daran, dir neues Domänenwissen anzueignen.

... überzeugst durch Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

... sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

Unser Angebot | Wir…

... bieten dir eine vielseitige Rolle mit viel Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einer serviceorientierten IT-Umgebung.

... arbeiten partnerschaftlich, unkompliziert und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

... setzen auf moderne Arbeitsformen mit geregelten Arbeitszeiten, um die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben zu unterstützen.

... bieten attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen sowie fortschrittliche Sozialleistungen.

Bitte stelle uns mit Deinem Lebenslauf auch Deine Zeugnisse und Diplome zu. Herzlichen Dank vorab!

title: Alternant - Business Developer (H/F/X)
original_description:
Dans le cadre du renforcement de son pôle Commercial, CyberSpector, TPE spécialisée en cybersécurité, cyber-intelligence et gouvernance numérique, recrute un(e) Alternant Business développeur. A ce poste stratégique, il/elle accélère la croissance, sécurise l’exécution des ventes et garantit un parcours client fluide et engageant autour de nos services et solutions, dans le strict respect des exigences de cybersécurité.

Vos missions

Piloter la performance commerciale : acquisition, développement de comptes et exécution du pipeline (services & solutions cyber).

  • Structurer et déployer le go-to-market : offres, pricing/packaging, playbooks, campagnes.
  • Sécuriser les deals clés et ancrer une discipline commerciale data-driven (CRM, KPIs, forecast).

Stratégie & plan d’exécution

  • Définir les territoires/segments (ICP, verticales, personae) et les playbooks.
  • Construire, avec le marketing, des campagnes inbound/outbound (contenus, événements, partenaires).
  • Développer l’écosystème partenaires (technologiques, intégrateurs, distributeurs).
  • Mettre en place et faire respecter la discipline CRM (qualité des données, étapes du funnel, hygiène pipeline).
  • Tenir les KPIs (pipeline coverage, taux de conversion, cycle de vente, MRR/ARR) et activer des plans de rattrapage.

Prospection & génération d’opportunités

  • Construire et exécuter un plan de prospection multicanal (emailing, social selling, appels, événements).
  • Qualifier les leads inbound/outbound (ICP, enjeux, budget, délai, décideurs).

Conduite du cycle de vente complet

  • Mener les RDV de découverte, démonstrations et POC/pilotes en lien avec les équipes techniques.
  • Rédiger les offres et négocier les conditions commerciales et contractuelles jusqu’au closing.

Appels d’offres (marchés publics & privés)

  • Assurer la veille, piloter le go/no-go, coordonner les dossiers techniques/financiers/juridiques et préparer les soutenances.

Gestion et expansion des comptes

  • Coordonner l’onboarding avec Customer Success, détecter upsell/cross-sell, sécuriser les renouvellements.

Collaboration interne & feedback marché

  • Partager les insights marché (prix, packaging, messages, objections).
  • Co-concevoir les campagnes et contenus avec Marketing & Produit.

Vos compétences

Compétences techniques

  • Expérience en ventes B2B sur cycle complet, idéalement dans le SaaS/IT/cybersécurité ; pratique des appels d’offres appréciée.
  • Maîtrise de la prospection structurée, de la découverte orientée valeur, de démos impactantees et de la négociation multi-interlocuteurs (métiers, Achats, DSI, RSSI).
  • Solide rigueur data/CRM : construction de pipeline, pilotage du forecast et suivi des ventes.
  • Langues : Français courant ; Anglais professionnel (oral/écrit).

Savoir-être

  • Orientation résultats et sens de l’impact.
  • Clarté écrite et orale, écoute active et analyse des besoins.
  • Esprit d’équipe, leadership d’exécution (« faire » et faire faire).
  • Curiosité marché, rigueur, créativité et forte éthique.

Formation

  • Alternant en Bac+3, Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en gestion commerciale, business developpement/marketing ou équivalent.

Avantages

Démarche RSE

Ticket Restaurant
Forfaits déplacement

Rejoindre CyberSpector, c’est contribuer à des projets à fort impact social et stratégique, à la croisée de la cybersécurité et de l’innovation, au sein d’une équipe engagée pour la résilience numérique des organisations et des entreprises.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Laravel | Next.js | PostgreSQL)
original_description:
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our engineering team and work on a large-scale production application.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working on modern technologies, and taking ownership of products used by real users.

You'll be joining an existing engineering team to help accelerate the development of one of our flagship products.

The application is already in production and includes:

• Large Laravel backend

• Next.js frontend

• PostgreSQL database

• Existing MongoDB components (currently being migrated)

• Multiple third-party API integrations

• Background jobs & queues

• Scheduled cron jobs

• Dockerized infrastructure

• CI/CD pipelines

• Cloud-based deployment

You'll work closely with our existing DevOps engineer to improve deployments, infrastructure, scalability, and application performance.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding complex systems and improving them rather than simply building small applications from scratch.

Tasks

echnology Stack

Frontend

• Next.js

• React.js

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Tailwind CSS

Backend

• Laravel

• PHP

• REST APIs

Database

• PostgreSQL

• MongoDB (Migration in Progress)

Infrastructure

• Docker

• Linux

• Nginx

• Git

• CI/CD

• Cloudflare

Nice to Have

• Redis

• RabbitMQ

• WebSockets

• AWS

• DigitalOcean

• Kubernetes

• AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude)

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

• Develop new features for an enterprise-scale web application.

• Understand and work within an existing production codebase.

• Build and maintain Laravel APIs and backend services.

• Develop frontend features using Next.js and React.

• Complete the migration from MongoDB to PostgreSQL.

• Optimize PostgreSQL queries and database performance.

• Integrate and maintain third-party APIs.

• Manage cron jobs, queues, scheduled tasks, and background workers.

• Collaborate with the DevOps engineer on deployments, CI/CD, and infrastructure improvements.

• Troubleshoot production issues and implement long-term solutions.

• Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.

• Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews.

• Mentor junior developers when needed.

Required:

title: Full Stack Engineer (Elixir Backend Focus)
original_description:
We're looking for a AI-first Full Stack Engineer with a strong backend and Elixir expertise to own partner APIs and dashboards that power the qiibee ecosystem (partnered Miles & More, Etihad Guest, and more).

In this role, you'll combine deep backend expertise with AI-powered workflows to take features through every stage — from architecture and coding to deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement — across a double-entry ledger, partner-facing APIs and the React interfaces on top of them.

You'll be a key point of ownership for our core platform, ensuring every partner integration is correct, reliable and well documented — supported by AI at every step.

Tasks

  • Design, build and operate Elixir services with Phoenix, Ecto and OTP: APIs, workers and background jobs.
  • Build and evolve our partner-facing REST APIs, including versioning, outbound webhooks and delivery guarantees.
  • Work on money-adjacent systems where correctness comes first: ledgers, points balances, settlement and reconciliation.
  • Own frontend features end to end in React and TypeScript, from the admin and partner dashboards to the API behind them.
  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code) daily to move faster, while reviewing their output.
  • Review code substantively, and act as a second pair of eyes on system correctness.
  • Write the reasoning down: clear PR descriptions, architecture notes, and docs updated in the same pull request as the code.
  • Collaborate with product and our infrastructure team on deployment, monitoring and security on AWS.

Requirements

  • AI first: Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) every day.
  • 6+ years of professional software engineering, with 4+ years on the backend.
  • 3+ years of production Elixir with Phoenix, Ecto and OTP, shipped and operated, not learned on the side.
  • Strong PostgreSQL: real SQL, transaction semantics and performance tuning.
  • Solid REST API design and background job processing (Oban or equivalent) with retries.
  • Proven experience in the loyalty, travel tech, payments or FinTech industries.
  • 2+ years of React and TypeScript, strong enough to own a frontend feature outright: components, state, forms, validation and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of AWS (ECS, RDS, S3), Docker and CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Fluent in English

Nice to have 🎯

  • Built features on top of LLM APIs or AI agent workflows
  • Redux Toolkit / RTK Query, LiveView, Node.js (Express) or GraphQL.
  • Multi-tenant B2B platforms, multi-region architectures, observability (AppSignal, Sentry, Datadog) and SOC 2 exposure.

Benefits

🚀 Benefits:

  • Fully remote work
  • Competitive monthly salary package
  • Equity share and qiibee tokens (QBX), sharing in our success
  • Fast-paced remote startup environment

💫 About us:

At qiibee, we're on a mission to turn loyalty currencies into one of the world's largest payment methods. Our points exchange platform lets businesses and loyalty programs issue and redeem loyalty rewards instantly, unlocking real purchasing power and economic freedom for their members. We're an AI-first, international team, building an increasingly agentic company where AI handles the busywork so our people can focus on what matters most: our customers.

We're looking for ambitious, high-performing people who are eager for growth, challenges, and continuous learning to help us turn our vision into reality. If this sounds like your dream job, we would love to hear from you! 🌟
